tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rang gi tshul gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i gtam rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan kho nas smras pa gsong po'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /rang gi tshul gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i gtam rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan kho nas smras pa gsong po'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rang gi tshul gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i gtam rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan kho nas smras pa gsong po'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅/ /rang gi tshul gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i gtam rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan kho nas smras pa gsong po'i dga' ston zhes bya ba// bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi rang bzhin zab zhi spros bral 'dus ma byas pa lhun grub mnyam yangs kun tu bzang*/ */ bde stong gnyis med ro la rtag rol kha sbyor zung 'jug rnam kun mchog ldan bde ba che// rnam pa sna tshogs sgyu ma'i gar mkhan gcig dang du bral rol pa'i rtsal 'chang 'dod dgur bsgyur/ rtsa brgyud bla ma sangs rgyas chos tshogs phyag 'os kun la rnam pa kun tu bdag 'dud do// mtshan dpe bye ba'i rgyan mang rdzogs kyang rin chen du ma'i rgyan la rol// srid zhir sdang dang khro ba spangs kyang glegs bam ral gri phyag na 'bar// rgyal ba kun gyi yab tu gyur kyang rgyal sras gzhon nu'i zol la brten// lhag pa'i lha mchog dpa' bo khyod ni bdag snying padmar rtag rol mdzod// skyes sbyangs dman zhing shin ter gyur pa yi// gyi na bdag la yi ger 'bri 'os pa'i// rnam thar ya mtshan can gyis dben mod kyang*// dad ldan gyis bskul slad du g.yar khral tsam/ /de yang rnam par thar pa yi ge'i lam du spel ba mang dag zhig mthong mod kyang*/ kun tu dpyad gsum dpyis phyin pa bgyis na 'di lta ste/ 'ga' zhig ni ya mtshan gyi chos mngon sum du ston pa'i grub pa mchog gi gnas thob pa rnam thar mthong ba tsam gyis go 'phang dam pa thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba dang*/ la la ni sku tshe'i stod mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs chen po rnams sbyangs shing sku tshe'i smad la sgrub pa snying por byas pas tshe 'dir rdo rje 'chang chen po mngon du mdzad pa dang*/ kha cig ni skyes sbyangs kyi yon tan rmad du byung bas bstan 'gro'i phan bde 'phel ba'i sgo gcig pur gyur pa dang*/ la la ni rang nyid ma grol yang lung dang rigs pa'i gzhung lugs la rgya cher sbyangs pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor los 'dzin pa dang*/

'ga' zhig ni rang rgyud la gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa ngo mthong tsam byung nas dam pa gong ma'i man ngag la brten te/ gzhan rjes su bzung bas sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin du 'jug pa sgrub pa nan tan gyi 'khor los rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin par mdzad pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig ni tshe stod thos bsam sgom gsum cung zad tsam bgyis nas snyan grags cung zad byung ba snying por byas te 'khor tshogs thabs kyis bsdu zhing chen por rlom pa dang*/ la la dag ni gong ma'i yig cha nag khrigs cung zad tsam la brten nas mkhas par rlom pa dang*/ kha cig ni cho ga dang chos spyod tsam glo bar tshud pas dam par rlom pa dang*/ la la ni legs bshad kyi cha mi 'tshal bar nga'i pha che ma gnyan rigs bzang rus btsun zhes rang bstod kho nas gzhan slu ba sogs mang dag cig mthong zhing thos pa dang*/ bdag gis ni dam pa gong ma de rnams kyi rnam thar 'chad tshul bshad ma thag pa rnams phyogs tsam yang mi 'tshal gyi| phyi ma de gnyis kyi tshul la gnas pas snag shog gron cing lag pa ngal la 'bad pa don med du bris pa la dgos pa ci zhig chu shing gi snying po ltar bas mod kyi/ 'on kyang bla ma lho pa sku skyes ring nas bskul ba dang*/ nye bar la phyi'i rdo rje 'dzin pa bla ma chos kyis dag pa'i me tog dang bcas bskul ba'i ngor/ mos ldan dad pa dga' sdug gi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pa 'ga' zhig dang tshul mtshungs par ma mchis pa dad ldan de dag la legs par ma bshad na rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu gnyis pa khur gyi dogs pas 'jigs te rang gi tshul rnams ci dran gang dran rnams med pa la yod par sgro btags pa dang*/ yod pa la med par skur pa btab pa'i skyon spangs nas gnas lugs gang yin gsong por smras pa rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyi mtshan nyid yin pas de ltar 'bri bar bya'o// de la yang spyir nged cag 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi btsan sa ma zin pas 'khor ba gcig nas gcig tu skye ba'i phreng ba 'dzin pa las 'os med kyang*/

rgyal dbang ratna'i sprul pa'i cha shas su grags pa zhig byung 'dug kyang*/ rgyal ba de nyid kyi dag snang gi chos tsinta ma ṇi'i rdzun bris dang por/ da ni lus len skye ba'i mtha' rdzogs shing*/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gter ston o rgyan gling pas zung mkhar rdo'i mchod rten nas gdan drangs pa thugs rje chen po ye shes 'od chog las/ da lta'i lha sras mu tig btsad po 'di// gang ltar bya ba rang la dbang yod kyang*// o rgyan nga la mos shing sems chags pas// gang la gang 'dul 'gro ba'i snang ngo ru// skye ba dang po pha bus las 'brel btags| |bar du pad 'byung bdag dang skabs su mjal// phyi ma'i dus na zhing khams 'bri zhes par// ratna'i mtshan can sde dgon skyong ba 'byung*/ bdud sprul dbang gis tshe yi dus byas nas// tha ma'i dus na nga yi thugs sprul pa// gter chos brgyud 'dzin 'gro la 'brel gsum 'dogs// rgyal sras dbur smyon zhes byar grags pa 'byung*// zhes dang*// a stag bla ma kun dgas rje de nyid la zhus pa'i dris lan du/ snang srid 'khor 'das chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar// kun shes kun rig yongs grol gang de yis// 'khor 'das byed po'i rgyu 'bras rten 'brel shes// bdag la ltos dang mos shing 'brel ba kun// sngon gyi smon lam rten 'brel mi bslu bas// 'di 'og ngan song mi ltung g.yar dam yin// lan gcig slar yang sa phyogs 'di nyid du// 'bri yi mi bud dharma'i srid nyams thug /de 'dra'i dus shig myur du 'byung ngam snyam// dam can kun kyang nga yi phyi bzhin 'brangs// bla ma yi dam dbyings nas bdag zhal phyogs| |phyogs 'di'i srid la 'jig rten skyong kun smod// de dus nga yi snying gis mi bzod pas// chos dang srid tshul 'dzin pas bstan zhabs skyong*// zhes pa 'di yang snying gtam ji bzhin du// snying gi bu la dben pa'i tshal nas bskur// da lta kun gyis kha 'byer mchu 'jib tsam// de dus nga la snying nas skyo ba 'byung*// e bden rim gyis gsal lo rdo rje'i mched// yi ge 'di ni shin tu gsang ba'i rgya// zhes sogs gsungs pa dang 'gal ba ltar snang yang*/

spyan snga shes rab 'byung gnas kyis/ de ni skad gcig bskal pa rgya mtshor ston// zhing khams mtha' yas phra ba'i rdul du 'dzud// mi mtshungs mdzad pa dpag med bstan gyur kyang*// de ni mi 'khrul gshis la gnas pa lags// zhes gsungs la/ gshis de gang zhe na/ ji skad du/ gshis de stong pa nyid la 'gyur ba med// ces gsungs shing*/ des na mi gcig pa ltar snang yang don la ma 'gal te/ ji skad du/ stong nyid yin pa'i gnad ka des// cir yang bsgyur du btub pa yin// zhes gsungs pas snga ma 'gyur ba med pa gsungs pa ni ngo bo la dgongs la/ phyi ma 'gyur btub par gsungs pa ni| rang mdangs rang rtsal la dgongs pa yin pas na/ dus gcig la rnam 'phrul mang po bstan pa yang*/ rgyal dbang ratnas gter sgrom du dag pa'i 'khor 'ga' zhig la nga'i skye ba gnyis lhan cig tu bstan pa lha sras mu tig btsad po dang slob dpon nam mkha'i snying po lta bu yin/ zhes gsungs/ zhes rnam thar drung pa rin chen dpal gyis bsgrigs par byung ba dang*/ gzhan yang chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas yin pas na 'gal bar mi bsam mo// gzhan yang gang zag mchog gi skye ba yin zer ba la deng sang ha cang khams che ba'i tshul mi ston pa yang srid de/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu// mi yul bod kyi grong khyer du// mi dang 'dra bar snang bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ rgyud rnams su/ gang phyir rdo rje sems dpa' che// sems can phan gdags dmigs nas ni// tha mal pa yi tshul gyis gnas// zhes gsungs pa sogs mang na/ don la mgon po byams pas/ chos nyid bsam mi khyab dran bya// zhes pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ nga dang nga 'dra bas gang zag gi tshod 'dzin par bya yis/ */khyod dang khyod 'dra bas gang zag gi tshod 'dzin par mi bya'o// zhes gsungs pa yin la/ yang karma pa mi bskyod zhabs kyi gsang ba'i rnam thar du/

nga karma pa'i mtshan gyis byin gyis brlabs zhes smras pa yin gyi/ nga karma pa'i skye ba yin ma smras/ de mi smra ba'i rgyu mtshan sngar gyi karma pa'i sgo khyi'i yon tan tsam yang da lta'i karma pa la med pa yin pas so// zhes gsungs pa yang don la gnas pa 'dra bsam/ des na nga rang gi rnam thar gyi 'go 'dir lung sna tshogs dang bcas bshad pa ni rang tshul la yon tan med par dam pa gong ma khyad par can mang po'i skye bar khas blangs pa de dngos 'gal du song dogs/ deng sang gi dge bshes rnams kyi bgro gleng gi spyan ltos la dmigs rtse gtad pa'i rang rgyal btsan po bcad nas ma 'ongs par gzhan rnams kyis 'chad los sngon bsus dogs pa sngar bcad pa'i skam rags gcig byung dogs la gnyis rgyab pa'i shes pa sngon du gtong ba zab pa yin zhes/ zer ba ltar byas pa'i khul yin no// da ni dkyus nyid 'chad par byed de/ kho bo cag gi rus ni 'gru ste/ mi'u gdung drug gi ya gyal yin la/ 'di ni yig cha rnying pa rnams su 'gru zhes pa bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu zhes 'byung la| dgongs pa yang zab tu/ slob dpon chen pos ni/ rje'u rigs ratna'i ming dang phrad nas kyang*/ zhes gsungs/ gang ltar yang rus de nyid las bye brag tu rigs ni gnam nas bskyur bas skyu ra zhes grags pa dag gi gdung las/ yab chos rgyal phun tshogs bkra shis dpal bzang po zhes pa slob dpon padmas gter lung du mar lung bstan pa de nyid dang*/ yum ni lho kong byang kong gnyis su grags pa'i byang kong da lta long por grags pa'i sde dpon de nyid kyi sras mo a ce g.yang khug ces grags pa/ las ldan rnams kyis rna ltag tu phag zhal yod pa dang phag gi ngur sgra 'byin pa thos pa sogs lo rgyus mang po yod pa de nyid kyi khab tu byung la/ de yang sngon yul dam pa la ngag 'chal zhig smras pa'i rnam smin gyis bud med kyi lus shig len dgos yod pa las ngan phyi thebs su bzhag kyang dgos pa med cing*/

rang gi las bdag gir bgyi ba'i slad du sras mo chung ngu zhig tu bsam bzhin du skyes/ de nyid kyi ma g.yar kha ru la nas dpon gyi chung ma a ce dbon mo zer ba zhig gis byas te/ lo gnyis tsam song ba'i tshe bsam par/ lus 'di ni myong 'gyur da lta smin pa'i ched du blangs pa yin gyi/ 'dis rang gzhan gyi don gang yang mi 'grub pas da ni 'phos te slar srid pa 'dzin no bsam pa'i rgyu byas/ a ce dbon mos rgyab tu khur te rtse ba'i mchod khang dang*/ zhal la ser mo'i bar gyi skas thung gi mgor cung zad stod du bsigs pas ya them la mgo brdabs pa'i thig gis rkyen byas te 'phos nas/ zla khongs las ma 'gyang bar slar rigs de nyid du nying mtshams sbyar bas ma'i khog tu gnas pa'i tshe zla ba gsum tsam nas rang gi bde sdug gi tshor ba shin tu gsal ba byung*/ zla ba lnga drug nas yum gyis gzhan la tshig gsung ba dang*/ gzhan gyis yum la zhu ba gsol ba sogs kyi tshig don go zhing yin min sogs brtag dpyad rnams zhib tu thub par 'dug /de nas zla grangs legs par thems pa shing lug lo'i rgyal gyi zla ba'i dmar po'i phyogs la rtse ba'i ka bzhi'i phug tu skyes 'dug /de phyin tshang mal du gnas pa'i tshe yang lus kyi 'gro mi pher ba tsam las sems la thams cad bkra zhing gsal bar byung*/ de nas cung zad 'gro bar brtsam pa'i tshe gog po mi sgur ba dang*/ gnyid tshe mig mi btsum pa sogs skyu ra'i rtags rnams tshang bar byung 'dug /de'i tshe rnams su phal cher mnyam bzhag la 'bad pas/ yab yum dang nye 'khor rnams kyis chos rje i tsu khu ma sgom rgyab zer ba'i tshe skyengs pa'i snang ba byung*/ de dus thams cad du rtse grogs gzhan mi dgos par bud med bzhin bzang gos rgyan shin tu mdzes pa zhig gis rtse grogs dang*/ rang gang bsam thams cad smra mi dgos par de rnams kyis byed/ skya ser gzhan nye skor du byung na de rnams mi snang bar gyur pas ngu ba zhig yod/

skabs zhig na nad tshabs che ba zhig gis thebs te/ sman pas bcos kyang bde bskyed ma byung ba'i tshe/ yab chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung gis 'o cag dkon mchog skyabs yin pas/ de ring chos rje 'di yang dkon mchog la skyabs gsol/ sngon chad sgor 'don ma myong bas gong po nyag tu khyer gsungs par zhabs 'bring rnams kyis de ltar gnang na thal song ches pas mi 'thad zhus par/ 'di nga la bsam bzhin du 'ongs pa'i bu zhig yin pas shi mi 'gro zhes gsung drang po dang*/ 'on te shi na yang bya thabs ci yod ces gsung brlang po'i tshul dang bcas te/ zhang po long po sde pa karma dar rgyas kyis pang du bdag khyer nas phebs/ gza' skar dge ba'i snga dro gong po nyag tu lha bsang gsol mchod dgyes dgu'i rnam rol du ma dang bcas bdag gi skra bcad cing dge bsnyen yongs rdzogs kyi bka' drin stsal ba'i ming dkon mchog phun tshogs zhes btags/ dam pa rnams nas chos nod pa'i thog ma 'di nyid yin pas lam 'jug pa'i rim pa go ma log par go// de nyin nas nad kyi 'tshe ba rtsad nas dwangs/ slar nyi mal tshal du dbyar dus kyi thugs spro dang sbrags te gsol ru rnams bsgril ba'i khrod du phebs/ sbra kha rnams kyis bsnyen bkur blo'i yul las 'das pas mchod cing*/ bdag gi rim 'gror tshe thar brgya rtsa gtong ba sogs mdzad/ gzhan yang byis pa'i dus der skyes pa dang bud med chas bzang mang pos bro gar dang glu gzhas tshad med pas dga' ba byed pa dang*/ skyes pa dang bud med dur khrod kyi chas gos gyon pa mang pos sngags kyi glu len pa dang rdo rje'i gar sngon chad thos mthong med pa mang pos bdag dga' bar byed pa ni grangs las 'das/ dus shig gi tshe ka bzhi'i steng gi nyi 'od du yab chos kyi rgyal po bzhugs pa'i sku pang du bdag gis mgo bzhag phyi gan du bsdad pa'i tshe gong po nyag gi thad nas 'od zer tshad med pa sna tshogs 'khrugs pa'i zlum po'i nang du 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa gsal la rdzogs pa zhig nyi ma ltar mkha' lam du byung ba/

bdag gis chos kyi rgyal po'i mgul la 'khyud nas ya ki bdag la da lta nyid du dgos zhes zhus pas/ gsung chen pos bzhad cing ya ki khyod rang la gdod nas yod pa yin/ 'on kyang khyod la 'gyang med du sbyin/ da lta gar 'dug gsungs par bltas pas gar yang mi 'dug /yang rtse ba'i tshoms su rtsed mo byed skabs/ bud med rgyan gos dkar po bgos pa zhig gis lag tu rin po che'i prog zhu zhig ster ba'i tshul byed 'dug pa/ de dgong chos kyi rgyal po la zhus pas de gter sgrom gyi sman mo yin 'dug pa/ da nangs nga'i rtsar yang byung gsungs shing bdag cag der 'khod rnams la chos kyi rgyal po nyid sku na phra ba'i tshe dag pa'i snang ba byung tshul 'ga' zhig gsungs| de nas rang lo lnga pa phag lo gsar pa'i dge mtshan gyi dga' ston ka bzhi'i steng gi nyi 'od du gnang zhing srod la bro gar glu gzhas sogs rdzogs ldan gyi skye dgu rnams la 'khu ba tsam mdzad pa'i dus/ bdag chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs pus la brten nas bsdad pa'i mdun mkhar drang srong chen po rā hu la gzi brjid bzod par dka' ba zhig mthong ba ji ltar yin snyam/ chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal dkyil la mjal bas/ spyan sdang mig drang srong la gzigs shing*/ khyod slob dpon padma'i bka' ltar bstan pa mi srung bar lto phyir rang rgyu ba ngo mi tsha'am thu thu zhes ljags chab cig gnang song bas 'ja' yal ba ltar song ba'i mod/ bdag la nged 'dir yong ba gtor bsdos phyis pa snyog tu 'ong ba yin 'dug ces gsungs/ der tshogs phal cher gyis nam mkha'i dbyings su me rgyug pa mthong 'dug /skabs shig zhal ngo rnams la sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe dbang brgya rtsa zhig gzims chung rab gsal du gnang ba'i dus/ dgong re bzhin tshe chang ka pā la'i steng du tshe dpag med mngon rtogs dang mthun pa mtheb sor gang ba zhig spyan bdag nyid la gzigs shing 'dzum mdangs mdzad pa dang*/

nub tha ma'i dgong chos kyi rgyal po'i sku mi snang bar 'od gong dmar po 'od phreng 'phro zhing 'bar ba zhig mjal/ de nas dpon sa g.yang khug dang bla ma rin po che sangs rgyas rin chen pas gsol ba btab cing*| gtso bor sde gzar snga phyi'i sgrib sbyong la dgongs nas sa pho byi ba lo'i dgun gyi ring bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa mnga' bdag nyang gi gter kha/ de yang deng sang gi bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa yin zer ba'i sna tshogs spu tshogs bsdus pa'i glegs bam bongs che zhing grangs mang ba nyid la mchor chas byed pa'i lugs ltar ma yin par/ bde gshegs 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa slob dpon padma/ shrī singha/ nam mkha'i snying po/ bai ro tsa na dang*/ lo paṇa bzhis mdzad pa'i nang du bde gshegs 'dus pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs lnga tshan lnga tshan du mdzad pa chos tshan brgya dang sum cu rtsa lnga po'i lung rnams rdzogs par gnang*/ sgrub chen gnang ba'i nyer bsdogs su rgyal dbang ratna'i zhabs zin bla ma sgru pa sku skye zer ba zhig sgru'i ri brag du bzhugs pa rtse bar spyan drangs/ grwa tshang ba rnams la 'cham slob pa'i tshe brtson 'grus kyis rtse'i mchod khang du bdag khur bzhin par bla ma des rnga 'cham nan ltar bslabs pas bdag la 'jags nas shin tu byang ba byung*/ de'i dbyar de nyid kyi bzhugs khri byang gzigs 'di'i thad du gur chen khams gsum zil gnon phub ste/ phyogs mtha'i dbang zhu ba byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal yab sras gsum la sogs pa'i che dgu grangs las 'das pa dang rang re'i dgon sde so so'i bla ma grwa rigs dpon skya mi dmangs sogs grangs las 'das pa tshogs pa la/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor pho brang chen po nyi ma dgu shar rdul tshon las grub pa gza' skar bzang por dbu btsugs nas/ dbang sgrub sbrags pa dang sman sgrub sogs rgyal dbang ratna'i phyag bzhes gtsang ma ji lta ba'i pha 'bab bzang pos snod ldan mched lcam de dag tshim par mdzad pa'i tshe/

nyi ma kha shas su rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor med par gzhal yas khang 'ja' tshon lta bu'i nang du zhi khro bdun brgya nyer lnga ma 'dres gsal rdzogs su snang ba dang*/ skabs la lar rdul tshon gyi bar snang la dkyil 'khor nyi ma dgu shar 'ja' ltar bkra ba dang*/ steng du tshangs pa'i dmu thag la lha dang lha mo mang po rol mo thogs pa'i khrod du bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mang po gar mdzad cing byon pa dang*/ nyin gcig dad ldan rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor dbu zhwa padma kha 'bus dang phod ka khrom zil gnon sogs rgyal dbang ratna'i sku chas rnams rdzogs par bzhes te/ dbang bskur mdzad pa'i nyin thog mtha' thams cad du chos kyi rgyal po'i sku'i snang ba ye med par rig 'dzin chen po rdo rje chos mngon sum du mthong zhing de nyid kho na yin pa'i snang ba rbad chod kyis dus 'da' ba byung*/ sgrub chen gyi thog mtha' bar gsum du rnga 'cham/ brub 'cham zor sogs gong ma'i phyag len ltar mdzad pa'i zor 'cham la chos kyi rgyal po nyid phebs pa'i tshe zhabs zung sa la ma reg par 'cham pa sogs mdzad/ nyin re bzhin chos kyi rgyal po dbang 'grem par phebs pa'i tshe bla ma rin po che sangs rgyas rin chen pas bdag sku pang du bsnams nas chos kyi rgyal po'i bzhugs khri'i steng du bskyal nas/ bu'i gdan khar pha sdod pa babs thob yin gsungs pa sogs sngon gyi skyes rabs la dgongs nas mdzad par snang*/ gzhan yang sgrub chen de'i ring lha dang bla ma mjal ba sogs mtha' yas pa byung yang phal cher ni rang blo 'khrul pas bsgribs nas brjed song ba mang 'dug /dkyil 'khor chen por me tog dor ba'i nyin bdag gi me tog de sngar ma mthong ba'i me tog kha dog sna tshogs pa bkra ba'i phreng ba zhig du gyur nas/ dkyil 'khor dbus su bde 'dus 'bring po gsal la rdzogs pa 'ja' tshon ltar bzhugs 'dug pa'i mgul du 'khril song ba zhig mthong*/

gsang mtshan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal zhes gnang*/ sman khang du lha mo mang po gar byed sdags kyi glu len pa dang*/ 'od dang du ba dang sgra la sogs pa dus rtag tu mthong ba sogs kyang byung*/ nyin re bzhin lha dang mkha' 'gro sde brgyad 'jigs rngam can mang po yang chos gral gyi gseb rnams su 'dug pa mthong tshul sogs chos kyi rgyal por zhus pas/ nga la de 'dra ba'i chos nyan pa ci la 'ong lkug pa khyod rang mig 'khrul ba yin mod ces khengs pa bskyungs te gsungs/ dus de nas bzung bdag la lkug pa kho na gsung ba zhig yod do// e ma/ rdul tshon sprul pa'i 'khor lor ston nus shing*// lha dang mkha' 'gro dregs pa'i 'khor 'du ba'i// dam pa 'di ni snyigs ma'i padma 'byung*| |nges par min nam 'on te ras bris la// brten cing dpe klog byed tshe yi ge yang*// shar gyis mi klog lha dang dregs pa yi// 'khor tshogs lta zhog shes ldan kun khrel ba'i// deng sang rig 'dzin ru lu ru lu phaṭ/ gzhan yang mchod khang rtser bde mchog sga lo lha lnga'i dbang bskur zhus pa'i tshe chos kyi rgyal po he ru kar 'dug pas bdag gi bsam par/ de ring bzhugs khri'i khar lha sku zhig bzhag 'dug chos kyi rgyal po gar phebs sam snyam pa'i tshe chos kyi rgyal po nyid du bstan nas shig tsam bzhad rjes lkug pa tsho grung mdog byed sa min/ kha rog par dbang zhus gsung dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad kyin 'dug /yang loka tri'i dbang zhus pa'i tshe bzhugs gdan khar drang srong dri med yin 'dug pa zhig mthong bar bdag chung bas drang srong yin pa ma shes par/ de ring bzhugs khrir rgan po mgo dkar kha spu can gcer bu 'di su yin snyam pa'i tshe/ dbang grol nas chos kyi rgyal pos bdag gi mgo la phyag thal mos reg cing lkug pa 'dis de ring rgan po gcig la yang dbang zhus ang zhes gsungs so// gzhan yang chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du lnga ldan gyi khrid dang*/

yang zab zhi khro'i dbang sogs dam pa'i chos kyi bgo skal 'ga' zhig thob pa ni thob yig tu gsal/ de nas lcags mo glang lor rdzong gsar bkra shis tshugs rmang bting ba'i tshe/ sde dgon thugs 'dod cung zad ma mnyam pa'i zang zing mang du byung bar blo ma bde yang bya thabs ni ma rnyed/ de'i phyi lo chu stag lor yang ri sgar pa bla ma mgar sprul skus dbu mdzad khams nas 'khor zhing 'bul nod tshad las 'das pa phul/ rtse ba'i bzhugs khri byang gzigs 'di'i steng nas rgyal dbang kun dga'i bka' 'bum rnams kyi ljags lung gnang skabs/ dgong re ljags lung grol ba'i tshe skya ser thams cad chos kyi rgyal po chos khri'i khar bzhugs pa la skor ba byed pa'i khrod du bdag kyang brtson 'grus kyis khur nas skor ba byed pa'i skabs shig /chab mdo rje drung bstan pa rgya mtshos phul ba'i mu tig gi phreng ba mdzub mo'i mgo las mi chung ba'i ya mtshan can gyi phyag phreng de phyag tu bzhes 'dug pa phud cing nyis skor du bdag gi ske la g.yogs nas/ lkug pa rang gis gyon ma 'gyang bar dgos pa khyad par can 'ong ba yin gsungs pa ni/ phyis mya ngan las 'das pa'i sku gdung gi phra la bdag gis 'bul ba sogs mngon par mkhyen pa yin 'dug /lar nged rang chung ba'i ring rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po nyid la gzhan gyi sku grib sogs byung tshe chos rje chung ba'i chus khrus gsung bdag gi dri chus sku khrus mdzad/ rtse bar nam bzhugs pa'i ring nub re gzims mal du phebs khar bdag phyag khyor du bsnams nas dbu steng du 'jog pa sogs mdzad/ bdag gis kyang rje chos kyi rgyal po'i gral mgor sdod pa dang yab la chos rje dang gdung brgyud ces 'bod pa zhig yod/ de nas stag lo zla ba bdun pa nas rdzong gsar du sku khams bsnyun pa'i tshul bstan/ slar do lir spyan drangs rtse ba'i mchod khang rtser bzhugs yul phab| bsnyun pa ni tshabs che bar yod/

kong po chos mdzad o rgyan yang bsnyun g.yog pa'i gral yin pas nyin re bzhin khong rang btang nas sku zhabs su shog gsungs/ phyin pas skabs 'ga' zhig tu sku rtsed gsungs/ skabs la lar chos kyi 'brel ba mang po gsungs/ phal cher ni spyan nam mkhar lta stangs dang phyag se gol kho na mdzad/ de gong sku zhabs su dzo ki gzhon nu stod sgur yod pa ming la tha ra pu rir 'bod pa zhig yod pa/ bdag la yang ze sgur yod pas de dang 'dra bar ming yang de ltar gsung ba zhig yod pas/ sku bsnyun ba'i ring res 'ga' chos rje/ res 'ga' lkug pa/ res 'ga' tha ra pu ri zhes 'bod pa gnang zhing 'phral yun gyi bslab bya lhug par stsal bas/ bdag gis kyang sku mi 'tsho bar thag chod par byung*/ nyer bdun gyi snga dro zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa nas bzung*/ pur ma sbyangs bar nyin re bzhin sku gdung yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i drung du yan lag bdun pa re phul nas/ rang gzhan phyogs med kyi don gnyis 'grub pa'i smon lam kha zhe med pa bsam rgyud dang 'dre nges shes pa re byas pas/ bsam na tshe 'di'i bya ba byas pa'i nang nas de nyid don che bar 'dug bsam sems dga' yel le ba rtag tu byung ngo*// blo bde ru lu ru lu ang*/ de nas gsang khog tu thang 'gyed gral gtsor stag lung zhabs drung kun dga' bkra shis phebs kyang ngos kyis mjal ba ma byung*/ dgongs rdzogs chog mang gral dbur rje zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa drug pa phebs nas bzhugs yul 'tsho byed 'brug dkon mchog tshang 'dir gnang*/ sgar dmangs kyang mtsher so sor btab/ bdag kyang gzims chung du mjal bar phyin/ rje zhwa dmar ba dang mjal ba'i thog ma 'di yin/ de nas bzung nyin re bzhin sku zhabs su shog gsungs nas phyin/ thugs shin tu dgyes pa kho na mdzad/ nged rang na so phra zhing yab chos kyi rgyal po 'dra ba'i dam pa bsten pas dam pa gzhan la mig ma phab pa 'dra bas sku rtsed la snyad pa kha yar zhus pas/

deng sang 'bri gung pa'i khrod na khyod las gyong ba mi 'dug pas/ 'bri gung pa'i rwa co yin pas ming 'bri rwar thogs gsungs sku rtsed gnang bas/ skabs der sku rtsed ltar snang yang nges don du rten 'brel bzang po'i sgo 'du mdzad par go// de nas dgongs rdzogs chog mang mtshe'u khar gnang ba grub nas slar rtse bar phebs skabs shig zu re brag dkar gyi gnas gzigs la phebs/ bdag kyang phyag phyir 'gro gsungs pas phyin/ lha lung ngur bzhugs zhag gcig gnang ba'i phyi nangs dad 'dus thams cad kyis tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad pa'i gral du brag dkar gyi gnas bstod cig gsung rtsom gnang ba'i tshe/ bdag la rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes ming 'dogs par mdzad/ slar rtse bar phebs nas ka drug 'dir khyab bdag dus kyi 'khor lo 'bro 'gyur gyi byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun/ mchog dbang gong ma dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang sogs rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa mdzad/ rje zhwa dmar ba'i drung du chos kyi bdud rtsi 'thung ba'i snga ma 'di yin/ de rjes bzhugs khri byang gzigs 'di'i steng nas skya ser mang bar phag mo dmar chung gi dbang zhig gnang ba zhus/ de nas rje zhwa dmar ba yangs pa can brgyud gtsang phyogs su phebs/ rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen rnam 'joms phun tshogs yang ri sgar pa rags bsdus dang bcas khams stod du dngul gdung gi 'bul sdud la phebs/ bla ma rin po che sangs rgyas rin chen pas dngul gdung gi thig rtsa zhal bkod dang*/ gdung g.yog gi gtso bor mchod khang rtser bzhugs pa la/ zhabs drung spro lung gi bde gshegs dang*/ bdag dpon g.yog lhan cig rje mi la'i mgur 'bum mdzod nag ma/ dwags po'i bka' 'bum/ phag gru'i bka' 'bum/ rgyal sras thogs med pa'i bka' 'bum/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum sogs bklag lung mang du zhus/ bla ma dam pa 'di pa'i gsung gis bskul/

dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal ba'i bstan bcos gsang sngags spyi don bzung*/ slob gnyer byed pa'i thog mar 'di yin/ de zin nas rang lugs kyi bskang gsol rnams bzung ba'i tshe/ bde mchog lhan skyes thengs 'ga' mjal/ nangs shig mgon po'i bstod chen byang shar nags 'dab ma gshar ba'i tshe/ de'i tshig tu gang yod kyi lha gtso 'khor thams cad yun ring po'i bar du mjal bas gtso 'khor mang zhing bya gcan sogs zang zing shin tu mang po 'dug pa nyams mtshar che bas nyin re bzhin de nyid kho na yid la 'char ba zhig byung*/ a phyi'i phrin las myur mgyogs bzung ba'i tshe nangs shig mdun mkhar bstan srung ma zhabs thang mkha' 'gro bzhi dang bcas pa byon/ gtso mos shel dkar gyi phreng ba zhig bdag gi ske la g.yogs byung bas dga' drag bka' drin che zhes zhus| zhing skyong dpa' bo rnam rol gshar ba'i tshe nangs shig zhing skyong yab yum 'khor bcas dang*/ dgong zhig yum si na ra ma spre'u gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa'i spre'u de gnyis kyis gar 'cham gya ma do mang po byed pa zhig mthong bas phyi nangs ka bzhir spre'u'i lad mo ltar 'khrab pas/ yum gyis chos rje'i 'cham de 'dra sus bslabs gsungs par/ nga rang byis pa'i nyams kyis lags spre'us bslabs zhes zhus par thams cad kyis mtshar mo mdzad pa 'dug /bka' srung smug nag lcam dral ha ra gza' me rlung 'khyil pa rtsi dmar ba'i bskang gsol sogs ni sngar gyi bag chags kyis blo la byang bar 'dug pas ched du ma bslabs/ de'i gong chos kyi rgyal po 'phan yul mkhar rtser phebs pa'i skabs shig yar rgyab dpon chen 'das pa'i byang zhus rten gos chas ja gos dar rin po che'i rigs sogs dpag tu med pa phul byung ba chos kyi rgyal po mkhar rtser bzhugs gshis ming yig phul/ byang rten rnams yum gyi phyag tu tshags gnang ba'i khrod du rgyab gri chung ngu shub khra mdzes po zhig 'dug pa bdag la gnang byung ba skye ba snga ma nas gsog 'jog dang ser sna la goms ches pas/

gri chung de la rtsis che che ltar byas pa'i len pa 'dra bas ring zhig lon nas/ skabs shig rmi lam du nged rang rdzong gi g.yon ngos nga rang gis chu mig bton pa'i lung pa de 'dra ba zhig gi mdor rtse zhing 'dug pa'i skabs| thag ring zhig nas sgra mi snyan pa ha ha hi hi sogs bsgrags byung bar bltas pas/ dom gad kyi thad tsam yin pa 'dra ba zhig nas ro langs thal mdog bongs thog so bcu tsam yod pa lto ba 'phyang zhing yan lag rags pa sha rgyas pa skra kham ser gyen du 'bar ba lag pas sbar mo gdengs shing brgyugs nas bdag ngos su 'ong 'dug par/ yid snang la yar rgyab dpon chen gyi ro langs yin zhing bdag gi gri chung gi ra mdar yin 'dug /ci mgyogs bros pa drag go snyam 'bad pas bros shing bltas pa dang ro langs sbrang mda' tsam du 'byor nas drag tu rgyug 'dug pa bdag gis gos kyi thu ba brdzes nas gyen la 'dzegs par dbugs rtseg cing ngal ba'i tshe/ ro langs ni ra sogs lcags thon nas cher rgyug cing ha ha hi hi hu hu ngas khyod btang ngo*// za yi 'thung gi gsod kyi zer ngar skad 'byin cing rkang pa rgyug 'dral/ lag pa rol stabs/ mgo bo sprug cing byung bas/ bdag shin tu bred cing gyen la 'dzegs pas/ 'gro bar mi nus pa tsam la thug pa'i tshe/ lung chung de'i dbus su brag de'u chen po zhig 'dug pa'i rtsa bar slebs/ ro langs ni rwa sog gdong du 'byor byung ba'i tshe/ bar snang nas oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ ces pa'i sgra sa sbir thub pa zhig byung bas mar la bltas pas ro langs de khum khum chum chum nyam chung ba ltar phyi 'then phyi 'gros su 'gro 'dug /yar bltas pas de'u de'i rtser mi sngo nag 'jigs su rung ba/ thod skam lnga bcings shing ral pa thor tshugs/ mi mgo'i phreng ba rnams chu rdza che shos tsam pa la la mig hrig hrig la la kha nas khrag 'dzag /'ga' zhig kha gdangs lce bskyod pa sogs 'jigs pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma byed pa/

stag sham bsnams shing zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon skum/ phyag g.yas rdo rje nag po rwa rnam par gdengs pa nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon dril bu nag po dku la brten pa/ gar stabs shigs shigs 'jigs rngam du ma dang ldan pa zhig bzhugs 'dug /de 'phral gnyid sad pa'i phyi nangs tshul de nyid bla ma rin po che sangs rgyas rin chen la zhus pas/ ha'i ya 'jigs rang 'jigs khyod ro langs kyi gdon gyis bar gcod rtsom par chas 'dug pa de 'khor lo sdom pas bskyabs par 'dug /da phyin bde mchog bsnyen na sgrub mi dgos par grub pa lta bu 'byung ngo gsungs pas/ de nyin nas bstod pa khrag rgyam ma dang yig bdun ci 'grub re bzla bar dam bcas/ de nas ha cang ma 'gyang bar nub cig rmi lam du yul ljongs slebs ma myong ba'i nags tshal dang sman ljongs rdzing bu la sogs pa yid las 'das pa'i bkod pa lha gnas kyang zil gyis gnon nus pa zhig tu lha dang lha mo mang po glu gar byed kyin 'dug pa'i khrod du bdag kyang slebs pas/ byis pa'i rgyu langs pas 'khrabs shing de rnams kyi glu'i lad mo shes pas dar cig song ba'i mod mig yengs pa 'dra zhig la/ yul ljongs skyid po de ni dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba 'dre srin ma rungs pa dang ro langs rnams gar dang rgyug 'dral byed pa/ gcan gzan gdug pa can dang dur bya la sogs mi sdug pa'i sgra 'byin cing 'phyo ba/ ro skam rlon bam rul bsregs pa dang 'thor ba dang gsal shing la 'phyang ba sogs 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba zhig gi dbus su/ dur khrod kyi gzhal med khang chen po'i nang du glu gar dang rol mo mang po byed kyin 'dug pa thos pas/ 'di na su yod pa yin snyam pa'i tshe sgo rtsa der bud med khwa ta'i mgo yod pa zhig don byung nas bdag la mdzub mos shog cig pa'i brda byas byung bar nang du phyin pas/ sngar de'u steng gi he ru ka de dbus su langs/

de 'dra ba mang po dang bud med khro 'dzum can mang po gcig la gcig 'khyud cing rol/ ngag tu ma hā su kha su khaṃ nirta sya la mi ta zhes sogs tshig don go rgyu med pa mang po 'then/ lus kyi gar stabs 'jigs rngam gyi tshul mang po byed 'dug /dar cig song nas gtso bo de he ru ka nag po thor tshugs can thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang mgo rlon gyi do shal mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs/ stag gi sham thabs can/ g.yas rdo rje g.yon dril bu dang bcas pas thod khrag thogs pa/ ro gdan la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa de la skyes pa bud med he ru ka'i chas byas pa 'ba' zhig gis bskor zhing tshogs 'dug pa'i khrod du bdag kyang slebs/ tshogs 'khor bzang po zhig byas pa'i mod/ gtso bos bdag mdun du bzhag /thog mar rdor dril mgo bor bzhag |de rjes thod pa'i khrag khar blugs byung ba 'thung bas dri ro brjod las 'das pa zhig 'dug /de nas phyag zhabs gnyis ka mgo bor bzhag /'khor lo sdom pa'i sngags rnams tshar gcig gsungs/ mthar gtso 'khor thams cad kyis rkang brgyad gnyis la snyan pa'i gdangs dang bcas gsungs/ de rjes phyag gis song zhig pa'i brda byung bas sgo nas phyir rgyang tsam phyin/ phyi mig bltas pas gar song mi 'dug /phyis bsam par rgyal dbang ratna'i thugs dam gyi gtso bo 'khor lo sdom par mdzad 'dug pa sogs kyi rgyu byas/ ro langs kyis ded pas rkyen byas te brag de'u'i steng du 'khor lo sdom pa'i zhal bstan/ skabs 'dir sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba yin nges shes pa'i gdeng tshad thob/ de phyin nas mig btsum ma thag 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku che chung ji ltar yang gsal la rdzogs pa re da lta'i bar du byung ngo*// kye ma/ smon lam rgyu mthun dag pa dang*// las kyi 'phen pa sogs dag pas| |skal dman ngas kyang sdom pa yi// sprul pa'i dbang nod blo bde dpal// skabs shig la mdun thang du o rong ba dang 'thab pas cung zad 'thab nyes byung bar brten rgyal dbang ratna'i zhabs zin bla ma mtha' yas phun tshogs zer ba gshin rje la mkhas pa zhig mal gro'i dgon pa zhig na bzhugs pa gdan drangs/

gshin rje'i sgrub pa zla ba gnyis bstud mar snga ma rtse ba'i mchod khang dang phyi ma ka drug tu mdzad pas sgra skad thon pa'i rtags byung*/ bla ma der yang zlog gi ngag 'don sogs 'don cha'i dbyangs rnams khrid cing nges par byas/ de nas skabs shig bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig rtse ba'i tshoms sku gdung rin po che'i sku gzhogs su bla ma rin po che sangs rgyas rin chen pas bkas bskul/ yang ri sgar pa'i tshogs la byas pa'i tshe bla ma gsar par song ba'i chos bshad ma 'grim dogs rig pa sgrim blo byas nas bshad pas skyon med tsam byung*/ gzhan la chos bshad pa'i snga shos 'di ka yin/ de nas thog ma nas yi ge klog pa re byang zhing rang bzhin du shes pa byung yang 'bri gung mthil klog 'di ya mtshan che bar bsams/ gdan sa chen po 'bri gung mthil gyi slob dpon las thog pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho spyan drangs mthil klog rnams rim par nan tan du sbyangs/ de'i tshe yang ri sgar pa rtsa brgyad sgang du bzhugs shing sgar gyi bla ma mgar sprul sku yin pas khong pas bdag la rgya nag gi sgam bu ye pha'u dang zi pha'u phebs byam la sogs pa byis par mkho ba'i yo byad dang*/ bum pa chung ngu sogs byin nas klog rem par slobs shig /ji ltar byang ba tsam gyi bdag gis dngos spyad 'di 'dra ba 'bul lo zhes kyang gsungs pas sems khrid/ klog shin tu byang bar byas pa'i bla ma de bdag la drin che bar byung*/ skabs shig sku rim gtor zlog gnang ba'i gser skyems sgo dbye'i 'cham byas par thams cad kyis 'cham dar 'dogs pa sogs byas/ 'cham byed pa'i thog ma 'di yin/ de nas rdo rje 'chang mkhan po yang khams nas phebs/ gser dngul rta nor sogs grangs las 'das pa phul/ dngul gdung rin po che dbyen bsdum pa'i mchod rten yang 'grub tu nye/ 'di'i gong tsam nas thab chen rtse ba nas rdzong du bsgril grub pa yin yang rags bsdus rtse bar phebs/

chos kyi rgyal po'i sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu rgyas pa'i slad du rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen pas rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba mdzad nas 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs phul/ thugs gsum dang ljags spyan ring bsrel yig 'bru dbu skra me thub sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rten kho nar byon pa'i thugs gcig dang gdung rus sbar mo gang bcas mthil du spyan drangs/ dngul gdung grub cing thog mar mtshungs med chos kyi rje nā ro pas rab gnas mdzad/ nged cag rdzong du bsdad/ de rjes skabs 'ga' zhig tu rgyal dbang ratna'i bka' 'bum sogs dbang lung mang po stsal/ skabs shig 'brug dkon mchog gi nang 'dir rje nā ro pa'i drung du yang zab kyi dbang bskur yongs rdzogs chab mdo rje drung gis zhus pa dang lhan cig tu thob pa'i tshe/ nyin re bzhin slob dpon padma'i drung du bar khang g.yu zhal du dgongs pa yang zab bka' bab gtad rgya dang bcas pa nod pa'i dran snang sha stag byung*/ de nas rje zhwa dmar ba dngul gdung rab gnas la mthil du phebs/ bdag zhabs phyir 'brangs/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i chos kyi seng ge'i khri chen po'i steng nas/ mthil tshogs chen la lda ldan gyi khrid bshad stsal ba mnos/ da res de tsam las rje zhwa dmar ba'i drung du dbang chos thob pa ma dran/ slar rdzong du bsdad cing skabs shig nye skor thams cad du 'brum pa'i 'tshe ba mang rabs shig byung ba'i tshe/ rtse bar thab chen bsgril rje nā ro pa sku 'brum sngar nas bzhes zin pas mdun sa dang sngo mdog tshang du bzhugs/ bdag cag ming sring rnams gzhis kar bsdad/ de skabs bde mchog gi mtshams khog nas dgongs gcig rdor she ma sne gdong par gyi steng nas tshoms bdun gsung bzhi bcu pa sogs gsal byed dang rnam thar min shos nag 'dzin byas/ slar rdzong du slebs/ chos kyi rgyal po'i grwa pa dge slong phun tshogs tshe ring zer ba zhig yod par dus 'khor gyi thig ring dang man ngag thig

/bka' brgyad sogs gsar rnying gi dkyil 'khor mtha' dag /mdor na mnga' dbul ri rab kyi thig dang padma'i bcud thig las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi thab khung sogs thig rtsa ma lus pa sbyangs shing*/ de dag gi dgun dus rnams su rdul tshon bri ba'i rim pa shin tu bzo zhing byang bar bslabs pas/ phyis na so phra zhing mig dang lag pa bde ba'i tshe ja zhal che chung 'tsham pa re'i zhabs ra tsam gyi kha rgyar dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs rdul tshon gyis bris pa so sor bkra zhing gsal la dag pa dang*/ rdul tshon bris pa dang*/ lha bzo mkhas pa'i dkyil thang dang bsdur na rdul tshon gyi brgya'i char yang ras bris kyis mi slebs pa de 'dra mang po bri myong*/ da lta'i ban rgan skra dkar so bud mig dang rna ba nyams/ langs re med pa 'di 'dra rang zhig sngar med pa yin/ da lta'i gzhon pa kun kyang na so gzhon ring yon tan gang dgos bslab pa rang drag pa 'dug go// yang mi slob kyang nga la ni khyad mi 'dug ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ gzhan yang bstan snying gi legs bshad lung gi rgya mtsho/ dwags po'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po'i thar rgyan sogs 'ga' zhig bzung*/ skabs shig bar snang khams su me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du lha mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug dur khrod dang dpal chas gyon pa phyag g.yas pa gsum 'khor lo rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon dang po lcags kyu tha ma sdigs mdzub la bar ma de shing bu sked nyag 'dra ba zhig bsnams 'dug pa rje nā ro par zhus pas/ bzhad gad cher mdzad phyag brdabs/ lha de gshin rje tshe bdag yin/ g.yon gyi phyag mtshan bar ma de la gtun shing zer ba yin/ tshe rabs sngon nas 'brel che ba zhig yin 'dug gsungs/ re zhig grib cham la brten khams ma bde ba zhig byung bar grib mdos dang glud btang ba'i dgong*/ rta dmar zag mgo med pa zhig la ban gzugs mi sdug pa zhig zhon/ 'khor ma rungs pa du mas bskor ba zhig

/chos skyong rtsi dmar ba khrab rmog gyon rta sngon po zhon mdung zhags 'khyer 'khor rta pa mang po dang bcas pas phyir ded nas song ba mthong tshe rje nā ro pa la zhus pas/ khyod khams ma bde ba'i nad bdag 'gong po zhig 'dug pa mdos glud blangs nas 'gro ba ded mi nged rang gi a khu bar 'dug /a khu ba 'di yang nged rang tshor mkho mo zhig yin gsungs/ de dgong yang khro bo mi g.yo ba ral gri gdengs shing hūm̐ sgra 'byin pa dang*/ sngags 'chang phod kha mthing nag zhwa theb nag po gyon pas gdon ngos su phur pas bsgril zhing dmod pa byed pa mthong ba nas bzung rgyal 'gong de'i gnod pa ye nas ma byung*/ de nas skabs shig yang ri sgar pa'i mtshams grwa brje len gyi steng zhabs drung spro lung bde bar gshegs pa de nyid kyis yang zab zhi khro'i dbang phreng gnang ba mnos/ nga rang gi g.yar khral du gu ru zhi ba'i dbang zhig bgyis pa'i tshe me tog gi char dang 'ja' tshon mang po 'dug zer mi thams cad lab 'dug nga rang gis ni ma mthong*/ 'byung ba'i gshis la ci yang yong gi 'dug pas cha ma 'tshal/ brje len grub nas rtsa ba'i bla ma gnas lugs chos skur ngo sprod cing bde stong zung 'jug gi gdams pas yan lag bdun ldan gyi rol pa skad cig la ster bar mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen rnam 'joms phun tshogs de nyid kyis/ nangs re bzhin spro lung gi zhabs drung bde gshegs dang bdag dpon slob sogs la rdzong gi zur 'phyong shar du rgyab chos la rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs dang*/ gzhi khrid zab lam nā ro chos drug gi khrid gzhung rgyal dbang ratna'i gsung rtsom rin po che dbang gi rgyal po'i steng nas dmigs rkang rnams rgyas bshad bcas stsal cing*| gtum mo'i skabs su sngon 'gro lus sbyong*/ dngos gzhi bde drod kyi 'khrul 'khor sogs rang lugs gang yin rnams gzhan zer gyi rjes zlos dang*/

lugs mang po'i bsre bslad sogs ci yang med par nā ro zhabs kyi dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa rnams khrid du stsal/ 'khrul 'khor rnams gtso bor dam pa de nyid kyi phyag khrid dang*/ bskyar dgos pa rnams chos kyi rgyal po'i grwa rigs rtsa rlung gi rtsal 'byongs pa bla ma shākya rin chen pas nan tan du mdzad/ legs par bsgoms pas gtum mo la bde drod mi rtog pa so sor bogs thon pas rang yid ches shing gdeng thob pa byung*/ thob chos su ma bzhag par lo kha shas kyi ring 'khrul 'khor la shin tu byang par sbyangs/ de'i dgun rje nā ro pa'i zhabs drung du spro lung gi bde gshegs dang bcas mthil du phebs/ mgo'i zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nub/ ras 'bud kyi gral la bsdad pas dmigs rlung 'khrul 'khor yang ma byas par da lta dbyar dus zha thul gyon pa las kyang drod stobs che ba/ lus thams cad drod 'bar ba'i ngo bo bde nyams tshad las 'das shing*/ sems mi rtog pa nam mkha' 'dra ba la rje sa paṇa bzhed pa'i phyag rgya chen po de 'drar ma song ba'i nyams kyis mtshan 'da' ba byung*/ skabs shig rwa sog thang du yang ri sgar pa dang lhan cig rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen pa'i drung du zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi dbang lung stsal ba'i dbang dngos gzhi'i byin 'bebs la paṇḍi ta sogs dgos 'dug pa mthong ba'i rkyen gyis/ de nub mal sar nyal ba'i tshe gnyid dang mngon sum gnyis ka min pa 'dra zhig la paṇḍi ta snam sbyar gyon pa dang ras rdo tshos ma'i kanta gyon pa thams cad paṇa zhwa mnabs/ glegs bam khur/ lhung bzed dang gseg shang thogs pa dri zhim po bro ba bcu lhag tsam gyis gar sna tshogs pa bsgyur zhing*/ ngag tu thos grol gyi rtsa sngags la ā we sha btags pa sha stag 'dug pa nga rang la thag nye ba zhig la paṇḍi ta rnams gang nas byon/ dgos pa ci yin dris pas zangs mdog dpal ri nas 'ong*/ khyod la byin rlabs byed ces bod skad dang*/

ma hā gu ru padma rā dza ma hā a dzardza shikṣa paṇḍi ta nirmā ṇa hoḥzhes pa dang*/ gzhan mi go ba'i rgya skad ṭi pi ṭi mang po zer bas mtshan mo thal/ nam langs pa dang gar song cha med du thal/ slob dpon nus pa ldan pa dang*// slob ma dad gus 'phel ba dag /'dzoms na padma 'byung gnas kyi// dbang bskur dngos dang dka' ba min/ he he lags/ de nas rang lo bcu gcig par rje nā ro pa'i drung du gter kha gong 'og gnyis ka'i drang srong loka tri pā la'i chos skor rnams kyi dbang lung lag len dang bcas pa rdzogs pa'i bka' drin gyi pha 'bab bzang po mnos pa'i mod kho nar/ deng sang gi dbang lung thob pa rnams kyi lugs ltar yal bar ma bor bar ngag mtshams rgyun ring ba zhig bgyis pa'i ring la snyan ngag mkhan gyi lugs drang por 'khrul snang rang bzhin brjod pa/ bstod ra byas na phul byung gi rgyan te dag pa'i snang ba zer dgos/ don la lha rig 'dre rig tshad las 'das pa byung ba rnams ni dpe tshan logs su bris yod pa ltar yin/ dus kun tu rā hu la dngos dang me'i rnam pas rked pa la 'khyud pa/ nyer spyad kyi rdo dril ḍā ma ru dkar yol gyi nang sogs la 'phro zhing 'khyud pa ni nyin mtshan phal cher dus 'da' ba byung*/ de nas skabs shig rje zhwa dmar ba drug pa de nyid 'bri gung du spyan drangs rdzong gsar du phyag phebs shing*/ bdag sogs la sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis dang*/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs dam lnga tshan lnga sogs kyi dbang stsal/ rdzong du dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgo nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sa chog gi gar dang bcas pa/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgo nas rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas dbang gi sbyin sreg rnams mdzad/ gzims chung du phebs nas bdag la sku rtsed dang sbrags/ nga'i gar dang sbyin sreg sogs yag po e 'dug gsungs par/ ci lab tshad ma mchis pa gda' lags zhus pas/

khyod shes na bsam e byung gsungs par/ shes na bsam byung te mi shes pa gda' lags zhus pas/ bslab na shes yong ma bslab na mi shes ngas kyang bslabs pas shes pa yin gsungs/ de 'dra slob 'dod kyang phyogs 'dir de 'dra'i slob dpon med zhus pas/ 'o na re shig de 'dra tsho slob par nga'i zlar e 'gro gsungs par/ shin tu 'gro 'dod kyang nga rang la dbang med rje nā ro pa dang yum la bka' bkod gnang rogs zhu zhus pas/ khong yum sras la bka' bkod gnang 'dug pa de ka 'thad pa'i bka' sgros mthun grub sgar chen sngon la btegs/ bdag gis gung dkar thang bar phebs skyel zhus/ slar rdzong du 'ongs zla bo sogs grabs chub par byas te/ chu lug rang lo bcu gsum par/ rgya ma khri khang du sgar chen gyi zhabs phyir sleb par phyin| rgya ma'i la rgyud thog mar bsam yas dom thang du bzhugs sgar phab/ chos skyong dang mjal nyin bdag la khyod 'dir ci la 'ong gnas skor la 'khyam dgos pa'i mi rigs min sogs sgar chen la 'ur 'joms kyi bka' phebs drag po mang du byung*/ sgar pa rnams shin tu 'tshab cing bred dngangs che bar byed 'dug /bdag tsho'i pha mes kyi srung ma yin pas dga' tshor dang dag snang las spros pa bred 'jigs ci yang ma byung*/ dbu rtse mgo mar gnas 'brel bgyis nub/ byang chub chen po bdag cag gi ston pa dngos su bzhugs pa'i snang ba kho na shar/ bar khang du gnas zhag bgyis nub sngon mkhan slob rje 'bangs gdan 'dzoms pa'i tshe'i dran snang shin tu mang bas res 'ga' dga' brod dgod 'chor ba dang*/ res 'ga' skyo shas kyis mchil ma 'chor bas mtshan mo 'das/ dbu rtse gong mar rnam snang bzhi sgrom gyi sku gzhogs su gnas zhag bgyis skabs sku rnams las 'od 'phro ba sogs mthong snang kha shas byung*/ has po ri'i rtser phyin skabs sngon lha sras kyis bzhengs pa'i dam pa rgyang gi lha khang yod pa'i bkod pa rnams dran/

da lta rdzing du song ba'i ming dam pa rdzing du grags pa mthong bas mi rtag pa'i dran shes bzod glags med pa byung*/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho'i gdung 'bum cung zad cig 'dug pa sgar chos sde thams cad kyis zhig gsos mdzad par bdag cag gis kyang sa rdo rgyab khur mang du phul/ slar mchims phur phebs/ mkha' 'gro gsang phug tu rje zhwa dmar ba sku mtshams bdun phrag gcig gnang ba'i zhabs phyir bsdad/ der lo chen bai ro tsa na'i phyag bris 'bum sha sgro ma bzhugs pa'i steng nas bklag lung zhus/ de nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i glu gar sogs ya mtshan dpag tu med pa mthong*/ blon po mgul du phebs/ gur dkar phug tu gnas zhag gnang ba'i nub/ rje zhwa dmar ba'i drung du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro lha dang lha mo mang pos phyag skor byed cing chos nyan pa nub gang mthong bas phyi nangs nas rje de slob dpon chen po dang khyad med pa'i dad pa 'gyur ba med pa thob/ yang grub thob me long rdo rje'i sgrub gnas skyid phug tu phebs/ der grub thob kyi phyag mdzub kyis brag ldebs la skyid skyid zer ba mang po bris 'dug pas mjal/ sngon me long rdo rjer skyes dus rdzogs pa chen po nyams su blangs pa'i tshul dran pas snang bzhi'i 'char sgo tshad rdzogs pa dus de nyid du byung bas dben pa gzhan du lo gsum rdzogs chen bsgoms pa las gnas der skye ba dran pa de gshog che ba byung*/ gzhan yang bla ma zhang gi sgrub gnas g.yu brag la phebs pa'i tshe bla ma zhang bem po ser po zhig dang dbu zhwa rgod gshog ma mnabs nas zhal 'dzum dang bcas/ e ma a la la/ snang srid 'khor 'das 'di rang sems su 'dug gi// rang sems 'di gzhi med rtsa bral du gda' yi| |gzhi rtsa bral ba de 'od gsal chen po ru 'dug gi// 'od gsal chen po de bden don nges grub du gda' yi// zhes sogs phyag rgya chen po'i mgur ma gdangs snyan la gsung ngar ba/

g.yang g.yang g.yang*/ hor ro ro/ ting ting ting zhes phra sbom sna tshogs 'gyur skad du mdzad/ sku mer mer shigs shigs grol nyams dang*/ dbu gug gug dbu zhu chen po lhab lheb mang po dgyes pa'i rnam rol du mdzad pa mjal/ gzhan yang ngang phug /g.yang ril phug sogs sgrub gnas ngo mtshar can du ma mjal/ bsgrags sngags grwar sgar phab/ bsgrags yang rdzong shel gyi brag phug mjal ba'i zhabs phyir phyin/ sgrub phug gong mar slob dpon chen po rgyal po'i cha lugs lha mo gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa sogs mjal/ 'on gyi stag tshang mthong smon gyi sgrub phug tu seng gdong ma'i sngags kyi rang sgra sgrog pa thos/ der brag logs la lag pa'i rjes zhig kyang byung*/ zangs ri mkhar dmar mjal dus ma cig lab kyi sgrol ma'i sku byin rlabs can nyid kyi na bza' ras gos sgron pa zhig 'dug par byin rlabs zhus pas sku des/ phyi gnyan sa 'grim pa phyi yi gcod// nang nyon mongs gcod pa nang gi gcod| |gsang ba rnam rtog gcod pa gsang ba'i gcod// bcad bya gcod byed bral ba don gyi gcod// ces gsungs par rje zhwa dmar bas ci zer ba red gsungs par/ bdag gis lab lob mang po mdzad kyi 'dug zhus pas cang mi gsung*/ thod smyon bsam grub kyi sku rdzi zhwa dang ber nag bzhes pa zhig 'dug pa bdag gis mtshar 'dod kyis rdzi zhwa de sgron phud mang po byas pas sku de shig tsam zhig bzhad byung ba'i tshe zhwa dmar ba bdag gi gdong la cer gyis gzigs shing ha'i mtshar ba la ang gsungs byung*/ de nas brag kha'i nya mgo na khar bzhugs sgar btab| sde pa bde legs rab tshes kyis dkar dro tshogs 'khor brgya 'bul la sogs pa tshad las 'das pas bsnyen bkur/ bdag na so phra yang khams rig bkra ba zhig yod pas sde pa des bdag la shin tu brtse bar mdzad/ chos rje dge legs phun tshogs kyis bos nas rin chen brag dang*/ bla ma sngags 'chang gis bos nas 'od gsal sding rnams su bdag rang phyin/

dgon pa gong du rje zhwa dmar ba'i zhabs phyir nya mgo gru'i bzhugs sgar du dgon pa gong ma dang ras chung phug pa'i grwa pa rags bsdus kyis snyan brgyud kyi 'khrul 'khor spyan 'bebs zhus par bdag gis kyang bltas/ thag mang yang sde pa bgres po zhig 'dug pa des kyang bdag la shin tu byams pa zhig byung*/ de nas bteg gdan sa chen po dpal gyi phag mo gru kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod du phebs pa'i tshe grwa tshang khag gnyis kyi bla ma che bgres sogs kyis thab bsu/ 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis mchod rdzas du ma thogs shing snam sbyar sgom zhwa dang bcas ser sbrengs kyis bsus| bzhugs yul yang dgon nang sor gzims chung khra mo dang ka bzhi steng mdo phugs su phyag phebs/ bdag la yang nub ngos der khang chung skyid po zhig yod kyang phal cher rje'i zhabs drung du bsdad/ chos sde khag rnams gling gseb du sgar btab/ zhag shas lon nas nang rten de bzhin gshegs pa nyan thos chen po gnyis dang bcas pa'i tshems dang*/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho'i zhal 'gram sogs nang rten blo'i gzhal byas dpag par mi nus pa ches mang ba rnams rten gshom gnang*/ de'i tshe bdag la skra spa lo yod pas bzhar ba 'gab tshul phebs byung bar bdag gi zla bo rnams kyis sngon rje gong ma'i skabs kyang dbu skra bzhar bas sku tshe'i bar chad byas pa yin zer zhu 'bul byed 'dug /nga rang gi bsam par skye ba snga ma de ltar byung ba bden/ skye ba 'di la skra bzhar ma bzhar gyis rjes su tshe ring thung gi 'gro 'ong byed pa'i mtshan ltas ni med bsam/ yin min ci yang ma lab/ de nas 'bri gung du yum sras la zhu skor byas par de gong nas rje zhwa dmar ba dang*/ sras yum bdag gi skra 'breg pa'i bka' bgros mthun yod 'dug pas/ de skabs skra 'breg pa sogs dpon slob rin po che'i dgongs pa dang bstun zhes sogs phebs byung bar sgyogs mda' na khar song zin 'dug pas/

gza' tshes skar ma sbyor byed mchog tu bzang por 'jag spyil du sku 'dra mthong ba don ldan kyi drung du de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems spyan drangs mchod pa dang bcas pa'i drung du/ ma ṇi ba chen mo gnyan 'jo zer ba rje nyid kyi dbu skra yang zhu mkhan yin pa de yang lag byams pa'i dbang gis mdun g.yas zur nas bzung*/ chan pas 'breg par brtsams pas ji ltar byas kyang ma chod par lan bu la lcags dregs chags 'dug /de nas rje zhwa dmar ba nyid kyi phyag gis spa lo gzhan rnams chan pas bregs/ chan pa ma song ba'i spa lo de rjes su bregs nas lcags dregs chags pa'i thad der dar dmar po zhig dkris nas sku phrag tu thugs tshags gnang*/ skra lhag ma rnams ma ṇi bas legs par bzhar grub nas ma lus pa tshags byas/ rje nyid sku 'dra'i g.yon zur du 'greng ste bzhugs par bdag gis skra phyag 'bul zhing*/ na mo snang srid rnam dag gi bla ma la// zhes sogs rkang pa gsum 'don gyin phyag phul bas bar ma'i tshe/ sku 'dra rin po cher rje zhwa dmar bzhi pas phul ba'i dngul gyi sgom zhwa tsha gser gsol ba shin tu lji ba zhig yod pa yud kyis phud de sku pang du chags song bar/ rje des bdag la khyod rang da lta phan khyim pa la da nangs rab tu 'byin par brtsams pas dpal phag mo gru pas kyang zhwa phud mdzad 'dug ces gsungs/ de 'phral steng gi gzims chung ka bzhi'i steng la nang rten khrod du de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems kyang bzhugs su gsol ba'i sku mdun du ma na ho dang g.yang ṭi/ shel dang gser dngul 'ba' zhig gi snod rnams su chu gtsang dri dang kha dog bsgyur ba dang ma bsgyur ba'i yon chab/ kha dog sna tshogs bkra ba'i me tog /sbyar ba dang rang bzhin grub pa'i bdug pa/ mar dang dri bzang pos sbags pa'i snang gsal dang*/ ga bur dang*/ gur kum tsandan sihla sogs sbyar ba'i dri chab/ 'bras sa lu sogs kyi bshos gtsang*|

gzhan yang nyer spyod lnga dang*/ rgyal po'i srid la 'os pa bdun la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad du mas brjid chags par bshams pa'i g.yas ngos su/ seng ge dang dar zab kyi khri la sangs rgyas dkon mchog yan lag gi ngo bo don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te rje zhwa dmar ba cod pan 'dzin pa dpal gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug rdo rje dga' ba don kun yongs su grub pa phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba khyab bdag bstan pa'i nyi ma de nyid kyis/ nang rten khrod nas 'phags pa shā ri'i bu'i snam sbyar mnabs te mkhan po'i bya ba mdzad/ yang ri'i drung pa shag rogs pa de/ skabs der rje 'di la shin tu mos shing*/ gzhan du ci 'dra na'ang de skabs bslab gtsang kho na yin pas las kyi slob dpon mdzad/ zu ri'i drung pas dus bsgo ba/ cog grwa drung pas grogs dan/ nyin byed gling slob dpon pa smra seng*/ 'phel rgyas gling pa'i chos sgo ba slad sdings pa/ mdzes rgyan gling pa'i slob dpon pa karma bkra shis rnams kyis kha skong mdzad de/ bdag gcig pu la dge tshul gyi sdom pa legs par stsal/ kha skong rnams kyi rnam gzhag /rab tu byung ba'i dga' ston gyi mang ja grwa tshang khag thams cad la phyag mdzod gzhung rang nas gnang ste/ lugs gnyis ka'i bka' drin gyi phung po dngos can du bdog na nam mkha'i khongs su yang cha tsam shong par mi nus pas rjes su 'dzin par mdzad/ bdag la ras zi hun gyi bla gos shig dang*/ paṇa zhwa thal sbyar dmar po zhig gis gtsos pa'i legs cha'i gnang skyes bzang po yang stsal/ de grol nas sku rtsed lta bur de ring nas bstan bcos lta bu rtsom yang sbyar byang la shākya'i btsun pa zer ba byas na rnam dpyod yong ba yin gsungs/ de nas rje drung nyid nas spyi don legs bshad rgya mtsho 'dzin chos/ sde pa phyag mdzod pa dkon mchog snyan ngag shin tu mkhas pa yin 'dug pas daṇḍi'i tshig rgyan me long ma'i don rgyan sgra rgyan gab tshig gi rgyan rnams yongs su rdzogs pa rtsom rgyugs/

rgyal ba'i dbang po dbang phyug rdo rje'i drung yig chen mo sde pa lum pa bas yig bris kyi byang stan rnams slob pa'i dbu gtsugs/ 'dzin chos nyin re par gyi shog logs re/ snyan ngag gi rtsom rgyugs sho lo ka bcu phrag re/ yi ge byang stan chen po yig phreng bdun re shong pa'i byang stan snga dro gsum phyi dro gsum re rnams chad med du sbyangs/ de dag gi mtshams rnams su nyams mtshar dang sbrags rje drung nyid nas/ lha yin na bon po'i lha yin pa 'dod zer byung na/ bande'i lha chos can/ sogs rdis rkang lnga drug re yang bslabs/ nangs nub 'dzin chos zhus pa rnams gshar sbyangs dang*/ de'i zhar la thun mong bsdus tshig dang bstan bcos bsdus pa'i sdom tshig sogs rtog ge'i gzhung lugs 'ga' zhig kyang sbyangs/ de nas phreng ba'i dbang bskur dang bka' 'gyur gyi lung sogs gsol ba btab pas/ phreng ba'i ljags bzlas kha gso ba'i phyir zla ba gcig mtshams bcad gnang*/ ka bzhi'i steng du phreng ba'i ras bris rnams gtor mchod dang bcas te bshams/ nyin re bzhin dkyil 'khor re re'i ljags bzlas dang de nyid kyi sbyin sreg res mos kyis 'jam rdor la zhi ba/ mi bskyod par rgyas pa sogs tshar rgyas pa re gnang*/ zhar la bdag la lag len slob pa'i phyir sku drung du bcar sdod bcug /de nub sbyin sreg gang gnang de'i phyag len rnams nangs zhogs spyan lam du lad mo zhus nas 'bebs shing byung ba rnams cang mi gsung*/ ma byung ba rnams la tshar gcod mdzad/ de ltar ljags bzlas thems nas gdan sa chen po'i bla g.yel du dkyil 'khor thams cad rdul tshon 'ba' zhig la bsgrubs shing*/ de yang bod rgan la la'i mkhas 'dod dang*/ bzed gzong 'di rung mthus dang*/ 'thad legs kha skong sogs la ming btags pa'i bsre bslad spu tsam yang med par/ slob dpon chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i zhabs la rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su stsal ba'i bzhed pa ji lta bar/

gsang 'dus 'jam rdor nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i bar rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor nyer brgyad po bla med kho na'i lugs su/ sgar gzhung yang zur cog grwa nyin byed gling*/ mthil pa'i 'phel rgyas gling pa dang*/ mdzes rgyan gling pa sogs 'dus pa bgrang gis mi lang ba rnams la/ rje phrin las pa phyi ma'i ljags bsgrigs sgrub thabs rnal 'byor rdzogs phreng dang dkyil chog 'jigs med dgongs rgyan ltar bka' drin du bstsal/ de'i yang nyin re bzhin sbyin sreg gi skabs ltar dbang bskur ba'i lag len dang dogs gnas thams cad gcod par mdzad/ de grub nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi ljags lung bklag lung rang min tsam phal cher shog bu re re'i thog mtha' bar gsum dang gal 'gag che ba rnams dang*/ brgyad stong phreng ba can rnams bklag lung du gnang zhing mthar pod dbang sogs yid kyi re ba yongs su tshim par gnang*/ bka' 'gyur gyi ljags lung thog ma'i skabs chos nyan gzims chung khra mor mi shong ba tsam byung yang*/ mjug tu bdag cag lnga drug las ma byung ba ni bla mas chos 'chad pa nus kyang slob mas rna ba nyan nas kha rog par sdod mi nus pa deng sang gi slob ma'i thugs gshis dkyus gcig par gda'/ de tshe phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid kyang gsungs pas/ gdan sa chen por zla ba ril po lnga gdan phab pa'i ring la dbang lung slob sbyang sogs nyin mo skad cig kyang btang snyoms su sdod pa'i go skabs med par byas/ ya mtshan du ma dang ldan pa'i 'phan zhal chen mo sku'i lhu so sor mchod khang chen mo'i lho ldebs su lan gcig bshams/ slar gdan sa'i shar ngos gro 'jo'i spang ldebs su lhu bsgrigs nas lan gcig bshams pa'i tshe/ rong cha dkar sogs rgyang ring nas mthong ba kun gyis da nangs gro 'jo'i spang la me shor 'dug zer ba sogs byung ngo*// rgyal ba gar gyi dbang po'i bka' drin las// bla med chos kyi bdud rtsi ngoms btungs pas// gdams chung man ngag chang skyur 'byang ma dgos// rgyal ba'i gsung rab dri bral lung mnos pas// bstan bcos rang bzo'i lung rgyun snyegs ma dgos// lhan cig skyes sbyor nyams khrid bskyangs pa'i mthus// kha bshad tshig la lta sgom re ma dgos// mkhas pa'i drung du mkhas par sbyangs pa'i mthus// rang bzo'i mkhas rlom rkang 'dren byed ma dgos// ha ha/

de nas skar ma ri ṣi shar ba'i chab khrus la thag ma lcang gseb tu phebs pa'i zhabs phyir yang phyin/ de dag gi gseng srubs nam byung phyag mdzod dkon mchog gis yi ge 'bru tsha/ chos rje gling pas sne'u gdong 'bru par kyang bslabs/ de nas rje zhwa dmar ba sog po chos khur gyis zul phu dgon par spyan drangs pa'i sar phebs/ bdag de bar du bsam yas sa phug tu sngar bslabs pa rnams bskyar sbyangs dang sbrags mtshams mal du sdod cig pa'i bka' phebs pa ltar sa sbug sgrub sder mtshams bcad nas bsdad pa'i skabs/ zan g.yang mthil du chos skyong chen pos shog gsungs par phyin pas 'bri gung dge bshes khyod zhwa dmar dge bshes kyi rtsar re zhig bsdad nas shes bya bslabs na bsam pa yin yang rang yul du gong yal dogs 'dug pas cis kyang spre'u lor rang yul du sleb par song zhig ces nan tan dang gzhan yang zhal ta slob ston mang du gnang byung*/ de nas zla ba gcig tsam song nas rje zhwa dmar ba gzhis ka gong ri dkar por phyag phebs 'phral bdag kyang shog gsungs 'bod mi gnang byung ba ltar phyin/ lam bar drang srong srin po ri'i 'khor lo sdom pa byin rlabs can mjal ba'i sman sku ma yin par sdom pa dngos kyi gsung rngam zhing snyan pa'i gdangs kyis oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra a karṣa ya ā we sha kā ya wāka tsitta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ zhes gsungs/ de nas gong dkar du sku zhabs su 'byor zhing zla gcig tsam bsdad nas dbang lung 'phro ma rnams rdzogs par zhus/ de dag gi ring thams cad du nangs nub kyi gzims mal 'chos pa sogs byas/ rje nyid kyis sku rtsed lta bur khyod chos phyogs nas nga'i slob ma yin/ 'jig rten nas nu bo yin pas/ zla bo ma 'dus dgu 'dus rnams kyis nga'i rogs byed pa dang mi 'dra khyod kyis gyis zhes gsungs pa la/ bdag gi bsam par bka' lung 'di 'dra ches mchog tu bka' drin bskyangs par 'dug gi/

rgyu mtshan ji skad du/ gang phyir rdo rje slob dpon mchog /de nyid mnyes par byas pa na// lha yi rgyal po'i dngos grub kyang*// blo chen des ni dka' ba min// zhes dang*/ 'brom ston gyis jo bo la/ kho bo khams su bsdad pa'i tshe chos byas pa rnams lam du song ngam zhus pas jo bos/ se btsun gyi rta 'tsho ba dang rang 'thag 'thag pa tshun byas pa rnams lam du song gzhan ye ma song gsung ba yid la brnags pas ji ltar gsungs pa'i las ka rnams ji ltar dgyes dgyes bzhin du byas/ gong dkar du slebs nas slar rnal 'byor rdzogs phreng 'jigs med dgongs rgyan sogs kyi bklag lung chos dbang phran bu zhu dgos pa rnams zhus/ chos skyong gi gsung rigs rnams zhus shing re zhig rang yul du chas pa'i dgongs pa zhus par/ re zhig 'di mus su bsdad na bsams kyang chos skyong gi zer rigs kyis phyin pa yang 'gab ces dgongs pa khrol zhing*/ yong khar nged rang sku mched sde gog gi 'dzin skyong las rgyal khams phyogs med 'di ka sdig mi gsog cing bstan 'gror sman pa yong tshul sogs bslab bya mthar phyin pa dang lugs zung gi gnang skyong tshad med pa dang bcas sgar chen gyi thab skyong gis rgyang tsam bskyal/ de nas chas te chos 'khor lha sar slebs/ gnas zhag dal ba zhig byed rtsis yin yang*/ gtsang sku yar rgyab pa sogs sde tshogs dang rang re'i zhabs drung nā ro pa yang phebs 'dug pa mjal bas/ 'dir nad mug dang mi tshogs che 'dug pas yun ring bsdad pa mi 'gab tshul phebs byung bas jo shāka sogs shur tsam mjal/ 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha rnams 'od zer 'phro ba sogs nyams snang 'ga' zhig byung*/ de nas bteg yer par slebs nas phyi nangs gnas mjal rnams byas tshe rgyal po zas gtsang gi sku la byin rlabs zhus pa'i tshe mgul gyi nor bu'i do shal khrod nas/ nor bu gcig brul nas bdag gi sgal steng du bab byung ba rten 'brel yong bsam tshags byas/

lha ri snying po mjal tshe sngon jo bo rin po che'i spyan sngar khu rngog 'brom sogs gdan 'dzoms pa'i tshe/ rtsa sher las/ bdag las ma yin gzhan las min// gnyis las ma yin rgyu med min// dngos po gang dang gang la yang*| |skye ba nam yang yod ma yin// zhes pa las 'phros pa'i gsung gleng mang po byung ba dran/ dpon sa stag lung mas bsnyen bkur gya nom pa mdzad/ phan yul rgyal chen rtser 'byor/ sgo mo'i gnas sogs mjal tshogs bdag bi nā ya kas bsu ba'i snang ba byung*/ 'phan yul brgyud khra phu dang ri chos kyi mgon po rdza sku sogs mjal bas/ mgon po'i rdza sku la zhal bzhi pa dngos su bzhugs pa'i mtshan ma mthong*/ sdings su phyin zhabs tog bzang bar byung*/ slar na bo la dang kha gsum la rgyud sgom shongs su zhag sdod byas/ phyi nangs rim pas spyil bu sogs mjal/ ra 'dzab mjal ba'i tshe sngon chad rgya gar du rang nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal ngos bzung gzhan yang dge gong gi jo bo dar 'dzin ma dang*/ brgyad ra mi g.yo ba sogs kyang de skabs chu chung ba dang 'grigs pas mjal nas rim gyis rtse ba sogs rgyud/ rdzong gsar du slebs nas zla bo bcu lhag tsam ma gtogs gzhan rnams grwa tshang sogs gang bder bzhag /de nas mi ring bar chos skyong gis zer ba ltar yum sku zo ngan zhing sku na smin pa'i stabs kyis sku rlung la brten pa'i mnyel gzhi byung bar dbang 'bul ba dang snyung g.yog sku byug sogs gang byas kyang ma phan par sa sprel zla ba lnga pa'i nyer drug la sku gshegs/ rgyang tsam gsangs nas slar gsang brtol dang dgongs rdzogs rnams rje nā ro pas 'gan bzhes kyis legs par grub/ yang ri sgar pa bla ma sding pa dang bcas byon pa bla ma lam du 'das shing sgar pa yang 'byor mtshams grwa brje len thog rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen pas tshogs su bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho'i dbang lung stsal ba bdag gis kyang mnos shing brje len mgyogs par mdzad/

yang ri sgar gyi mgo 'dren du zhabs drung spro lung gi bde bar gshegs pa de nyid kyis thugs khur bzhes te mi ring bar klung shod rgyud mdo khams su bteg /de nas skabs shig bla ma rin po che sangs rgyas rin chen rdzong gsar du spyan drangs/ tshe bdag lcags sdig gnubs lugs kyi lcags sdig khams lnga'i 'od mdangs las byung ba dbang chog mu tig phreng ba zhus shing*/ de 'phral gnubs lugs lcags sdig la phyi skor lcags 'dra/ nang skor thog 'dra/ gsang ba gnam thog me'i skor rnams kyi bklag lung yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ gzhan yang dbang chos mang du zhus pa thob yig tu gsal/ de rjes rje nā ro pa'i drung du gshin rje yang zlog me'i spu gri'i dbang lung yongs rdzogs man ngag lag len dang bcas pa zhus shing*/ mi ring bar zur 'phyong shar du bdag cag bcu drug gis sgrub pa tshes gcig nas brtsams te nyer dgu'i bar rgyal dbang ratna yab sras kyi phyag bzhes ji lta ba bgyis pa'i tshe/ gshin rje tshe bdag zhal mjal thengs lnga tsam dang*/ gzhan yang lha grub pa dang las sbyor tshad du phyin pa'i ltas dang*/ lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing*/ nyer dgu dang gnam stong la las mjug sreg 'phang mnan pa la sogs pa thams cad tshang bar bgyis/ sgrub pa 'di'i dbu zhabs kun tu rje nā ro pa'i zhal bkod kyis khyab par gnang bas 'di skor gyi lag len rab tu byang zhing gzhan dring spu tsam 'jog mi dgos pa dus de nyid nas byung*/ yang skabs shig rdzong gi zur 'phyong shar du bka' srung gsum gyi las sbyor gyi sgrub pa zhig bdag cag dgus tshes gcig nas gnam stong gi bar du bgyis pa'i gtor ma gsum so sor zhal rngam 'don pa'i phyag len yod pa ltar bgyis pa'i tshe/ bka' srung gi rtags mtshan zhal ston dngos nyams rmi lam du yang yang byung la/ sgrub rogs thams cad mthong bar ma mo'i gtor zhal nas rakta'i rgyun 'dzag pa dang*/

drang srong gi gtor mar me stag dang du ba 'phro zhing sbrang bu bab pa thams cad skad cig la 'chi ba dang dam can pa'i gtor ma'i tshems mche ba rnams gtor ma 'chos pa'i dus las sor do re tsam gyis ring du song ba dang*/ sgrub khang du me dang du ba 'khrigs pa sogs dang*/ sde brgyad kyi cho 'phrul sdig chom gzugs med pa'i skad 'byin pa sogs ya nga ba'i rnam pa mang du byung zhing*/ lhag par 'bod rbad bsad mnan gyi rtags rnams brtan po mthong bas dgu stong la las kyi mtha' sdud sreg 'phang mnan pa'i sbyor ba rdzogs par byas pa'i tshe/ tshes gcig nas gzhan su la yang med par bdag cag sgrub pa po rnams la dal yams babs lji ba rang min pa zhig byung ba rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen par zhus pas/ bka' srung sgrub yun cung zad ring ba thal ba'i rnam pa yin 'dug kyang*/ lha rtags yin pas nyer 'tshe che ba mi yong gang ltar bdag gis thabs bya'o gsungs/ rtsa gsum las byang dang bka' srung la mchod gtor tshogs mchod rgyas pa zhig gnang song bas bdag tsho phyi nangs nas nad gzhi med du sangs 'dug /yang dus shig gi tshe bdag gcig pus rdzong gi rab gsal du gza' dug gi spu gri'i sgrub pa yun ring ba zhig byed skabs dngos nyams su drang srong 'khor bcas 'du ba dang*/ sngags pa phod zhwa nag po gyon pa gzi brjid can gyis thun gtor dngos su len pa sogs rtags mtshan mang du byung zhing sgrub mjug kyang rdzogs par byas/ yang dus re zhig bdag zla grogs bzhi dang bcas pas dgongs pa yang zab kyi gza'i gsang sgrub dug gi 'khor lo nyin zhag phrugs gcig rdzong gi rab gsal du bgyis pa'i tshe/ nub mo phyi 'khyams su rgyu 'grul byed pa rnams zla bo dang sdebs pa ma gtogs gcig pur 'gro mi nus pa'i 'jigs rngam dang*/ thams cad kyis tshor bar sdig choms dang ku sgra dang bso sgra sgrog pa dang*/ me 'od 'khrugs pa sogs byung 'dug

/sgrub khang du me g.yo ba dang du ba 'khrigs pa dang gzhung du bshad pa'i rtags rnams rdzogs par byung bas/ nyi ma nub la bab dus las sbyor rdzogs par byas/ yang rje nā ro pa'i drung du bstan srung a phyi'i skor gyi dbang lung rnams rdzogs par zhus 'phral de nyid kyi bsnyen sgrub rgyal dbang ratnas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs snying po gsal ba ltar bgyis pa'i tshe/ bdun phrag gsum pa'i nyi shar gyi thun la skad med kyang snang ba bde ba zhig byung bas bstod pa ka ma lo 'dab mar gdangs byas pa'i tshe/ rab gsal gyi phyong kha'i bar snang du bstan srung ma gtso 'khor lnga zhabs thang mdzad nas bstod pa'i gdangs dang bstun pa'i gar 'cham yid 'phrog pa zhig mdzad byung bar/ sku rdzi brtson 'grus langs nas phyag gad rgyag 'dug pa phyi ltas byas nas ci red nag yud yud zer 'dug pas thun grub nas bdag gi bsam par/ nag yud ma red dkar yud red// dkar yud rgan mo'i bcos gog red// skad med snang bde bstod dbyangs len// rgan mo dga' nas gar 'cham byas// zer ba zhig sam ṭar lag dal du bris nas bzhag /de rjes rje nā ro pas gu ru chos dbang gi klu brgyad lto ba'i zab gter sngags sdebs snying gzer nag po gzhung 'grel gyi lung dang*/ sdebs dang gshed kyi 'khor lo'i lag len sogs dpyis phyin pa gnang zhing byang chub par byas/ rjes su drag sngags 'khor lo gsang sdebs kyi rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa dang*/ gsang sngags sngags lnga 'khrul 'khor rgya sdebs pa'i rgyud sogs la rtog pa zhib tu bcug pas snying gzer la dgos shing der med pa'i zab gnad mang du rnyed cing blor tshud/ gzhan yang drag po rgya sdebs snying gi me long*/ drag sngags kyi sa sdebs/ thugs gsang ba rin po che dpal gyi be'u/ sdebs kyi rgyud thod pa nag po sogs sngags sdebs kyi skor mang rabs la'ang byang bar bgyis/ skabs shig ban grong shod pa'i spo bo rnam sras las nag rtsis kyi skor rnams byang bar byas shing*/

der ma 'thus pa rnams las ru mkhan chen pa'i dbon por khyung nag sgang dril dang*/ rgya rdol gyi rigs mi 'dra ba drug bdun tsam sogs rgya che zhing lag len gnad dril du bslabs shing*/ rtsa rgyud rin po che kun 'dus/ zangs khyams khyi mo 'gros/ ston chung a bo'i zangs khyams/ gshin bshad zhib mo brgya yi dar tshags/ thems yig be'u brgyad cu pa/ zangs khyams 'phar ba gong rgyug /drang srong dgo ba spu can dang spu gri g.yul rgyal skor/ gyim shang zhags pa nag po/ gyim shang ga'u mgo nag /gshin babs gsal ba'i me long*/ dmag rtsis shel me ru dar sogs nag rtsis kyi gzhung lugs chen po rnams kyang byang bar byas mod/ deng sang gi rtsis mkhan gson rtsis bre gang rdel drug /bag rtsis khra mo dgu skor/ gshin rtsis rdo don bcu gsum pa sogs tsam byang bas nag rtsis nga mkhas zer ba'i rbad khams ni 'u rang gis ma thon ang lags/ yang skabs shig rje nā ro pa'i drung du khams gsum 'khrug byed las kyi rlung dmar chos rgyal dri med lhun po zhes sam mtshan gzhan o rgyan mkha' spyod gling pas kong po bu chu mchod rten nas spyan drangs pa'i lung yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ de dag gi lag len rgyal dbang ratna'i phyag bzhes ji lta ba'i bka' drin stsal te/ mi 'gyang bar gzhan phyogs 'ga' zhig lag sbrel gyis rang srid la 'tshe ba'i skad cha byung bar rje nā ro pas ji ltar 'gab gsungs par rlung dmar zhig brtsam na zhus pas| de rang bgyis gsung ba ltar rlung dmar gyi 'khor lo chen mo brtsams te rtse ba'i mdun pa tshang du bdag grogs gsum dang bcas zhag shas sgrub pa'i tshe/ 'gag tu sdod mi rnams kyi nyams dang rmi lam du mi sngon po lag tu ba dan thogs pa sha ba la zhon pa dang*/ mi lus bya mchu can mang po dang*/ mi'i lus la mgo brnyan sna tshogs yod pa dang*/ gla ba la spre'u zhon pa dang*| 'ug pa la bya rog zhon pa sogs ji snyed pa sgrub khang du 'du tshogs byed pa byung 'dug

/nang du yang nang rtags rdzogs par mthong bas rdzong gsar gyi smad chu mkhar lcog gi steng du bskor bas zla ba bdun brgyad nas phyi rtags kyang legs par byung song*/ yang skabs shig rje nā ro pas mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i dmag zlog dgra chos rgyas pa dpal rga lo'i phyag len dpyis phyin pa rgyal dbang ratnas mdo khams su gsan pa mgon po khams byon du grags pa'i khrod du bzhugs pa de nyid phyag len du stsal cing*/ gtor chen la khro zhal dbyung ba sogs man ngag gces dgu du mas brgyan pa zhig gnang ba'i phyag g.yog bdag cag mang pos zhus nas gtor ma 'phangs pa'i nub bdag gi rmi lam du/ 'bri gung lung pa thams cad bya rog ri de'u tsam pa kha dang gshog rtse nas me 'od 'phro ba bgrang las 'das pa phyogs rnams su rgyu ba rmis pa ni phul du byung ba'i mtshan mar 'dug /gzhan yang gnas skabs de rnams su rang srid nyams dma' zhing sog po kha dan sogs bod sog kun za rgyu 'bri gung par byed pa zhig yod pas zla ba ngo re bzhin yang 'byed dkrug bskrad mnan drag po mngon spyod kyi las sbyor kho nar rgyab 'tshol dgos pa zhig yod pas de dag gnang ba thams cad kyi phyag g.yog bdag rang gis sgrub thub par zhus/ skabs shig zur 'phyong nub kyi gzims chung chung ngu der rje nā ro pa'i phyag phyi chos sgo ba sku mdun ngag dbang gis mdzad nas/ loka tri pā la'i srung zlog bsad mnan kyi sgrub pa 'byung bzhi'i las sbyor sogs shin tu tshang rgyas shig yun ring por gnang ba'i mchod g.yog bdag gis zhus pas/ loka tri'i lag len skor yang ma tshang ba med pa zhib cha thon pa'i bka' drin tshad las 'das pa byung*/ de tshe skabs shig mal gro gung dkar grwa tshang mdzad rgyu mang ba'i rgyur brten lha sa sogs su dus 'khrug snga phyir byung ba'i dus shig /kong po dkar srid kyi dmag rnams mal gro brgyud pa'i sne len la rje nā ro pa cha dkar du phebs pa'i tshe/

rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen pa rdzong du spyan drangs/ ka brgyad du dpon slob phyogs mthun chos zhu ba lda drug dang sbrags mtshams bcad/ sha ba ri nas brgyud pa'i rtsa 'dab snyan brgyud nyams khrid du zhus| de dag gi rgyab rlung rlung 'tsho'i skabs kha zas rags pa bsrung dgos pa dang sbrags grub pa'i dbang phyug dza har pir nas brgyud pa'i rlung khrid kyang bdun gcig btang*/ snyigs ma 'byongs nas rgyab thur dang*/ de rjes mdun thur rdo rje chu 'thung gi rim pa thabs ldan gnyis dang bcas pa'i 'khrul 'khor lag len rnams rtsa ba khogs shing zur thon pa man ngag kha bshad dang dpe char ma lus pa lag mthil du zan rdog byin pa ltar dam pa de nyid dngos kyis rus chod par stsal cing*/ sbyang ba'i grogs gsol dpon 'gom phun tshogs kyis mdzad/ de dag gi thun mtshams rnams su 'bebs mchid mang po thabs mkhas kyis zhus par rje mkhan chen pa nyid dge ba'i bshes gnyen ram sding ma ba 'byung gnas rdo rjer sku skye ba bzhes pa dang*/ gzhan mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po za hor rgyal por sku 'khrungs pa'i tshe mdun na 'don du sku 'khrungs pa sogs sngon gnas mang po dang*/ lus 'di bor nas mnyam med pa'i drung du 'gro ba ma gtogs slar skye ba 'dzin pa sogs mi byed thag chod yin tshul blo'i yul las 'das pa mang dag gsungs kyang blo chung rnams ha las shi dogs nas ma bris pa yin/ nyams khrid de grol nas kyang rtsa rlung gi rdzogs rim skor 'di bskyed rdzogs gzhan las lag len dka' zhing khe nyen che ba zhig 'dug pas/ lo ngo gsum tsam du nyin mo 'khrul 'khor dang mtshan mo dmigs pa rlung thun ma chag par sbyangs pas da lta'i bar du mi brjed pa 'di byung ba yin/ da lta'i la la ba dag sngar bdag gis khu ma khu cig bslabs/ ye ma ye cig sbyangs/ gcig ga ma gcig nyams su blangs pa yin te deng sang brjed nas thon pa mi 'dug zer ba la bltas na/

nyams chung bdag 'dra bas deng sang brjed ngas la shor na brjed gsos kyi dogs gcod su la byed ang*/ gzhan yang dam pa de nyid kyi drung du sgrub thabs rgya mtsho zhes sam sgrub thabs kun las btus pa'i dbang lung sogs mang du thob pa ni thob yig tu gsal/ de nas skabs shig bla ma rin po che sangs rgyas rin chen ban grong rdzong du sku gshegs pa'i gdung mjal la phyin/ bla ma de bdag la shin tu thugs brtse zhing bka' drin che ba zhig yin pas pha shi ba'i dwa phrug ltar mya ngan gyi khang bur zhugs kyang gsol 'debs smon lam las gzhan pa'i bya thabs ma 'tshal/ yongs 'dzin sangs rgyas mtshan can des// rlung sems dwangs ma'i ye shes kyis// btang ba'i za ma tog de'i drung*// phyag dang smon lam tshim par btab// de bas na rje zhwa dmar ba'i zhabs drung nas rang yul du slebs nas bzung yang ri sgar gyi bla ma ma byas pa'i bar du dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i bgo skal dang*/ phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i lag khrid la sogs pa'i bka' drin gyi pha 'bab ches che ba rnams ni rje nā ro pa dang rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen pa dang bla ma rin po che sangs rgyas rin chen pa dang rnam pa gsum yin no// bla ma nyung yang gdams pa mang*// 'khos khyer chung yang blo gros ldan// 'ud gog med kyang don mang rtogs// lang tsho ngan yang rig rtsal che// de nas spro lung du gsol thab sgril zhing bla ma ba log pa sogs la rtsa 'dab snyan brgyud kyi khrid dang rgyab thur gyi thur ma'i lag len sogs rgyas par byas/ zhabs drung spro lung gi bde gshegs de nyid mdo khams nas yar phebs pa'i snyan pa byung bas rje nā ro pa mtshe'u khar phebs pa'i zhabs phyir bdag gis kyang phyin/ rje nā ro pas dbu mdzad mthil gyi mkhan slob chos gsum dpon rigs sogs rang re'i che dgu grangs las 'das pa'i rta bsu dang sbrags yang ri sgar pa dpon slob mtshe'u kha'i thang du sgar btab/

rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po nas gdul bya rigs can gsum la phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i seng ge'i khri chen por rje nā ro pa nyid kyi zhabs zung bkra shis kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong bkra ba lha mi'i gtsug gi nor bur bkur ba dag bkod pa'i drung du/ bdag cag 'dus pa rgya mtsho rnams dang skye bo'i tshogs grangs las 'das pas yongs su bskor ba'i spyan sngar| yang ri sgar pa dpon slob kyis zang zing gi dngos po rnam thos kyi bu yang bag 'khum par bgyid pa phul/ bdag sogs rnams la yang so sor gang 'os mkhos su phebs pa'i skyes kyis tshim par mdzad/ mi ring bar dpon slob thams cad lhan cig pho brang bkra shis tshugs su phebs so// de nas mi ring bar spro lung gi bde bar gshegs pa de nyid kyis yang ri sgar gyi gdan sar 'jog pa'i thugs 'dun gtad pa'i tshe/ rje nā ro pas rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen pa brgyud de bdag la yang ri sgar bla byed dgos tshul gsungs pas/ bdag 'dra ba lugs gnyis kyi thos myong gis dben cing lhag par lus rten kyang dge tshul yin pas mi 'thad tshul zhus kyang bka' nan gser gyi gnya' shing ltar lji ba'i steng*/ rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen pas kyang rje nā ro pa'i bka' dang du blang ba kho na 'gab tshul gsungs par/ rje nā ro paṇa chen dang mar mi sogs kyis bla ma'i bka' bsgrub pa'i slad du lus srog thed la bor ba de 'dra ba la bsam na/ ngos cag gis kyang dam pa bka' drin can de gnyis kyi dgongs pa la 'gal ba las shi bar yang dga' ba'i go cha gyon te khas len zhus/ yan lag lnga'i 'bras bu dge ba la bab pa'i tshe 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i gral gtsor phyin/ rje nā ro pas bskor ja'i gnang sbyin/ rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen pas dbu mdzad 'dus pa rgya mtshos shis brjod kyi glu dbyangs me tog gi char 'bebs pa sogs mdzad pas gcig tu tshul de lta bu la sems dga' ba/

gnyis su rang cag la thos myong med pas ma byung gi dogs pa/ gsum du khams sogs sa thag ring po bskor dgos pas ngal dub kyi bsam pa sogs sna tshogs shar/ de nas rje nā ro pa gsol thab rtse bar bsgril/ nged rnams rdzong du bsdad pa'i ring thab chen ma bzhugs pas shing rgyugs med pa nas me shing chad nyag byung ba'i tshe/ gyang pa'i lha kha/ dum bu glang thang gdong*/ la dun pa'i se ri sogs breg song bar/ dge 'dun pa'i ming gis ma byin len la 'ur rgyug byed pa tshul dang mthun pa mi sems pas deng sang ltar gang 'dod rang du ma bzhag par sdom gcod re yang byas/ de skabs sde pa gzhung la phyag nas sogs gang yang khrol cher med pa nga rang rgyus yod pas phogs dus mchod sogs la thugs sun gtan nas ma zhus par/ gad lha 'or du mgon po dang gshin rje'i gtor zlog dang sbyin sreg sogs byas pa'i yon nas khal brgya phul ba dang*| mchad 'u 'phags yangs la sbyin bdag bskul bas zla phogs gcig byung ba sogs phul bas gzhi bslangs/ gzhan yang phyug po rnams la yon bdag bskul bas rgya che ba ma byung yang zla ba rer nas bre bcu re tsam ma chad pa byung*/ de skabs yang ri sgar par chang gi longs spyod byed srol med pas mang ja bzhi dang 'jam dus gnyis ma chad pa e yong bltas/ de nas mi ring bar 'phan yul du btegs/ mkhar rtse'i ri dmar sgur du sgar btab/ rje nā ro pa yang mkhar rtser rdzong du bzhugs/ khang nyer mtshams grwa brje len dang*| lhag par rje nā ro pa'i thugs dam rta'u sgrub sde gsang sngags mchog grub gling gi mtshams grwa rdzongs pa'i thog ma yin pas grwa pa kha yod lag yod lnga bcu lhag tsam btang*/ de nas mi ring bar mkhar rtse'i bka' blon pa rnams blo gros nyes pas dpon sa mkhar rtse ma'i phyag mdzod gu ru rdo rje pha bu gnyis rkyen ngan pa'i lam du btang*/ rgya mkhar 'chor ba'i rgyu rkyen thog ma'i dbu 'di dus tshugs pa yin/

kho pa'i nang tshang byings dang dngos po bzang ba rnams sgar par skyabs bcol/ de la lab brjod sna tshogs gtong mkhan 'dug kyang*/ sems can sdug bsngal ba'i skyabs dkon mchog gsum la 'chol ba babs thob yin bsam/ ci byung yang de rnams blos ma btang bar skyabs gnas nges par byas/ deng sang gi dge 'dun gyis sems can gzhan la skyabs byed pa ltar zhog phal pas byas pa las kyang sdug po ster bar dge 'dun la la pho rgod pa 'dug go oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ de nas bla ma dang mkha' 'gros stod lung kha rag mjal bar bskul bas/ kha rag tu phyin te de nub kha rag tu bsdad/ dpon sa a rdil yum sras phebs pas bsnyen bkur gya nom pa byung zhing*/ de nub bde chen pa'i sde pa go shri'i rigs kyi karma bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal dang nged cag zhang dpon gnas khang gcig tu gnas pa'i nub rmi lam du slob dpon chen po drang srong dri med kyi cha lugs su mjal nas/ dgyes bzhin du bdag la gnas kyi sgo dbye bar lung bstan pa ltar tshe chu phug dang*/ tshe chu/ tshe dpag med pa'i sku dang gshin rje tshe bdag gi sku sogs gsar du sgo phye/ gnas de'i phug pa rnams su yang mthong snang dang rkang lag gi rjes la sogs pa mang du byung ba dang*/ gu ru'i rdo sku sogs nga rang gi dbang skal 'ga' zhig kyang longs spyad/ 'di'i zhib cha kha rag bde chen thar pa gling gi gnas bstod dad ldan snying la dga' ster ku mu ta'i phreng bar yod pa ltar yin/ 'dir yi ges ngal bas bzlas nas ma bris/ de nas rgyal stod du thod le mgon khang mjal ba'i tshe mgon khang de ha cang gzi brjid che ba rang mi 'dug cing sku brnyan de yang thal ba skya shud de ba zhig 'dug pas/ 'di byin rlabs can zhig rang ci 'dra yin nam snyam slar rang gi sgar khrod du sleb ma thag /ser ba dang 'brug sgra sogs 'jigs pa zhig byung bas mgon po de la ye shes pa bzhugs nges su yid ches pa byung*/
