za dam o tanta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang mjal du phyin/ thog steng du ltad mo la chas pa'i tshe phyogs shig tu 'brug glog thog gi cho 'phrul mang du ston pa zhig mthong bas phyogs pha gi gang yin dris pas/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i zhal ngo mang pos mgon po zhal mjal ba'i sgrub gnas dgon pa dpal ldan rtse zhes pa gnyan po yin zer/ 'o na bdag kyang mjal du 'gro smras pas/ sa 'bri sngar lha 'gras che bas phrag dog yong mi 'gab zer bar/ lha 'gras yong don med rgyal ba'i bstan srung tshad ldan zhig yin na ni chos byed la dngos grub ster ba yin/ 'jig rten dregs pa can yin na ni bdag 'jigs rgyu med zer bas/ yid yul du mgon po gur ni mgon po dngos grub 'byung bar gaṇḍi 'dzin pa'i mgon po zhes phyag bzhi ba'i 'khor du gtogs pa de ka yin/ zhal bzhi pa ni rang gi skye ba sngon ma'i chos skyong yin/ dkar bdud sogs ni rdo rje phur pa'i srung ma yin/ pu tra lcam dral sogs kyang rnying ma'i srung ma yin pas nga la 'khu ldog ci la yong snyam/ mjal du phyin pas thog mar mgon po zhal bzhi mi snang ba mgon po brgyad dngos su bzhugs pa mjal zhing 'phral dang yun gyi bslab bya lung bstan mang po dang*/ gtso bor mgon po brgyad zhal mthong ba ji lta ba'i sgrub skor smin grol las tshogs dang bcas pa gyis shig bstan 'gror sman pa rgya chen po 'byung bar 'gyur ro sogs kyi gnang ba byin pa byung*/ thog steng du phyin slar mjal bas mgon khang dkyus ma'i tshul ltar mthong*/ 'di skor zhib cha mgon po brgyad kyi lo rgyus bris pa ltar yin/ sgar du slebs nas mgon brgyad kyi phrin las snga ma de sogs 'ga' zhig brtsams/ phyag rje sprul sku ba bsod nams 'od zer gyis mgon brgyad kyi sku thang bris/ zhar la lañdza rigs lnga dang wartu rigs lnga sogs yi ge'i gzugs gyur 'ga' zhig byang bar bslabs/

de nas sgar btegs dur khrod blo mos rgyal du sgar phab/ bdag gis grub thob dbus smyon pa'i gzims spyil du mtshams bcad nas mgon po brgyad kyi bsnyen sgrub bgyis pa'i tshe/ zhag bdun phrag gcig gi khongs su bsnyen sgrub kyi rtags tshang bar rdzogs shing ye shes mgon po brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal mthong*/ zhag bdun pa'i phyis nub srod thun btang zin nas dar cig song ba na/ phyi rol tu char mun rab tu 'khrigs nas 'dug pa'i khrod du he ru ka sngon po dur khrod kyi chas brgyad gyon pa brgyad 'dug pa'i nang nas bongs che ba zhig 'dug pa de bdag gi bug sgo 'gag tu slebs nas bdag la/ kye kye/ sngon dpal chen he ru kas ma traṃ ru tra bsgral ba dang*/ zas gtsang sras kyis bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa ltar do nub armo ni ka'i rdo'i steng du mgyogs par song la don sgrubs/ skya rengs 'char ba'i tshe sgrub khang du sleb par byos shig zer bas/ bug sgo 'gag tu dge slong ba thel sogs zla bo gnyis yod par skad btang*/ mtshams sgo bshigs nas dur khrod de'i nub phyogs su grog rong zhig tu armo ni ka'i rdo yin zer ba'i pha bong dkar po leb chags pa zhig yod pa der 'gro bar chas pa'i tshe/ char mun cher 'khrigs pas bdag cag gsum ga rkang lag bzhi ka sar btsugs nas phyin glog 'gyu ba'i tshe lam gang du 'dug dmigs bcar/ res 'ga' g.yang la lhung gis dogs sbo nyugs byas te ngal ba ltar phyin pas/ rdo leb steng du slebs sngas dang stan ni med/ pha bong gi steng char chus khyab pa'i khrod du bsdad cing rim gnyis la gnas/ zla grogs gnyis phar rgyang tsam gyi sar 'dug pa'i tshe/ nam gung dus mgon po brgyad dzo ki sngo sangs brgyad du byas 'khor mang po khrid nas baṃ chen sogs tshogs mang po khyer nas bdag gi sar byung*/ mgon po brgyad kyi las byang snga ma de nged cag lhan cig tu bton/

tshogs 'khor rgyas par byas shing dzo ki brgyad po dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur mang du mdzad rjes/ bdun po gcig la thim gcig po des bslab bya lung bstan mgon po brgyad kyi rgyud dbang khrid las tshogs rnams 'di ltar rtsoms shig par sprad rjes jo shāka mjal bar song gsung ba sogs lung bstan mang du mdzad nas mi snang bar gyur/ slar nged cag gsum lam bgrod par dka' bzhin du snga ma ltar dud 'gro'i 'gros lta bus spyil por slebs/ zhag shas song nas lha sar grwa rkyang gi rdzu bag gis mched grogs bcu gnyis dang sbrags phyin/ jo shākya mjal zhing rang gzhan gyi don 'grub pa'i smon lam btab cing*/ bdag gis shākya mu ni'i thugs kar yan lag mchog gis gtugs pa'i tshe/ shākya mu nis bzhad pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad pa lkog gyur rang 'dod ma yin par zla grogs bcu gcig po kun gyis mthong 'dug /bcu gcig zhal la smon lam btab pa'i tshe sngon gnas mang po dran/ yi ger 'bri nyan yod med sna tshogs 'dug pas ma bris/ de nas yar log rje nā ro par bdag bsnyen rdzogs bsgrub dgos par gsol pas/ dgyes bzhin par de rang 'gab/ mkhan po yang sngar rgyun yin pas chos lung tshogs pa'i mkhan po spyan 'dren gsungs pa phebs/ slar sgar bteg 'bri gung du slebs/ chos lung mkhan chen pa lhun rab chos mdzad du grags pa/ 'dul mngon sogs gsung rab rgya mtsho la dbang phyug pa jo gdan byed grwa'i mkhan po bzhag nas/ chos lung dang spos khang gi gzhi ba'i mkhan por bzhugs pa byams pa chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes grags pa de nyid spyan drangs/ rang lo bco brgyad pa mngal dang bshol brtsis pas nyi shur tshang ba'i skabs pho brang bkra shis tshugs su mkhan po de nyid dang*/ las kyi slob dpon rab 'byams smra ba lung rigs rgya mtsho sogs dad pa'i dge 'dun bcu phrag grangs tshang gi drung du bdag cag mched grogs gsum bsnyen par rdzogs/

de nyin dkar po'i gral tshes bco lnga yin pas de nub nam mkha'i rna ba dang srid gsum rnam rgyal lhan cig 'dzoms pas/ sras sgra gcan 'dzin bltams pa sogs kyang zla ba sgra gcan zhugs pa dang dus mtshungs pa sogs gsung rab kyi gleng gzhi dang dus mtshungs pas rten 'brel shin tu legs par mthong*/ de nas mkhan chen dam pa de nyid kyi drung du/ phur pa sa lugs kyi dbang rdzas dkyil 'khor/ dgyes rdor man ngag lugs ras bris/ tshe dpag med lha dgu slob dpon dze ta ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i lugs rdul tshon la brten pa/ gzhan yang gur zhal gyi rjes gnang rigs mang ba/ rnam sras dkar po/ dmar po skor gsum/ dur khrod bdag po sogs mang ba dang*/ mdo rtsa/ bu chog /paṇa chen shākya mchog gi bka' 'bum steng nas mdo rtsa'i dka' 'grel nyi ma'i shing rta/ las brgya'i dka' 'grel ba dan dkar po/ bslab bya dpag bsam 'dod 'jo/ gzhi gsum gyi cho ga bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho/ dbu ma'i stong thun/ lugs gnyis rnam 'byed/ tshad ma dang*/ phar phyin gyi spyi don/ legs bshad gser thur/ khro phu lo tsā ba'i man ngag brgya rtsa sogs mang du thob pa ni thob yig nang du gsal/ phar la dgongs pa yang zab kyi dbang lung*/ gshin rje tshe bdag gi dbang chog mu tig phreng ba/ pad gling pa'i drag po dmar chen thems med kyi lha dbang chen mo sogs thugs bzhed dang bstun pa phul/ de nas mkhan chen pa de nyid gtsang phyogs la phebs/ chos skyong zhal phyag gnyis pa spyir ye shes par song ba dang sgos su rang gi skye ba snga ma'i lhar song bas phrag dog mi yong yang gzhan don snying chu bsre ba sogs legs par bgyis/ de ltar gyi tshe rje zhwa dmar ba'i drung nas tshur 'khor ba nas bzung yang ri sgar pa'i sprang g.yog byas nas khams su chas pa'i bar rnams su 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ paṇa chen shāka mchog pa'i 'dul 'grel nyi ma'i shing rta/ ba dan dkar po/

bslab bya chen mo/ dbu ma'i stong thun/ lugs gnyis rnam 'byed sogs la yang gang grub sbyangs/ nged rang 'dzin shes 'bring tsam la go ba che rgyu rang med pa zhig yod pa la bsams/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dkar po shes rab 'phel ba'i sgrub thabs slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i lugs kyi bsnyen pa grangs tshad rdzogs pa thengs bdun grub rjes nyi zla gza' 'dzin dang 'phrad pa'i ma ṣa'i las sbyor rdzogs pa thengs nyi shu tsam byas pa thams cad la myu gu ring ba sor gsum tsam dang thung ba nas re re'i bar tsam ma skyes pa ye ma byung*/ rang re'i mkhan chen pa de nyid dbyangs can ma dkar mo dngos su grub pa'i grags pa de nyid don la yang gnas pa 'dug pas dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i rjes gnang brgya phrag gcig lhag pa thengs gsum zhus shing*/ bsnyen pa yang mang tsam bgyis/ deng dus kyi ban sngags rnams kyi bze gzong dang rnyed 'tshol khe bun 'bad rtsol byed pa las kyang mod mi dman pa'i shes rab dang blo gros la rtsol 'don byas pa de tshun chad nas/ deng sang phan chad 'dzin pa rang ha cang cher ma song yang*/ bzung ba rnams brjed dka' ba mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi go dka'i gnas gang 'dra zhig kyang thengs gsum rtog pa zhib 'jug byas na mi go ba mi srid nges pa 'di byung ba yin/ de nas grwa tshang gi sprang g.yog du song bas rang yul du sdod pa la ni skyil krung 'tsho bas bshigs nas/ rkang 'gro lag rkyong gi brtul zhugs ming snyan la bsod snyoms dang gdul bya/ ming ngan la phyogs med du sprang ba'i phyir klung shod brgyud sgar bteg yar lam byang rwa sgreng gi gnas mjal/ jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje'i ral gri la thams cad kyis lces 'byogs pa'i lugs 'dug pas/ bdag gis kyang lces lnga drug tsam 'byogs pa'i tha ma'i tshe lce la rma med par khrag mang du zag byung bas/ de'i gong du chos dang gtam gang yang smra ba'i tshe cung zad mi bde zhing mgyogs dig 'dra zhig yod pa de rmang nas med par/

kha lce lcog rgan ma las bde ba zhig byung*/ de nas thog mar byang brgyud rgyal po 'bri gung pa'i sku tsha gdong dmar dpon karma g.yul rgyal gyi ru ba dang lhan cig 'dzoms shing go bsu sogs lha min gyi rgyal po'i dpung las kyang ches brjid pa'i bsu ba dang bcas nya chu glang dil sar sgar phab/ hor stod pa'i dpon a bsod kyis 'bri gung sde dgon gyi sbra kha 'ga' zhig phyags pa'i gshor bslangs/ byang gnam mtsho do'i gnas mjal la phyin/ bkra shis do bo che'i steng du dpon karma g.yul rgyal dang tsha zhang lhan cig gsol mchod bsang gi cho ga rgyas par byas/ der nam mkha' nas me tog gi char pa dang 'ja' sprin dang mtsho'i kha dog margad bzhus pa lta bu'i dbus su slob dpon chen po padma'i phyag gi rjes 'o ma'i mdog ltar phyag ngar dang bcas pa'i rjes kun gyis mjal/ hor rje rgyal pos rta dkar po gyi ling gi gar mtshan rdzogs pa'i rna thag bkra shis kha btags yug gis byas pa'i sne mo bdag gi lag par bzhags nas spyir rgyal khams sgos 'bri hor rnams la nyer 'tshe med pa dang*/ yang sgos la rkang phran ye med pas rkang phran gcig gnyis tsam 'byung ba zhig mdzad dgos zhes nan gyis gsungs par de ltar 'grub par khas blangs/ de nub rga lo phug tu gnas zhag bgyis pa'i tshe/ slob dpon chen pos sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe sgrub slob dpon dā na shrīs gnang ba las cung zad rgyas pa'i sgrub thabs dbang bskur lung bstan sogs stsal bar rmis pa ni lo rgyus logs su bris pa ltar yin/ nam langs pa'i tshe gnyan chen po thang lha 'khor dpag tu med pas phyag dang bsu ba byed pa mthong*/ nyi ma shar nas bkra shis do bo che'i rtser 'khod pa'i tshe mtsho nang du gnam mtsho phyug mo lha'i lus ltar mdzes pa rin po che du ma'i rgyan gyis spud pa lag g.yon rin po che'i gzhong pa rin po ches bkang ba zhig thogs/

g.yas pas gser gyi nya chen po ri de'u tsam la rin po che'i sga srab kyis brgyan pa'i sga gong du rin po che mdog sna tshogs pa'i 'od 'phro ba rgya rdza tsam zhig bkal ba'i nya'i sna thag gos yug dkar pos byas pa'i sne mo bdag la gtad pa der 'khod hor bod skya ser thams cad kyis mthong*/ mtsho'i nang nas ri de'u tsam zhig bkra shis do bo che'i ngos su nag khyur khyur 'ong ba mthong bas/ mtsho nang gi ma ka ra sogs srog chags ma rungs pa zhig 'jigs pa byed du 'ong ngam snyam nas bred dngangs dang ca co 'byin par 'dug /rgyang nas se mo do mthong bas sngon spyan snga sher 'byung du gyur dus do der rang gzhan gyi don mang po bsgrubs pa'i sa bon btab pa gsal bar dran/ slar nya chur slebs nas sgar bteg lam du byang 'ba' rom brag mjal/ rdza del du hor dpon dang lhan cig gnas zhag bgyis te phug pa'i nang du bdag gis nyal/ sgo 'gag du hor dpon gzims/ de nub nyams snang mang bar byung zhing*/ lhag par tho rangs gnod sbyin gang bzang chas gos dkar po can byung nas bdag la gus gus ltar byas/ bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa 'dul ba'i lugs ltar byin/ phyi nangs hor dpon gyis mdang brag phug sgo 'dir lab sgra rdog sgra ye nas mang po byung*/ phug pa'i nang du yang lab lob mang po byed grags pa de ci yin nam gsungs pas zur tsam las ma zhus/ lar nya chu 'ba' rom gnam mtsho sogs su nyams rmi lam dngos sum mtha' yas pa zhig byung ba dang*/ de min gyi rnam thar 'dir 'bri 'os da lta'i bar du mang ba rang zhig 'dug kyang che long sa bcad tsam ma gtogs/ da ni na tshod kyis gtugs shing mig mi bkra| lag pa 'khob/ sos dal la dga' bas yig tshogs mang po 'bri bar shin tu 'tsher ba zhig 'dug pas sa bcad tsam ma gtogs 'di phyin 'bri ma lcogs pa yin/ de nas 'dam gyi gad skya lkog tu ru sgar lhan cig tu phab/

mchod rten nag 'bal sngo 'bal ser 'bal sogs mjal/ lhag par mchod rten nag 'bal gyi 'og nas dpal ldan 'brug pa'i rtogs ldan 'ga' zung gis gnyan srin gi nad bdag mo gter du bzhes pa'i shul de yang mthong bas/ slob dpon padma dus gsum sa ler mkhyen pa'i gsung gis gter nas khyi ro min shos gang yang 'byung zhes gsungs pa thugs mad/ dpal ldan 'brug pa'i rtogs ldan rnams nyams rtogs bzang zhing rgyal khams 'grim sems can thams cad la 'brel ba sna tshogs pa 'jog pas de 'dra'i zab gter 'don pa yang sngar ma byung phyis mi 'byung ba'i gnas su 'dug pas ngo mtshar dang ya mtshan che ba a la la/ rtsod dus kyi 'gro ba rnams mchod gnas gter ston de 'dra 'dug pas skal ba bzang*/ sku bsod che/ sku tshogs mthar phyin pa 'dug go// oṃ ru lu ru lu ma ṇi padme hūm̐ dang hūm̐/ de nas mtsher der dpon tshang gi sbra nag lan tshwa'i rgya mtsho mer ba lta bu'i nang du hor rgyal po karma g.yul rgyal ni gdengs can dbang po ltar lhun chags par bzhugs/ de'i mi bzang 'jig rten gyi chos tshul mtha' dag chub pa rnams kyis nam mkha'i rna ba la rgyu skar gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba ltar bag dro ba'i khrod du/ bdag cag rnams kyis dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa bya rog mtshan can gyi sgo nas gtor mas srung zlog las sgrub pa slob dpon chen po nag po'i zhabs dang dril bu pa rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags pa'i lugs/ dpal rga lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal gyis bod du bsnams pa khams pa a seng dang bde gshegs phag gru'i phyag bzhes/ rgyal dbang ratna'i mtshan can gyis mdo khams nas spyan drangs shing phrin las kyi gzhung bstan srung mtshon cha zhes pa rje btsun ratna'i gsung rtsom ltar gtor zlog bya mgo ma bca' gzhi 'bring po la man ngag lag len gyi phyag bzhes cung zad yod pas brgyan pa ltar bcas/ de'i tshe hor dpon gyis 'cham sogs 'bri gung sos gtor chen mo ci 'dra bar gyis gsungs par/

zhag bdun phrag gcig lhag par bsgrubs nas nang rtags rdzogs pa'i tshe nyer dgu'i snga dro rnga 'cham brub 'cham bdag rang gis gtsos zor 'cham dang sgo dbye sogs rgyas par byas pa'i dgong mo gtor chen yang deng sang gi ban sngags phal gyi phyag len gtor ma khyi ro ltar lam dbrag tu bor ba ma yin par/ sde brgyad spyi dang bye brag gi thebs zlog 'jam gsum gyi gnad dag bstun nas gtor ma 'phang ba sogs gnad thebs dang ldan par byas nub/ hor dpon rgyal pos lag rte'u son pa na gcig pa shel thig ces pa rta mchog gi mtshan nyid phal cher nges par tshang ba de srab mda' bkra shis pa'i dar gyis byas pa bdag gi lag tu gtad/ rta 'dis mdo khams lan gnyis bskor phyis rdzong du na tshod kyi khur ma theg pas lnga par thal ba'i tshe dpral bar lha sku dang rus bu la ring bsrel mang bar byung 'dug /nga rang shi dus ring bsrel mi 'byung ba rta'i ring bsrel de yang a la la/ de'i tshe bdag gis hor dpon la sras gnyis 'byung ba'i dang po la nga rang gi ming las gras pa thogs zhus pas/ phyis bdag mdo khams su yod thog a nyog snga ma rigs rtsal dang ldan pa dpa' zhing brtul phod pa rnam par gnon pa'i dpal du ma dang ldan pa de nged rang gi a ce dpon sa mgo mgo bya ba la mtsher mal de nyid du dpon tshang gi sbra phub pa zhig gi dus stag lor btsas 'dug pa/ phyis thar 'don gyi tshe zhabs drung spro lung gi bde gshegs de phebs 'dug par yang*/ a nyog gi mtshan nged rang gi ngag bsgos pa ltar dkon cog ces par btags 'dug /de nas rim gyis bteg cing hor rgyal po dang a ce mi bzang mang po dang lhan cig rdzong kha bar du skyel ma dang thugs 'phreng ba'i rnam pa mdzad/ bdag kyang thag ring du 'gro dgos par ji ltar yong snyam sems 'phreng ba byung yang*/ slar bsam par rang nyid yar ma 'khor bar zhang mtshan mchod yon gang la yang nyes skyon med pa shes pas bag bro/

der rngod pa dang nag shod gnyis ka nas ja 'dren dang 'bod mi byung yang*/ da res rngod du 'gro bar shar/ a la rong rgyud phyin pa'i dbu ru dmar nel du bsdad nub rngod lung pa'i gzhi bdag gis bsu ba dang tho rangs mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po mjal zhing dus gsum gyi 'gyur tshul mtha' yas pa gsungs/ rim gyis bgrod nas mdor slebs/ ya ngan sribs pa'i rta bsu sogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas rgyal brag rtsar sgar btab/ mdo nga dgon rnying jog dgon par gsar spos byas pa'i bla ma spang mda' ba bkra shis dar rgyas yin pas der phyin/ grwa pa rnams kyis bsu ba ser sbreng dang bcas bsnyen bkur tshad med pa bshams/ bla brang du bstan srung a phyi'i rten 'dzugs pa sogs bgyis/ slar sgar du slebs nas rngod smad pa rnams nas nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor gza' skar dus sbyor bzang por bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po rdul tshon la bzhengs te gong ma'i phyag bzhes ji lta ba mi bar khyis ma chod pa'i lugs kyi sgrub dbang phyag len rgyas pa'i lugs ltar bgyis pa'i tshe/ nyin re bzhin 'ja' 'od me tog gi char dang*/ dkyil 'khor chen por lus med pa'i phyag dang skor ba byed mkhan mang po'i 'dzab sgra sgrog pa sogs ngo mtshar gyi ltas bgrang las 'das pa byung mod/ de dag rang nyid kyi yon tan yin pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal ba ga la rigs/ rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol lag len gnad ma 'chug cing slob dpon dang slob ma sogs phun sum tshogs pa lnga tshogs kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba las byung ba yin par sems la shar/ bdag gis dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba grub nas 'dus pa rnams grol zhing*/ bdag dang bla ma rtogs ldan be ri ba/ bla ma spangs mda' ba/ mchod g.yog dge slong phun tshogs tshe ring sogs bdag zla grogs 'ga' zhig bcas dkyil 'khor bskor zhing shar ngos nas bdag gis mdzub mo gtad de/

de ring dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor de 'di yin ang zhes smras pa'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar na yang dag gi bum pa'i steng du thod pa sgrub rten dang bcas bzhin pa steng gi nam mkha' la khru gang tsam 'phags nas ma ṇi phreng skor gcig tsam bgrang ba'i yun du bya lding ba ltar bsdad/ slar ma 'khrugs par mañdzi'i steng du bab song bas/ de'i ring der 'khod thams cad kyis rig pas ha las pa ltar mig had de bltas nas bsdad/ slar de ring de 'dra'i ya mtshan mthong ba zhes thams cad dga' zhing tshim pa'i rnam pas sems rangs par byed 'dug tshul de lta bu ni 'phags yul du yang dag gi bka' bab slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra/ bod du yang dag gi bka' bab slob dpon nam mkha'i snying po yin pas de'i rten 'brel yin nam snyam/ de'i tshe 'cham sogs gong ma'i phyag len ltar grub nas rim gyis sgrub chen grol/ bdag gis bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi dbang sgrub byed pa'i thog ma 'di yin/ gzhan yang skya ser thams cad la rang rang gang 'dod pa'i theg pa gong 'og gi chos kyis tshims par byas/ zang zing gi 'bul nod kyang gya nom pa blangs shing theg pa chen po'i bsngo bas rgyas btab/ slar btegs te rngod gangs shod du sgar btab/ rngod stod pa rnams kyi 'dod pa ltar rig 'dzin padma gling pas lho brag sman mdo'i brag nas zab gter du bzhes pa bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho'i dbang sgrub dbu btsugs/ rtsa ba'i dbang bskur rdzogs chen dbang gi phreng ba rdul tshon du bzhengs shing*/ bla med kyi dkyil 'khor gzhan bcu gsum po rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid lte ba bsgyur ba gong ma'i phyag bzhes yin pa ltar bsgrubs/ dam par rlom pa la la dag gis thos grol sogs la skye bdun sbyar nas sgrub pa'i phyag len gya ma do mthong yang*/ de lta ma yin par zab chos 'di nyid rang du skye bdun sgrub pa gsungs pa ltar rdzas dang yo byad phab rgyun sogs mtshan nyid tshang ba 'du byas te dge slong zag pa bral ba bcu phrag tsam gyis ril bu bsgril/

kha dog bsgyur/ legs par skams pa dril bur gzhal ba khal gnyis dang bre bco brgyad byung bar bum par bkang zhing rgya dang bcas dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su bkod nas/ thugs rje chen po'i bskyed sgom dang hrīḥha ra pañtsa'i 'dzab kyi sgra nyin mtshan kun tu ma chad par dus drug tu khrus gsol dang byin 'bebs sogs lugs 'di nyid rang la dgos nges rnams chad pa'i skyon dang*/ mi dgos pa 'thad legs dang chos brgyad kyi kha 'gengs byed pa lhag pa'i skyon gnyis ka spangs pas zhag bdun phrag nas grub pa'i rtags gzhung ltar du mthong*/ la las nye gnas kyis mtshan mo ril bu sgrub khang steng shod dang chu 'gram du gtor nas phyis ril bu 'phur 'dug zer ba sogs kyang bdag gis ni mi shes/ gang ltar yang bum pa zhal phyes shing kun gyis mthong bar slar dril bu la gzhal bas khal gsum dang bre bco brgyad du 'phel ba rnams der tshogs kyi 'dus pa ches mang ba la bkyes/ de ltar dbang bskur grol nas/ rngod lung par sngon drung pa shākya badzra'i phyag bzhes bzang por yul de'i ri klung gi rgya sogs gang spyi'i 'gan dgon pa bcu gsum gyis mdzad pa zhig yod 'dug kyang*/ phyis sems can rnams bsod nams mod dman cing*/ dgon pa rnams kyang thos bsam sgom pa kho bas nga e lhag snyam pa yar lta'i 'gran sems ni med/ rang rang gi grub mtha' sogs brtsad pas nang mi mthun pa sel bur song 'dug pas 'bad brtson rnam grangs du ma'i ngos nas dngos po gtong ba rnams yang ri sgar 'dus pa rang gi dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo rnams kyis btang ste/ dbre mdo ri khrod kyis gtsos dgon pa khag bcu gsum gyi 'dus pa rnams spyan drangs/ lhan cig tu tshogs pa'i zhal grangs khri las mi dman nges tshogs pa zhag gsum gyi bar du kha na ma tho ba spangs pa'i bza' bca' btung ba dge 'dun la 'os pa dag legs par bstabs shing bsnyen bkur/

de dag gi tshe sngar gnyen sde'i bca' yig drung shākya badzra gyis stsal ba nyid sor bzhag pa'i bca' yig gsar du kha gsal bar bris pa nyin re bzhin tshogs su yang ri sgar gyi mdzes chos pas bsgrags pa dang*/ bdag rang gis chos dang mthun pa'i tshogs gtam mnyes bshin pa bskyar nan kho nas phul/ grol ba'i nyin mo dgon rang so so'i chos skyong rnams kyi gtor ma so sor bshams nas bskyed bstim mchod bstod 'dzab bzlas mnga' gsol gyis mnyes par byas pa rnams dpang du btsugs nas/ dge 'dun 'dus pa dang yul mi bsam yod thams cad dam la bzhag cing bkar nas sngon gyi lugs bzang po ri mo gser gsos legs par bgyis pas/ sde dgon thams cad kyis yi rangs dang legs so'i sgra dbyangs kyis dbyar rnga'i nga ro bag 'khums pa tsam du bgyis/ de'i skabs shig yer spom dgon du phyin/ 'dod chos 'ga' yar dang bla brang du bstan srung chos kyi sgrol ma'i rten 'dzugs bgyis/ slar sgar pa bteg /rngod rnam rgyal dgon du sgar phab/ 'du khang du gzhi byes thams cad la kun rig gi dbang bskur rdul mtshon la brten pa dang gzhan yang 'dod chos mang du byin/ de'i skabs gzhi bdag sha ba ra mgos dam mnos shing skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa blangs/ de nas dgun dus su song ba kha ba cher bab cing grang reg kyang shin tu che ba byung bas sgar du ma bsdad par zhugs 'gram brten pa'i phyir rnam rgyal dgon gyi bla brang du bsdad/ bla ma be ri bkra shis bsod nams ye spom dang rnam rgyal dgon gnyis ka'i khur bzhes yin pas zhugs 'gram du dad gtam bgyis par/ bdag gis rgyal brag rtsar bka' brgyad dbang sgrub bgyis pa'i nyer bdun gyi nub 'khrul snang byung tshul 'phros shig btang bas cis kyang yi ger 'bri dgos zhes nan gyis gsungs par/ rgyal brag rtsar nyer bdun gyi thor thun la bab dus rmi lam du/ nga rang gi sring mo dpon sa dkon mchog dpal mo zer ba 'od kyi lam dkar po zhig las byung nas/

do nub kun tu bzang po'i pho brang du mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po 'khor rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i dbus su bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang stsol bar mchis kyi 'gro zer| bdag 'gro rtsis byas pas thag ring po zhig tu yul ljongs spro 'jigs sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i dbus su rdo rje'i brag dmar smug chos 'byung kho na brtsegs pa 'dra ba'i steng du gzhal med khang kho lag tshad med pa zhig 'dug pa'i sgor 'od lam de yar zug 'dug par bdag gnyis bgrod pas/ gzhal yas khang de'i nang du slebs pa'i tshe yol ba dang bla bre sogs tshad med pa'i gung du gdan seṅge'i khri chen por mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po yin rgyu ba bde gshegs 'bring po'i cha lugs su bzhugs/ de'i g.yas su bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor bcos ma'i dkyil 'khor min par 'od phung sna tshogs 'bar 'phro 'khrugs pa'i dbus su zhi khro bdun brgya nyer lnga gsal la rdzogs pa sku gar stabs/ gsung sngags sgra/ thugs ting nge 'dzin las mi g.yo bar bkra lam mer bzhugs 'dug /de dag gi g.yas g.yon rnams su 'bol stan mang po bshams 'dug par rig 'dzin bgres po dang dar ma dang gzhon pa'i rnam pa la la ni dge slong*/ la la ni sngags pa/ la la ni rgyal po'i cha lugs grangs las 'das pa zhal nas drag sngags so bdun ma dbyangs su sgrog cing*/ bdag la dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mang po mdzad kyi 'dug /bdag gis phyag phul bas mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po he ru ka'i cha lugs su bsgyings pa de sku gar stabs shigs shigs gsung gdangs chen pos ha ha a la la hoḥ e ma a hoḥ zhes gsungs/ yar 'gyu ba'i dbus der 'bol gdan zhig 'dug pa bdag rang gi yin rgyu ba byas 'dzegs nas bsdad pas dpon slob kun dgyes pa'i rnam grangs mdzad 'dug /de ma thag 'dus pa rgya mtshos phyag dang maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba btab pas/ he ru ka des dkyil 'khor phyi nang gi 'jug pa nas brtsams/

phyi nang gi rdzas dbang brgya rtsa brgyad/ lha dbang mchog dbang gong ma gsum/ rdo rje rgyal po'i bka' rab 'byams kyi dbang rnams gter byon dang khyad med par mdzad 'dug par/ dbang rdzas rnams ni 'ja' tshon las grub pa snang la rang bzhin med par sha stag 'dug /dbang grub nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo lhag gtor dang bcas pa da lta'i bka' brgyad las byang shī la ka ras mdzad pa 'di nyid rang gsung gi 'dug pas phyis las byang 'di la yang yid ches thob pa byung*/ de ltar grub nas rig 'dzin rnams phyir grol/ dkyil 'khor sogs mi snang bar mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po sngar zhal bzhugs pa'i dus kho na ltar bzhugs 'dug par/ bdag gis bdag sa thag ring por 'gro dgos pas thugs rjes bzung zhing bka' stsal kyang gnang ba gsol ba btab pas/ gtso bor lam zab mo bskyed rdzogs nyams su blang lugs/ gzhan yang phral dang yun gyi bslab bya mang bar gnang*/ phyag zhabs bzhi ka bdag gi spyi bor bkod de bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gtso bo thams cad kyi sngags mthar kā ya wā ka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing byin rlabs bka' gtad rtsal sprugs su gnang ba'i mod/ sngar gyi bu mo des khrid de 'od lam du 'ong bas rang gi mal sar slebs/ gnyid sad pa'i tshe snang ba la zhogs pa bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub chen gyi las gzhung la 'jug ran par bab 'dug /'di yang bla ma be ri ba la bris pa der 'di las tshig sna ring ba zhig yod kyang 'dir bsdus nas bris pa yin/ 'di skabs bla ma be ri ba'i gan du kong po 'tsho byed rgyal mtshan don grub zer ba pha phyogs nas bla ma be ri ba dang*/ ma phyogs nas 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa padma dkar po'i sku nyer 'gro ba sman pa mkhas nges shig 'dug pa bdag gi zlar 'brangs/ skra bcad pa'i ming la dkon mchog rgyal mtshan du btags/ phyis bdag rang gi gso dpyad kyi slob dpon bka' drin can du gyur pa de yin no// kye ma/

mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po'i drung*| |dngos dang rmi lam lan gnyis su// bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang sgrub stsal// rang sems gdod ma'i che mchog tu// ngos sprad gsang ming btags pa ni// che mchog las 'brel rtsal zhes gnang*// nga 'dra nyams chung gyi nas kyang*// skal bzang bdud rtsi de ltar thob// de ltar rnam rgyal dgon du bsdad pa'i nub cig lcags kyi a tsa ra sdo sangs mi rkang gi gling bu thogs pa zhig byung*/ khyod su yin gang nas 'ong ci 'dod dris pas nga ma hā kā lā tsa turmu kha yin/ kha'u brag rdzong nas 'ongs gtor ma byin zer/ khyod la sngon chad 'dris zhen che ba med par gtor ma slong ba ci yin smras pas/ ha ha mtshar che khyod rgya gar si ti'i yul mun chen dur khrod du gtum srung rnal 'byor du gyur pa'i tshe dang*/ yang bla ma gnyan gyi slob mar gyur pa'i tshe sogs bdag lus grib ltar 'grogs pa de yin zer bas gtor ma phul/ sgrub lugs sogs dris pas zhib tu smras byung ba dang snga rabs pa'i yig cha la khyad mi 'dug pas yid ches pa byung*/ de nas zla dgon pa'i 'bod mi byung bas sgar bteg ste shar kong la brgyud zla dgon dang nye bar zla dgon spyan snga bzod pa phun tshogs kyis gtsos pa'i rta bsu dang*/ 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis ser sbreng sogs bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen pos legs par bsus te dgon thang du sgar btab/ grwa nang so sos sne len tshad med pa mdzad/ 'du khang chen mor rig 'dzin padma gling pas sgam po dar gyi ri nas spyan drangs pa'i zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi dbang bzhi 'phrad tshad rang grol rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor steng nas bskur/ slar gzhi byes kyi gzhi khrid ma thob pa brgya phrag tsam 'dug par zab lam nā ro chos drug gi nyams khrid 'khrul 'khor sogs lag len zhib par byas shing*/ sdod yul mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i mgon khang du byas skabs rmi lam du bud med sngo sangs skra dang smin ma dmar ser du yod pa zhig gis do nub dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du dpal chen nā ro pas khyod shog gsungs pas khyod 'bod du 'ong ba yin zer/

de'i zlar phyin pas sa thag ring po zhig na dur khrod chen po shin tu 'jigs su rung ba zhig tu khrom chen po'i dbus su pha bong dkar po seng ge bsnol ba lta bu'i steng du mi lpags bkab pa'i gdan la he ru ka smug nag shin tu 'jigs pa zhig bzhugs 'dug pas bdag la dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mang po mdzad pa'i rjes su chos drug bsdus pa tshigs su bcad pa de gsungs shing*/ gzhan gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde mang po'i gnad 'gag dang gtum mo'i 'og sgo'i skor sogs zhal gdams bslab bya rgyas par stsal cing zhabs spyi bor bkod nas/ bde dgyes gsang gdan sgyu thod sogs kyi sngags mang po gsung zhing ljags chab gnang nas da song zhig gsungs pas bud med de dang bsdebs nas 'ong ba'i snang ba la gnyid sad pas thor thun la 'jug ran par 'dug /yang de skabs zur re ba yin pa'i grwa pa zhig thun tshod pa yin pa des 'khar rnga bcag /gnas dbyung byas pas zur re ba'i grwa pa zhig gis kho bsad pa red zer ba'i gtam ngan bsgrags/ grwa pa gzhan 'gas kyang de rjes 'brangs pas yid phyung*/ yang ri sgar pa rang gang bder bzhud/ nga rang re zhig zla dgon du bsdad| de nas gang du 'gro blta rgyu byed par thag bcad pa'i tshe/ zla dgon bla ma dang ban bon rnams dang*/ sgar rang gi ban mang thams cad kyis de ltar byas na mi 'thus shing gte po rnams gnas dbyung byed zer bar slar bsam pa zos/ gte po rnams kyis kyang chad sgrub tsam byas pas bzod par bgyis nas re zhig bsdad/ phyis zla dgon du log pa'i khas len dang dgon pa nas kyang spyil bu bzo zer ba'i bkod pa byas/ bde steng nas rgya ston sde pa'i 'bod mi ja 'dren byung ba ltar sgar bteg /nye bar phyin tshe thab bsu dang*/ rta bsu ser sbreng sogs rgya che bar byung*/ dgon dang nye bar sgar btab/ ngal gsos nas rgya ston chos rjes dbu byas gzhi byes kyi 'dus pa lnga brgya lhag tsam la rdo rje rnal 'byor mas slob dpon chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa la dngos su bstsal ba'i rdo rje phreng ba'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor nyer bdun ras bris dang*/

dus kyi 'khor lo rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas dbang bskur/ gzhan yang dbang lung khrid mang du bgyis/ slar sgar bteg /rim pas lam gyi mi ser dang dgon pa khag ru ba la sogs par so sor tshim pa'i 'dod chos byas| ba thang du sgar phab nas kong sman chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan par dngul chu gtso bkrus chen mo rje zur mkhar ba mnyam nyid rdo rje'i yig cha ji lta ba'i lag len dang*/ grub thob u rgyan pa'i dngul 'bum gyi dngul skam dang*/ dngul chu sha ltar bza' ba skom ltar btung ba/ rgod 'dul dang g.yung 'dul la sogs pa rnams dang*/ sman gzhung gi dgongs pa gser dngul zangs lcags bzhi sreg 'dul dang*/ man ngag rin chen thal sbyor gyi dgongs pa gser dngul zho thums su sreg pa'i lag len snyan brgyud zhal rgyun yi ge med pa'i skor rnams dang*/ a bhra ha ri nag po'i 'dul sbyong nas bzung rin chen ril bu grang sbyor che 'bring chung gsum dang de dag gi rjes 'brang mthun byed ril bu dang*/ gzhan yang sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa dang de'i 'grel pa zla zer/ klu sgrub kyi sbyor ba rgyas pa/ dpal ldan rgyud bzhi/ bye ba ring bsrel/ grangs can ma bu/ grangs med skor/ zin thig /yang thig /so ma ra dza la sogs pa rnams kyi lag len dka' gnad kyi dogs gcod sogs dpyis phyin pa sbyangs shing*/ de yang 'tsho byed de nyid bshad pa dang lag len gnyis ka la byang ba dang*/ nged cag sa gcig tu mi 'dug par ri klung kun la rgyu ba'i stabs kyis sngo sman gyi sde tshan so so'i skye sa yul gyi khyad par/ pho mo rgod g.yung sogs sngo sman phal cher rigs gsum gsum du dbye ba dang*/ rdo sman rnams kyang deng sang gi sman pa phal gyis lag tu blang ba lta zhog /ming tsam yang ma thos pa mang po dang*/ shing gi rigs sger ming spyi la btags pa thang shing lta bu la mtshon na/

thang dkar/ thang nag /thang sgron/ thang ma/ gor tsan/ thang shug gam mdung shing nags ma sogs dbye ba/ shug pa la rgya shug /bod shug /stag shug /shug pa tsandan| shug tsher sogs des mtshon pa'i dbye ba/ gzhan yang 'tsho mdzad de nyid dpyad don la yang mkhas par 'dug pas sman la mkho ba'i rin po che'i rigs kyang*/ ji skad du ljon shing las| brtan g.yo zhu dang mi zhu ba'i// khams las grub pa'i rin chen rnams// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ brtan g.yo zhu ba'i khams las grub pa gser dngul zangs lcags tshon mo steng sogs kyi gser la dbye na/ yu gur gyi gser/ stag lag gi gser/ gu lang gi gser/ bod gser dmar po/ gser nag po/ dngul la/ sog dngul| rdo dngul/ gying sha ra dngul/ lug dngul/ ha yang ho sogs/ zangs la stod zangs/ smad zangs/ ljon dmar/ ljon skya/ rang byung gi zangs sogs/ lcags la rong lcags| brag lcags rtsa lcags sogs/ de bzhin du brtag dka' ba shel rigs rnams dang*/ rdo rigs la byu ru dkar dmar/ mu men la/ gser mu men/ rdo mu men/ mu men phal pa/ srog chags las byung ba/ mu tig dkar po/ dmar po/ nag po/ gandza mu tig /da hor mu tig la sogs pa mtha' yas pa so so'i mtshan nyid dang dbye ba byed las rnams byang bar mkhyen la/ gzhan yang gsung rab mdo sngags kyi phyogs la yang go babs legs pa/ rig gnas la snyan ngag ni shin tu byang ba/ bzo pa tra'i lag len yang 'ga' zhig mkhyen pa sogs te/ mdor na blo ldan mkhyen pa'i nor gyis phyug pa de nyid kyi bcu cha tsam yang bdag lta bu'i gang zag gzhan dbang can gyis shes pa ga la srid/ 'on kyang ji skad du/ ri rab gser gyi ngos la gnas pa yi// bya yi rang bzhin rnams kyang gser du snang*// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mkhas pa bsten na mkhas par 'gyur zhing*/ blun po bsten na blun por 'gyur ba yang chos nyid du snang ba'i phyir/ mkhas pa de'i drin las bdag gis kyang sngags gcig gi brtul zhugs 'dzin ma dgos tsam bslabs pa yin no// deng sang dpe cha rkang gang re snam phrag tu bcug nas nga'i zab khyad nga'i khyad chos zhes mgo bo gyen du 'degs/

sngo sman sogs sna re'i bcos la sba gsang dang phrag dog khor yug tu byed/ mkhas pa dang phrad na khyad du gsod cing bag 'khums pas legs bshad brdar sha gcod pa'i gleng mo bgyis na kha skam/ dpral ba rngul/ 'dug mi bzod/ blun po tshogs pa'i dbus su bsgyings stabs kyis rang bstod gzhan smod nga che nga gnyan nga bden gyis lung pa 'gengs/ nad pa shi na sngon las dang nad lhag gdon rkyen la khag 'dogs/ nad pa sos na a pho ngas byas/ sngo sman 'dis gsos/ khyad chos 'dis 'tshengs/ rta khyer shog /mdzo khyer shog sogs za 'dod ngo tsha med kyis lung pa 'gengs pa'i sman pa rnams dang 'o cag ni rigs mi mthun pa snang ste/ slob dpon chen po padmas/ bur sgog sha chang dri ma mi gcig par// so sor 'byung ltar zhes sogs gsungs pa dang*/ yang mi re'i lag na rtsis kyi shog khra re// rmongs khyu tshogs nas mkhas pa skyar la 'don// zhes gsungs pa sogs dang tshul 'dra bar snang mod kyi/ 'on kyang drang zhing gsong por smra ba gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po bzhugs mchis pas a la la hoḥ de nas der 'khor gyi sde dgon rnams dang*/ gzhan yang gling rdzong dang tsha 'boms dgon sogs nas grwa par byed mi yang shin tu mang zhing*/ so sor 'dod pa tshim pa'i rnam dkar gyi 'brel pa bzhag /byang rta rnar 'byor pa'i tshe gling gi dpa' brtul sum cu gling rje ge sar dang bcas pas bzhengs pa'i 'bum mjal ba na/ ge sar gyis bzhengs pa'i 'bum gyi kha byang du/ ge sar khri srong lde'u btsan yin// mchod gnas slob dpon padma yin// 'brug mo ye shes mtsho rgyal yin// zhes sogs 'dug pas ge sar 'di rgyal po khri srong gi rjes su byung bar 'dug |shar yel phug tu phyin/ der bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas yel pa'i sku la byin rlabs zhus pas sku brnyan gyis bzhad pa sogs byung*/ mnyam med dwags po'i sman sgro bzhugs pa'i mchod rten la skor phyag byas pa'i tshe sman gyi dris kun la khyab pa byung*/

mchod khang gog po zhig 'dug mchod rten sprel khog mar grags pa dpal phag mo gru pa spre'u g.yu'i smin ma can du skye ba bzhes pa'i gdung bzhugs pa zhig 'dug pa yang mjal/ sngar byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal ba'i phyag tu spre'u g.yu'i smin ma can gyi dbu thod sku dang yig 'bru du ma rang byon du phebs shing*/ spre'u'i thod pa dkyus ma bas che tsam zhig bzhugs 'dug pa bdag gis kyang mjal/ de'i grwa pa rnams kyis bdag dpon slob mdo khams su byon dus shar yel phug gi mchod rten sprel khog ma nas byang bdag rin po ches rdzu 'phrul gyis padma dang bum pa'i mtshams nas phyag gis btegs te spre'u'i thod pa zhus pa yin zhes grags grags mor mdzad kyi 'dug /phyis bdag rang yel phug tu slebs mchod rten sprel khog mar bskor ba byas pa'i tshe mchod rten de'i rgyab logs bum pa'i stod tsam na bre'i kha rgya tsam gyi bug pa zhig 'dug /mchod rten de grang gser gyis gar bus byugs par/ bug pa de gnas de ka'i 'jim pa phal pa zhig gis bkag 'dug pas/ phal cher sprel thod bug pa de nas rdzu 'phrul gyis zhus pa 'dra 'dug go// gzhan yang cham la khar 'byor dus gsal stong sgom sho'i sgrub gnas mi g.yel phug mjal bar phyin dus der sgom sho dang dge ma ra dge lug dge gnyis dang bcas bzhugs pa dang*/ cham stod smad kyi 'khrug pa bsdums pa sogs sngon gnas mang po dran/ yang khams pa rnams deng sang mdzod ces zer/ gzhan khams kyi gla ba rkang gcig tu the'u rang thams cad dam la btags zer ba de yin pa 'dug pas mjal du phyin/ gnas de gangs kyis lam chod pas bgrod dka' ba 'dug kyang 'bad pas phyin/ da lta gnas sgo ma bye ba zhig yin 'dug pas lo rgyus ni 'chad mkhan mi 'dug /mjal bas kha ba'i khrod kyi brag logs shin tu che ba gyang lta bu'i ngos su go sbus byed kyi rnam pa sgo'i ru bzhi la padma mchod tshags sogs shing la bcos pa lta bu kha dog nag po la sgo'i me long gnyis dmar srub dang bcas pa zheng khru nyi shu tsam dang dpangs thog so bco lnga tsam yod pa ngo mtshar che ba zhig dang*/

de'i g.yon du mi ring bar brag gi rtsa bar mchod rten rnying pa mi tshad tsam ngo mtshar can 'dug pa mjal zhing don gnyis 'grub pa'i smon lam btab/ gnas de ma 'ongs pa'i dus su bdag rang gi skye ba zhig gis sgo 'byed pa'i mtshan ma zhig kyang mthong*/ de'i brag ldebs g.yas su lag pa gnyis ka'i rjes kyang gsal bar yod/ g.yang chen pho brang du dpon slob mgar gyi dgon par bos| zhag shas bsdad cing gdugs tshod bsnyen bkur gyi dga' ston rgya cher mdzad cing dpon slob mgar de yang sngon bla ma gtsang chung yin pas smon lam gyi 'brel bas bdag la shin tu dgyes pa zhig yod pas ri bo che bar bdag gi zlar phebs pa yin/ nang chen sgar du bos nas 'bul nod dang bsnyen bkur gya nom pa mdzad/ rdza mo phug tu skyo brag ting 'dzin bzang pos bos/ gdugs tshod dus su rung ba'i sman gyis bsnyen bkur/ nang chen grwa nang yon mchod thams cad la so sor 'dod chos kyi bdud rtsi'i ros tshim par byas/ rdza shing khang dmar mdor rgyal ba'i dbang po chos dbyings rdo rje yang lcags kyi pho rog sha khyer byas pa yang mjal/ rje de sku na phra ba rang yin yang thugs spyang zhing dkyil che ba zhig 'dug pas bdag la yang shin tu dgyes par mdzad| der karma pa gung bzhuḍa kyi ja gral la yang ri drung pa sha rog pas dbus gtsang du yab sras kyi mjal 'dzoms dang*/ gtsang yar gyi sde gzar sogs thugs la brnag pa'i gro ma dang gro mtshon gyi dpe'i gsung sgros mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i sgo nas mang du mdzad byung*/ cham la khar rin chen tsha grang gnyis ka'i sbyor ba rgyas pa phon che bar yang byas| de nas rim gyis sgar btegs te par thang dang khra bo la brgyud 'dan lung par slebs pa'i tshe brag ri chen po zhig gi zhol du chu'i 'khris thang chung nge ba zhig tu nged rang rta rags rnams kyis bab nas ja skol ba'i tshe/ brag logs nas rnga zhig rdung byung bas zla bo rnams ja skol ba'i ring*/

dge slong phun tshogs tshe ring dang*/ dge bshes ba thel nged gsum brag logs rnga rdung sa der phyin pas/ brag phug gting ring po zhig du sngags pa rgan dar zhig 'dug /de dang skad cha byas pas da lan khra bo lar mi khal mang po 'grims byung ba sog po min nam snyam 'dug pa la su yin zhes dris byung bas/ 'bri gung yang ri sgar pa yin/ nga yang 'di ltar yin zhes bshad pas/ 'o na nga yang skyu ra yin skyabs su mchi zer/ skyu ra sha nye 'grigs| phug pa de ji ltar yin dris pas/ bstan srung chos kyi sgrol ma mi'i zol la brten nas rigs sras bzhi bskrun pa'i mthar phug pa'i de'i nang du phebs/ rgya gar gyi dur khrod nas bam blangs tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad cing rjes 'jug rnams la bslab bya lung bstan mthar phyin pa mdzad nas sku lus de nyid kyis mkha' spyod du gshegs pa yin/ phug pa 'di la phug pa gting ring zer/ zhes sogs rgyal dbang ratnas a phyi'i rnam thar ljags bsgrigs mdzad pa dang tshig sna ring thung tsam ma gtogs don la khyad par spu tsam med pa bshad byung bas yid ches pa byung*| 'dan stod brag rtsa zhes par slebs/ de ni 'gru mi 'gyur thar pa'i gnas brgyad las/ 'dan stod brag rtsa skyu ras bzung*// skyu ra mi 'gyur 'gru gcig yin// brag rtsa mi 'gyur gnas gcig yin// zhes pa de yin 'dug /brag ldebs phal thog lnga bcu lhag nges tsam gyi sar shug phung zhig 'dug pa sngar lha khang khra mo'i gser 'phru dang mnyam zer/ brag logs der yig 'bru'i rigs rdo dkar gyi skyo mas bris pa 'dra ba bgrang las 'das pa 'dug /de skabs sga 'dan skyur gsum gyi lung par sog dogs che bar 'dug pas/ sa lugs kyi dgon pa bcas sku mgo zer ba zhig tu nged tshos kyang btsan sa 'chos pa sogs dgon pa dang 'dod mnyam byed rtsis yod par/ 'brog pa rta mi ral pa can sum cu tsam zhig slebs byung bas nged rnams skyu ra yin 'bri gung chos rje bsu bar yong zer bas/

de rnams dang bsdongs te de nub rtsibs klung mo che dang nye bar sgar phab/ bdag zla bo gsum dang bcas rtsibs klung mo che'i skyob pa'i gzims phug tu gnas zhag bgyis pa'i tshe/ nyams rmis shin tu mang ba byung zhing phug pa'i brag mthil 'bur mo zhig gi mgor skyob pa rin po che'i zhabs rjes che chung sogs rdo rje gsang lam ma dang khyad med pa ngo mtshar shin tu che ba sngar sus kyang ma rnyed pa zhig phyi nangs rnyed pas thams cad yid ches par 'dug /phyi nangs sgar bteg pa'i lam bar du/ grong khyer rtsong ngu 'dug pa da lta ni re hrul rgya che ba 'dug /de nas mda' rgyang gang tsam du phyin par ri de'u 'bur tsam zhig 'dug pa'i rtser pha bong zhig 'dug par/ rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i yum gyis sku rgyab gtad nas 'khrungs pa'i tshe de ka'i mdun du skyob pa rin po che sku btsas ma thag pa'i zhabs rjes dang*/ de'u de'i zhol du chu phran chung ngu rgyun 'bab pa zhig 'dug pa'i 'gram du skyob pa nyid byis pa'i tshul mdzad tshe'i zhabs rjes shin tu mang ba 'dug /de nas bteg pa'i bar sga stod lha sgra zhes pa spyan sda 'bri gung gling pa 'khrungs pa'i grong de dang nye bar sgar btab/ der paṇḍi ta smṛ ti dzñā nas yum gyi don du ra rdzi mdzad/ ra'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i rde'u bsags nas nyin re rde'u rnams bkram pa'i dus su ra phyugs rnams gzas la bkram| rde'u rnams bsdus pa'i tshe phyugs rnams nang du 'du ba'i rdzu 'phrul dang bcas yun ring mdzad pa'i mthar/ rdzi bo thon pa'i gla rngan len pa'i tshe kho bo la gla rngan gzhan mi 'tshal/ gnas tshang gi sgyed rdo 'di dgos gsungs/ phul ba bcag pas sgyed rdo'i nang du yum sdig pa'i lus blangs pa phyung nas gnas spar zhing ro bsregs pa'i thal sol dang*/ ra phyugs kyi grangs mnyam rde'u rnams lhan cig bzhugs pa'i mchod rten 'dug pa sogs mjal ba'i tshe grub thob brgyad cu'i gtso bo sa ra has mdzad pa zhal mjal/

de nas rim gyis glang chen dgon du sgar phab/ gzhi bdag klu bdud shin tu ma rungs pa zhig 'dug par dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa phog /dgon de sa lugs yin yang rang re'i grwa rigs bla ma rin rgyal ba zer ba zhig gis ma bskos bla ma mdzad 'dug pa khong grwa nang gis shin tu gus shing*/ der sgar zhag bco lnga tsam bsdad/ de tshor dgun dus spyir grang ba dang lhag par lung pa byang khar song bas sa yul grang ba'i dpe byed sa/ sha tshag lug 'khyags pa rnams sta re sogs lar mi 'gro ba tho ba dang pang rdzog gis gse dgos kyi 'dug par/ bdag ras kyang gi brtul zhugs 'dra ba zhig yin pas nub mo thams cad du rlung dmigs 'khrul 'khor ci yang mi dgos par gtum mo yid la dran tsam gyis bde drod 'bar ba zhig yod/ lar deng sang gi grub thob rnams kyis ras gos bzhes pa tsam la mi thams cad ha las pa rdo rje 'chang byon pa tsam byed 'dug kyang*/ gtum mo'i gzhung du thun mong gi bogs 'don dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bogs 'don gsungs par drod dang bde ba ni thun mong ltar snang ba dang*/ mi rtog pa ni thun mong ma yin pa don dam pa'i yon tan du gsungs 'dug pas/ bdag la de 'dra'i khams chen gyi re ba ci la yod/ 'on kyang 'jig rten kha gtam du btsag 'grogs dang rams 'grogs zer ba bden 'dug pas/ rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen pa de'i bka' drin gyis dus nam yang gtum mo yid la byas pa tsam gyis drod 'bar ba drod kyi rang bzhin bde nyams kyis gang ba/ bde drod gnyis ka'i ngo bo mi rtog par lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su cham cham 'gro ba sha stag byung*/ de yang rang blo ma dag pa'i bsam tshod la/ gtum mo bde drod mi rtog pa yan lag bdun ldan gyi ngo bor grol ba zhig ma byung na/ gos gyon mi dgos pa ni dud 'gro phal cher la 'dug cing*/ dgun dus chu ras byas pa la ya mtshan byed pa yang lhan skyes kyi ye shes ma skyes na/

dgun dus ras chus sbags pa dros pa tsam las nya sbal sogs dgun dus chu nang du gnas pa khams che ba 'dra bsam ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ de'i tshe yon mchod thams cad kyis 'bul nod dang*/ gser kha dang thag nye bas gser mang du byung ba yang dge slong gi blang byar bkag kyang dmigs bsal du sum brgya par gos dang rgyags chos ldan gyi phyir blang bar gsungs pas chos ldan gyi phyir yin na khams che/ gos dang rgyags phyir rang yin na deng sang 'jig rten pa rnams kyang 'thab rtsod sde gzar sogs byed pa yang rtsa ba zas gos la thug pa yin mod/ 'on kyang rung ba gsum gyis blang ba 'dul ba mdo nas gsungs pa ltar ma brjed tsam byas nas blangs/ so sor yon chud mi 'dza' ba'i bsngo smon gyis rgyas btab/ slar 'dan dang skyu ra sogs su phyin/ khams skyo che tshang gi nyin rdzong mgo'i zhol du sgar btab/ nyin rdzong du bos 'bul nod mang du byas/ bla ma nam mkha' rin chen pa/ dbon po dkon mchog grags pa/ dbon po dkon mchog bzang po rnams kyang sgar du byon/ slar khams skyo chung tshang gi lha khang gzhogs su sgar phab/ 'bul nod rgya che ba dang dbon po dkon mchog chos skyong ba sgar du byon/ der lung pa zhig gi gsham chu 'gram du pha bong chen po sngo sang nge ba leb mo zhig la/ skyob pa rin po che'i sku na phra ba'i tshul bstan nas gzhan gyi gsung rab sgrog pa'i tshe yon la ra chen po zhig phul ba khrid nas yum gyi sar phebs pa'i lam du/ byis pa chung bas ra ma thub par pha bong de la zhabs gtad mdzad pa'i pha bong gi steng dang logs thams cad du byis pa'i zhabs rjes dang ra'i rjes 'dres pa zhig 'dug pa mjal/ dran thang chu 'gram zhig tu dpal phag mo gru pa'i 'khrungs yul da lta tsha khang zhig 'dug pa yang mjal/ gzhan yang lung pa de rnams su rang re'i gnas dge'u dgon sogs mang du 'dug pa rnams kyis so sor bos shing bsnyen bkur bstabs/

skyo rongs dbon po sogs grwa rgyun yang mang ba byung*/ gzhan yang zil 'khor lo mdo zhes par bon po a khyung bla ma zhes pa'i sras la rgya nag 'jig pa'i lce mdung dang ser 'bebs zab mo'i rigs 'ga' zhig zhus/ rting lung zhes par/ bon po mkhas pa zhig la dbang phyug gi gtad khram dang ser 'bebs sogs zhus/ rna tsha grong mo che zhes pa'i sdes sgar pa la mi 'tshams pa'i las byas par chu 'khyag drag po phab nas tshar bcad phyis kyi ban sngags yongs kyi bstan pa la phan par byas/ ri bo cher slebs skabs thang du sgar btab| chos rje sku skye dang khri thog pa gnyis ka dang mjal 'phrad lugs legs byas/ khyad par chos rje khri thog pa dang nang gtsang ba byung zhing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems sogs nang rten rnams zhib par mjal/ mchod khang chen mor dgyes rdor grwa tshang ba rnams la drag po pad gling pa'i dbang sogs bgyis/ ri bo che'i sde pas shin tu mos shing hor dril khyad can dang hor gyi ting shag sogs byin/ phur pa sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter ma'i dbang sogs phul/ gzhan ri bo che pa grwa nang thams cad kyis dad 'dun shin tu che ba byas/ der rin chen grang sbyor rgyas pa zhig sbyar de nas rim par btegs te 'ba' phyogs su 'byor dus khra ma mgor sgar btab/ dpon phun tshogs g.yul rgyal shin tu 'bri gung par gus zhen che yang de skabs su dpon tshang yas mas thug pa sogs kyis longs spyod cher mi 'dug kyang 'ba' pa dpon g.yog thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur tshad med pa bstabs/ 'jang gi ra stag mo'u khas 'bod mi byung bas sgar mang stong gzhung du bzhag /nged rags bsdus kyis phyin ra stag rdzong du bsdad/ ra stag dpon de gsang sngags snga 'gyur la dad gus shin tu che bar 'dug pas rnying ma'i dbang lung kha shas dang*/ gtor zlog 'cham sogs rnying ma'i lugs mang du byas/ ra stag dpon gyi sku nye ka thog ru gshis dgon gyi bla ma dbon po dkon mchog rtse mo sgar du byon|

de res khrin rdzong mo'u kha dang rgyab ja dgon pa rnams kyi 'bod mi byung yang sgar mang stong gzhung du bzhag pas ma phyin/ ja dang a tho dgon sogs su rang re'i grwa rigs rong mi bla ma rnams phrin las rgyas par bzhugs 'dug pas thams cad kyis dngul la sogs pa'i rnyed pa mtha' yas pa bstabs/ so sor gang 'dod kyi dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis ngoms par byas/ gzhan wa shul 'brong pa lha thog la sogs pa'i sde khrod rnams nas kyang 'bul zhabs mang zhing dad gus che bar byas/ wa shul khrod nas shig bande sogs grwa rgyun kha shas kyang byung*/ li thang du slebs skabs zhag shas bsdad/ rin chen ril bu zhig kyang sbyar/ li thang chos mdzad sogs thams cad kyi mos 'dun dang 'bul zhabs cher byas/ li thang chos mdzad kyis bdag na so rgas pas tshe phyi ma thugs rjes zungs zer bar de 'dra mi dgos da dung 'phrad yong zer ba byas mar bab/ mar lam 'gor thogs kyang che zhing kam po gnas su ma sleb bar gyi lo rgyus bris pa ni med pas/ da lam 'bri ba shar tshe brjed ngas la song bas dran ha lam las spros pa zhib cha 'bri thabs ma byung*/ 'jang sa dam mthil sogs su sgar chen gyi drung du 'khor lag do sogs cung zad dus ngan gyis nyams bdo ba 'ga' dang*/ zur ri drung pa sogs kyi mdzad spyod la brten nas/ rje zhwa dmar ba drug pa de nyid thugs phyung ba'i tshul bstan/ kun spangs kyi zol gyis dpon slob nyung bsdus kam po gnas nang du dben par bzhugs/ grwa tshang rnams yon bdag so so'i sar gram/ sgar gzhung kam po gnas mdo stag lpags thang du bzhugs 'dug pas| rgyal ba de mjal du phyin pas kam po gnas kyi rked pa tsam du sgon dkar zer ba sa lugs kyi sde gog cig gi mchod khang zhig gso gnang ba'i sar mjal/ ri ldebs su brag phug cig tu bzhugs yul 'dug par zhag shas bdag kyang phug pa der sku drung du nyal/

dbu sems so so'i sems bskyed kyi sdom pa zhus dpon slob rnams lhan cig snga mkho ltar gnang dgos pa'i zhu 'bul nan bskyed zhus pas don 'grub pa'i zhal bzhes byung*/ slar dpon slob chabs cig gnas phu'i 'phags yul gong du phebs/ dpal rga lo'i gzims phug tu zhag shas bzhugs/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston sogs yi rangs pa'i byams brtses bskyangs/ khyod deng sang yon tan gang 'dra slob kyi yod gsungs par/ da lta dpe cha 'dra ni nyin mtshan kun tu lta ba'i khul byas/ sgra ris shig slob 'dod kyang slob dpon ma rnyed zhus pas/ 'o na slob dpon yang 'di nas gtong chog /'grel pa rigs 'ga'i dpe cha yod pa yang khur gsungs/ dge slong lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa slob dpon du gnang*/ lo tsā ba thugs rje dpal gyi sgra 'grel dang*/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi sgra 'grel legs bshad rab gsal snang ba'i glegs bam yang gnang byung ba khur/ kam po gnas nas bteg rang re'i sgar du sleb 'phral nas 'go btsugs sgra mdo ka lā pa'i 'grel pa sa bzang paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i steng nas khrid/ rim gyis phyin pa'i rab stong tshar sgang du slebs/ gser phye thang zhes par sgar pa gzhi phab/ nged rags bsdus kyis pags yul zer bar sgar pa dar rtse mdor sdod ring gi chas thebs sgrub par a bhi ṣa'i tshong zog khyer nas phyin pas/ 'bru nas la sogs pa gya nom pa rnyed kyang*/ sgar gzhis su 'brum bu'i 'tshe ba byung nged rnams kyang sgar khrod du slebs/ sde pa mkhar rtse ba sogs grwa pa mig 'dra ba dang*/ drin chen kong sman chen po sogs 'brum pas thebs pas lung stong rnams su phye/ gser phye thang du gshin rje yang zlog gi sgrub pa zhig bgyis pa'i tshe/ nub gcig rmi lam du bdag ri 'bur zhig gi rtser bsdad/ mdun du sgar pa rnams khra thing nger 'dug pa'i sar/ bdag rang la chung dus mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po 'phan yul mkhar rtser phebs pa zhig gi skabs srung bar tshe bdag gi sku thang me thub de gnang ba nas bzung da lta'i bar tshe bdag gi lha rtags la kong po ngo shes shig rtag tu yong mkhan yod pa de yang gzhogs der byung bar/

bdag gis da lo nged rang sgar par 'brum nad yong ba 'di rgyu rkyen cis lan dris par/ 'brum nad yong ba'i rgyu 'gu zi dgon par grwa pas bla ma bsad shul gyi mchod khang du sgar pa rnams phyin pas len/ da cha khong tsho'i sbug ril de chag song bas skyon med zer/ 'gu zi'i dgon pa de chos lugs sa skya pa yin/ grwa pa rnams kyis bla ma bsad pa'i shul mchod khang du nged rnams gdugs tshod la bos pa de yin 'dug de nas srung ba'i dus rmi lam du/ nged cag sgar pa rnams la dgra dogs shig yod pa'i khul gyis 'grim pa'i tshe/ kong po ngo shes de yang 'dug par dris pas/ gangs ri chen po zhig 'dug pa de la mdzub mo gtad nas/ ya gi gangs ri ti se yin/ ya gi'i rtser sgar phob zer/ der thar ram dris pas lam sna bdag gis byas na mi thar ba gang du yang med zer/ khong gis sna khrid gangs ri de'i rtser phyin pas mtha' thams cad gangs kyi ra bas bskor ba/ dbus kyang gangs rang la byas pa'i thang bde ba la rtswa chu shing gsum yang 'dzoms pa zhig 'dug par sgar btab pa rmis pa ni srung rtags mthar phyin par 'dug /lar na kha ba zhes pa nam mkha' nas bab pa'i ming dang*/ gangs zhes pa 'khyag pa lta bu sa nas skyes pa la zer/ khams kyi gangs rnying skye 'bri byed pa kun gyis mthong ba yin/ dbus gtsang pa rnams la de 'dra'i rnam dbye mi gda'/ sgrub pa'i zlog pa'i skabs thor thun la bab tshe/ bud med lus thams cad ra lpags ltar spu zhol che ba/ ske yan chad lhung bzed rtsi legs pa ltar nag cing 'od 'phro ba zhig bdag dang gtor ma'i mdun du pus btsugs byas byung ba khyod su yin dris pas/ nga thor pa'i nad bdag yin zer/ ci byed bsgral dgos pa min nam byas pas/ de 'dra mi dgos yos lo pa 'di bdag la byin/ gzhan dpon slob thams cad la da cha 'brum bu'i 'tshe ba mi 'byung bar dam bca'o zer/ bdag gis kyang de khas chog smras/

bzhag bra'i gangs la blta bar phyin sku mkhar gyi gangs ri dngos gzhi la gangs kyi lcags ris bskor ba'i dbus su mtsho mang pos gang 'dug pa'i zhol du rta bzhag /rkang gis 'dzegs pas brag dang gangs 'dres shing shin tu gzar bas nyen che bar 'dug kyang lcags ri'i rtser slebs nas bsang mchod sogs byas/ rab sgang pa'i rgan rabs rnams sngar bzhag bra'i lcags ri'i rtser lo chen bai ro tsa nas byon zer ba'i rna gtam tsam yod/ gzhan dngos su bgrod pa 'bri gung chos rje min pa yod ma myong zer ha las pa byed 'dug 'jig rten pa rnams cal sgrog ma gtogs ri rtser sleb pa rang ngo mtshar che rgyu ci la yod/ de nas rim gyis dar rtse mdo pa rnams kyis ja 'dren dang 'bod mi byung bar phyin pas/ dga' ldan thang shing du mdo pa rnams kyis rta bsu gzab rgyas tshad las 'das pas bsus te/ mi chen rtswa rar sgar phab nas zhag shas song ba'i tshe/ yul phyi nas yin pa'i grwa pa drel mgo zer ba zhig 'brum pa na logs su bkar bas shi/ lo snying yos lo pa yin pas sngar gser phye thang du nad bdag mos dgos zer ba de ka yin 'dug /mi chen rtswa rar dgun dus yin cing der zla ba gsum bsdad par 'brum nad pa'i bsngo byang gi rten dang*/ grwa pa rnams mdo'i grong khrod du phyin pa sogs 'brum pa la 'dzem cha ci yang ma byas kyang nyer 'tshe gtan nas med pa nad bdag gis khas blangs pa chad btsan pa nyid du byung*/ der bsdad pa'i ring yid spro ba gnas po che chung sogs thams cad kyang dad gus che bar 'dug /der rgya nag gi rgyal phran li'u rdzong pi zhes rgya nag rgyal po'i dmag dpon gyi las ka yod pa zhig gi mi sna mang po 'dug pa bdag gi sar byung*/ dri ba mang du byas pa'i mthar nged kyi rgyal po la btsun mo lnga bcu yod par gsum sbrum pas de rnams la sras pho mo gang 'byung zer bar/ rgan pa dang gzhon pa gnyis la sras po re/

'bring po la sras mo 'byung*/ chung ba des rgyal sa 'dzin pa 'dug byas pas/ phyis dar rtse mdo pa'i rgyu 'grul byung ba'i skad cha la de ka ltar byung bas yid ches byed 'dug zer/ li'u rdzong pi zer ba de da lta ja pa rnams kyi ming 'chol nas lug rdzi zer ba de yin 'dug /dar rtse mdor ji tsam sdod pa'i ring gnas chen rnams kyis nyin re bzhin mang ja dang 'gyed rnyed pa bstabs pa sogs dang*/ rta 'bul sde pa rang 'di skabs dar rtse mdor mi 'dug /'gag chu nas mang 'gyed ja gos dar sman spos la sogs pa gya nom pa'i rnyed pa bstabs/ der gnas kyi yon bdag che phra thams cad la so sor lugs gnyis kyi 'byor pas re ba yongs su bskangs par byas/ snye lo mgo nas gnas po padma gzungs kyi bu nam mkha' gzungs zer ba zhig sngar gyi bdag mo gser khang ma'i skye bar 'dug pas bdag la byin/ de nas mdo nas rnyed pa yang legs par thob par byas te yar rim gyis bteg /dga' ldan thang shing bar gnas chen rnams kyis skyel ma sogs yon mchod legs pa'i lam srol la gnas pa byas/ rab sgang sogs brgyud 'bri gung du mtshams grwa brje len ran pa byung ba dang*/ rang re yang rkang 'gro lag rkyong gi brtul zhugs kho na lo lnga tsam song bas dub ste/ yar lam 'gor thogs med par gang mgyogs byed rtsis la dmigs rtse gtad kyang*/ sgar pa yang sprang po gzhi chen du song ba dang lam bar yon bdag kyang dad 'dun che bas cung zad 'gor/ 'jang rgyab ja dgon du rje zhwa dmar ba dpon slob kyang bzhugs sgar gra sgrig snga lor bdag rang gis zhus pa don ldan dpon slob thams cad sngar las kyang gzi brjid che bar bzhugs 'dug pas phyag 'bul la bdag zla bo rags bsdus kyis phyin/ sgar mang stong gzhung du bzhag /rje zhwa dmar ba'i drung du zhag shas bsdad cing dar rtse mdo nas ka lā pa'i ri mo yang ma lus pa grub zhus pas thugs dgyes par gnang*/

thugs rje dpal gyi sgra 'grel phyag rang du phul/ sa bzang pa'i ṭī ka dang slob dpon dge slong bstan pa yang khyer/ khrin rdzong mu'u kha sogs kyi 'bod mi byung yang ma phyin| rgyab ja nas bteg rim gyis brgyud/ mgu log rmi lam sgang du drung 'tsho karma bzod pa sogs don gnyer 'gar rin chen grang sbyor gyi lag len slob pa dang sbrags phon chung nge ba zhig sbyar| der yod thog li thang chos mdzad bsnyun nas 'bod mi tsha 'grul byung bas sgar mang rjes la bzhag /rta hrags kyis mtshan rgyab nas phyin pas li thang du slebs/ chos mdzad nad dun thug nas 'dug pas bdag dang 'phrad ma thag /bdag la gson po'i re ba med kyang zhabs drung nas slar 'phrad yong gsungs pas phebs sgug zhus bsdad pa yin zer ba sogs thag chod pa'i lab mang du mdzad/ phyi nyin grongs song bar li thang dpon lhun po sogs ltos bcas de thams cad kyis/ nged li thang bar rgyab ja ba'i mthu kha yod pas da lam khyed kyis rtsis byas nas shi sgab chod pa dang*/ mthu bzlog dgos zer ba dang*/ de tsho yon bdag drin chen yin pas rtsis rgyas par byas/ phyogs srung la rten li ma dang rgya nag ma 'ba' zhig dang rgya nag tu bzhengs pa'i gsung rab khyad can dang go khrab rnying ma'i rigs sogs ya mtshan can mang du gtad/ rtsis grub nas phyogs srung rnams phar gtad pas cis kyang khyer zhes nan shin tu che ba byas byung yang*| sngags pas yas za ba babs thob 'dug kyang nged rang mi ngan ming chen du 'dug pa dang grwa tshang gi bla ma 'dra zhig byas nas za rgyu gtso bor ston ngo tsha med byas na mi 'gab pa 'dra bsam pa sems la brnags/ kha nas ci yang mi dgos zhes 'dod chung chog shes yod pa'i khul byas/ deng sang gi bla ma dang ban sngags kyi mdzad lugs ltar byas na/ phyogs srung de rnams 'os rigs par khyer 'ong na byes thebs de'i ring gi rnyed pa dang mnyam la khad 'dug kyang ma khyer/

de nas sgar mang yang slebs/ cho ga zhag bdun phrag gcig byas pa sogs kyi yon 'bul la rgya dkar nag gi sku rten gyi rigs rgya nag rnying dus kyi dgang blugs gser tshags 'phrul ma rgya shubs dang bcas pa dgang blugs kyi las ka shes mkhan la khyad zog yong ba/ 'bras shel gyi rkyan bu/ me shel shin tu che ba sogs shel spyad du ma dang*/ gos dar rnying ma'i rigs go khrab khyad can rta dre'u mdzo la sogs pa dang*/ nas khal brgya phrag sogs gya nom pa phul/ slar yang bdag gi mthu lam gcod pa'i phyir tshe bdag gi sgo nas so mtshams gcod pa dang gsang lam 'gog pa dang*/ zug pa dbyung ba sogs gzhung ltar byas shing*/ lo bcu gnyis kyi bar shi chad dang byad kha mi 'byung ba'i khag khur byas/ phyis li thang gi gnas skor ba 'dra la dris pas lo nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar shi chad nyes skyon ci yang ma byung 'dug /mkhas pa'i drung du mkhas par bslabs// mkhas par sbyangs pa mkhas pas shes// mkhas pas mkhas pa'i bya ba byed// mkhas pa'i lag rjes de 'dra yin// ha ha ru lu ru lu phaṭ// de nas yar btegs te ba tsha gling gsum/ nags shod/ zla dgon/ rnam rgyal dgon/ ye phom dgon/ ldong ba dgon sogs nas grwa rgyun yong mi yang shin tu mang bar byung*/ hor dkyil bar du 'gor gzhi gang chung gis tshugs zhag kho na dang res 'ga' mal gso ba'i bcags ma tsam ma gtogs gom pa gang yang byas/ zhar la gdul bya byung ba tsho dar rtse mdo nas lag longs pas mi 'dod pa'i tshul tsam drang ba'i don dang*/ nges pa'i don du 'khyer rgyu rnyed tshad chud zos med par khyer nas 'ongs/ zog med rgya yul bgrod na yang*// stong log yin pa'i tshul bsams nas// gang rnyed gang thub byas nas khyer// ma rnyed pa la thabs ci yod// gzhan yang mtshams gzhung du rgya mo bza'i phyag bris yig drug 'dug pa mjal/ de dang mi ring bar spang gi logs la nyams mtshar du lañdza'i yi ge hūm̐ gi klad kor nang du yang mi rta mang du shong ba zhig brkos pa'i tshe rdo'i dung dkar g.yas 'khyil khong stong sgros shin tu gtsang ba mi rgyags pas pang theg pa zhig thon pa klad kor gyi dbus der bzhag

/de la sogs pa dang gzhan yang ra la'i rnam snang dang*/ 'or ngu'i byams mdun dang*| klong thang sgrol ma'i lha khang sogs mjal/ bdag chos rje zhwa dmar ba rgyab jar mjal dus rje'i sku gzhogs su rgya gar shar phyogs pa'i paṇḍi ta dge slong mtshan dngos sha tsi tā nanta zer ba phyis paṇḍi tar gyur nas wā tsa ppa ti zhes bod skad du smra ba'i bdag por btags pa/ gzhung lugs kyi rgya dpe po ti tshad longs bdun cu don gsum rje'i sku gzhogs su gshar rgyugs phul ba zhig /khong rgya gar du mkhan po dang gnas kyi bla ma gzhi mthun pa zhig yod 'dug pa sku gshegs pa'i gdung gi mdun du khong rang gi spyi bo'i thod pa mtheb long che ba tsam zhig khol bur phyung bas kong bu byas nas mar me phul/ khong rang yid phyung bas rgya nag gi yul sogs gnas ri dang rgyal khams kun tu nges med du 'phyo zhing byon pa 'jang sa dam brgyud rje'i sku zhabs su 'byor 'dug pa de phyis bdag tsho yar lam mtshams dil du sleb thog /khong rgya gar du 'byon par nam dus kyis la kha bas chod dogs dang*/ rje re zhig dbus gtsang du mi phebs pa shes nas| khong dbus gtsang du sngon la 'byon pa'i zhu 'bul mdzad 'dug par kun shes skam po zer ba'i drung 'khor rgan po zhig khong bskyel ma dang bcas/ bdag la bka' shog tu paṇḍi ta 'di rten dge slong gtsang ma sbyangs pa'i yon tan sogs thugs la mnga' ba ltar yin/ 'di phral du thugs gtum pa'i tshul tsam 'dug kyang de 'phral sos 'gro ba 'dzin pa med pa byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan yang cung zad mnga' ba zhig yod pa rgya gar du 'byon par rings pas 'bri gung bar phyag phyir 'khrid pa dang*/ khong rang gi 'dod pa la gang yod gnang ba sogs gang legs mdzad dgos/ 'di la yag po mdzad na bdag la mdzad pa dang khyad med/ 'bri gung nas gtsang bar skyel grogs dang gtsang sde srid la'ang nged rang gi yi ge byas yod gsungs 'dug pa ltar paṇḍi ta sgar du byon kun shes phyir slog

/'bri gung du ma sleb bar gyi ring sgra ka lā pa'i dogs gcod dang*/ ming gzhi rkyen dang rnam dbye phrad la sogs pa gal che ba'i gnad rnams kyi dogs gcod dang*/ gzhi slob sogs la shin tu phan zhing blo bskyed tshad med pa thon pa byung*/ gzhan su la yang med pa'i khong par rtsis kyi ri mo sogs gang la'ang brten mi dgos par paṇḍi ta de ring gza' skar sogs ci yod dris na/ phyag mdzub la rtsis grangs tsam mdzad thog nyi ma gcig po de'i gza' tshes skar sbyor byed pa lda po nged rang gi tshes rtsis la shar ba dang khyad med pa/ tshes rtsis la nor 'khrul byung yang khong gis zhus dag pher ba yod/ rgyun gyi yi dam dgyes rdor dang chos skyong phyag bzhi dang phyag drug la mdzad pa bdag ma gtogs thams cad la gsang*/ mi kun gyi thos sar bzang spyod smon lam legs sbyar gyi skad du gsung ba zhig yod/ de nas rim gyis yar bgrod nas/ byang gi ya rog thang dkar ma zhes bya ba de dang nye bar slebs/ thang ljongs chen po de ni ji ltar na maṇḍal ltar khod snyoms shing 'bar 'bur dang rang rong gcong rong tsha sgo la sogs pa med pa/ shin tu khod snyoms shing bde ba lag mthil ltar 'jam pa/ bai ḍūrya gsar pa'i khu bas sbags pa ltar sngo zhing mdangs legs pa/ 'bab chu'i rgyun rnams dbu ba'i phreng ba'i rgyan du ma dang bcas gnod pa med pa phyogs kun tu 'bab pa/ ri thams cad zlum zhing 'jam la margad lta bu'i mdog mnga' ba/ nam mkha' mthing shun gsar pa'i lang tsho las kyang ches yid du 'ong ba'i dbus su rta bdun gyi dbang po mtshams sprin gsar pa'i kha dog la 'khu zhing*/ 'od zer gyi phreng ba mtha' yas pa spro bas skye dgu thams cad la 'jam zhing dro ba'i bde ba 'bad med du stsol ba/ de lta bu'i ljongs su hor ser po'i ru ba rnams kyis sa gzhi khengs shing brjid chags pa'i dbus su/ hor kun las rgyal gyi rigs las 'khrungs pa rnam par gnon pa dang dpa' zhing brtul phod pa sogs rgyal rigs kyi yon tan bgrang gis mi lang ba dang ldan pa dpon karma g.yul rgyal gyi sbra nag ji ltar na/

dug can gyi 'jing ltar 'khyil zhing kho lag yangs shing tshad las 'das pa legs par phub/ de dang mi ring ba'i sar rgya gar gyi grub chen nā ro ta pa sprul sku'i snang brnyan du mdzad pa rje maṅga la sampanna kīrti dhwa dza shrī bha dra'i bzhugs sgar chen po lha'i lha lam du rgyu skar gyi phreng ba 'khrigs pa lta bu'i dbus su rje'i gzims gur ri bong 'dzin pa'i lang tsho nya gang ba ltar mthong ba tsam gyis yid kyi dga' ma tshim par mdzad pa bcas 'du mdzad pa'i nye ba'i gan du phyin pa'i tshe/ rje maṅga'i mtshan can drung 'khor brgya phrag gis bskor ba'i chibs rags dang*/ byang brgyud rgyal po karma g.yul rgyal la mi bzang brgya phrag gis yongs su bskor ba ji ltar na bde sogs kyi bdag po la lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu dang bcas pa'i bsu ba'i bkod pa mtha' yas pas legs par bsus te/ bdag cag rnams kyi sgar pa yang de dang mi ring ba'i sar phab/ rje nā ro pa'i sku gzhogs nas gsol ras sne len gyi pha 'bab bzang zhing gya nom pa dang*/ hor dpon tshang gis kyang ston mo bzang shoms kyis tshim par mdzad| hor dpon sras yum dang bcas pa so sor dbang phran bu phul/ rje nā ro pa'i bzhugs sgar zhag shas rjes la bzhugs/ bdag rnams sgar btegs nas gzhu rong brgyud mthil du slebs| 'bri gung mthil gyi gnas mjal dang mchod khang so sor mchod rdzas kyi bye brag 'dus pa'i tshogs rgya chen po bla g.yel thang du tshogs par mang ja dang ja dar gyi 'gyed chas legs par phul/ sgar btegs te rdzong gsar bkra shis tshugs kyi shar phyogs ra sog thang stod du sgar phab/ zhabs drung spro lung du gshegs pa dang*/ gdung brgyud pa sogs rdzong du mjal/ slar rje nā ro pa phebs grub byung bar rdzong gi lcang ra'i nang du bzhugs khri brtsigs pa'i khar spyan drangs/ bdag sgar pa gzhung grwa pa so so dang bcas pas 'bul chas spam bstod nas phul bas|

rje nā ro pa 'khor dang bcas pas yang ri sgar pa'i 'bul ba da lam las bzang ba ma byung zhes thugs mnyes par mdzad/ mi 'gyang bar mtshams grwa rnams 'dzoms byung bar/ nged cag khams nas 'khor ba'i grwa pa gral bzhugs rang la brgyad brgya lhag nges dang mtshams grwa rnams bsdoms par stong lhag nges byung bar bdag rang gis dbu sems kyi sems bskyed lugs so so dang dbang chos mang po bgyis/ rje nā ro pas lcang ra nang du bzhugs sgar btab/ hor dpon sras yum gzab rgyas kyis phebs pa ra sog gi dur khrod sgur du sgar phab nas/ skya ser 'dus pa'i tshogs mtha' yas pa la rje nā ro pas rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang bskur ngor lugs mnga' ris pa tshul khrims 'od zer bas bsgrigs pa dkyil 'khor zhe lnga'i dbang dang*/ mtha' rten bde legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum dang bcas pa rdzogs par stsal/ mtshams grwa khag rnams so sor brdzangs/ bdag kyang khams nas 'ongs pas ngal bar song nas rje nā ro pa'i drung du sgar gyi bla ma 'jog tshul dgongs pa nan zhus byas pas legs par gnang*/ bla ma spangs mda' ba bkra shis dar rgyas pa bsko bzhag dang*/ sgar phyi nang gi rtsis sprod sogs snga gong rim par sprad pa rnams las mi dman zhing rgya dpangs gang sa nas mtho bar phul/ rdzong gsar sogs su bsdad kyang zos mi bde ba las mi yong bsam me sbrul hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco brgyad la nged rang nyung bsdus kyis bteg /rtse bar slebs pas sngar rje gong ma bzhugs dus lugs gnyis ka nas 'gran zla dang bral ba de 'dra ba da lta rje btsun mi la'i pha yul ltar thag nye ba mthong ba'i yid khong du chud pa byung*/ yar lam gtsang po la dar zam 'dug pas dpon ma gcig mgon gyis bos/ lung chung du bsdad nub srod la grong leb rgyal po'i 'tshub cha shin tu che ba byung*/ ting nge 'dzin dang sngags rgyas gzir bas nam gung nas gzugs zhi bar bstan/

nga rang gis srung 'khor byas pa thams cad la mi gnod pa dang khyad par ma gcig mgon khyim tshang la lo shas mi gnod pa'i dam blangs/ tho rangs mkhar rtse yin rgyu ba'i gzhal med khang rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang las lhag pa'i dbus su gdan khri mtha' yas pa'i steng du mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po khrag 'thung rol pa'i cha lugs can gyi sku g.yas su/ rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i cha lugs dang*/ g.yon du drin chen gyi ma de sngar gyi cha lugs su bzhugs/ gdan khri'i mdun du 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag/ loka tri/ ma hā kā lā tsa turbhudza/ dharma tā re sogs khrom tshogs pa ltar thams cad bdag la dgyes 'dzum du bzhugs 'dug pa mjal zhing*/ bdag gis yus chen pos mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po yab yum la zhu ba mang du phul bas lugs gnyis ka'i bslab bya 'phral phugs du ma'i sgo mtha' yas pas rangs par mdzad/ lhag par lug lo rta zla'i tshes bcu la ti sgro'i tshogs khang steng nas gter chos mang ba zhig 'byin dgos pa sogs lung bstan mang rabs gnang ba'i rjes/ yab sras rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dang gsum ka res zhi ba res khro bo res sa chu me rlung gi gzugs res nyi ma zla ba/ res ci yang med pa'i rnam pa sogs rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul mtha' yas pa 'du mdzad pa'i mthar gsum ka spyan bar snang la hrig hrig phyag se gol tog tog mdzad cing*/ kwa ye bu mthong ngam go'am gsungs pas/ mthong zhing 'khor 'das gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad med bzhin du snang ba ci yang ma yin cir yang snang ba snang stong dbyer med spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad kyis stong par/ rang sems rol pa las gzhan gang du'ang ma grub la rang sems kyang spros pa'i mtha' thams cad las 'das pa kun khyab kun gsal chen por go lags zhes zhus pas de yin gsungs shing 'od kyi rang bzhin du gshegs/ de nas gad la 'or du bos/

gung tshigs bzang bar byas nas/ dben gnas tha ba kha bde chen steng du re zhig gnas mal bgyis shing*/ de dag gi tshe gzhan pa'i lugs gnyis kyi bya bzhag khams che ba byas pa ni med phran bu ni brjed 'dug kyang*/ rang gis mdo khams su dkor zas phul ches pa'i sgrib sbyong 'dra e yong gi re bas kun rig gi bsnyen pa grangs tshad thems nges byas pa'i mthar zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'bum phrag gcig rdzogs par byas/ de skabs nas rje nā ro pa lha sde gzhung gi thugs khur zhabs drung spro lung gi bde gshegs la phul nas kun spangs gnang skabs yin pas/ rje nā ro pa bde chen steng du phebs/ zhag shas bzhugs par tshe bdag gi rjes gnang rnon po nang gcod zhus/ rje de'i bkas gshin rje yang zlog gi las sbyor gyi sgrub pa rgyas pa zhig byed dgos pa'i bka' stsal dang du blangs/ nged cag rnams rdzong gsar du phyin/ gzhi ma bde chen steng du bzhag /rdzong du sgrub pa'i gtso bor rje nā ro pa dang zhabs drung gdung brgyud kyang bzhugs/ bdag cag dpon slob nyi shu rtsa gcig gis tshes gcig nas nyer dgu'i bar sgrub pa mdzad par/ 'dam du dpon g.yul rgyal snyung drag pos thebs pas rje nā ro pa spyan 'dren shin tu nan che ba snga phyi mang por byung bas mi phebs ka med byung yang*/ bdag cag rnams kyis sgrub pa 'phro mthud pas rje de'i thugs rjes sgrub pa zhud pa sogs kyi nyes skyon ci yang med pa'i steng nang rtags rdzogs par byung bas nyer dgu las kyi mjug sdud rnams bgyis pas/ phyi rtags kyang zla ba phyed tsam nas kun gyis mthong ba'i mngon gyur du byung*/ de nas bdag kyang bde chen steng du log nas bsdad skabs hor dpon bsnyungs pa je lod las ma byung bas bdag kyang shad rtsol gyis phyin 'dam du 'byor/ hor dpon la dbang sogs thugs dang bstun pa byas kyang mi ring bar 'das/ de dag gi yar 'dren sogs skabs sbyar byas nas tshur log bde chen steng du bsdad/

slar skabs shig sdod yul spro lung du 'dod pa 'dra zhig byung bas/ spro lung du bsgril nas bsdad/ skabs shig mkhar rtse nas dpon sa'i thugs phyir 'chus pas brgya mkhar gtsang nas bzhes 'dug par/ thabs gzhan ni ma rnyed dkon mchog la gsol 'debs sogs byas/ rje nā ro pa 'brong ngur du bzhugs pa mjal ba dang sbrags/ zla ba lnga pa'i yar ngor gter sgrom du phyin/ rje nā ro pa mjal/ gnas phran bskor zhing phyin pa'i lam du bsam yas chos skyong gi yi ger/ da lam lha mchod 'di'i steng du lha mi sngon nas dam tshig gcig pa'i rten 'brel sgrig dgos yod pas tshes bcu gsum la pho brang gong du 'byor ba shog /de la ma byung na lha mi'i dam tshig la khyod rang gis 'das pa yin no zer ba 'dug pas rje nā ro par ji ltar drag zhus pas/ cis kyang phyin pa 'gab pas de ring rang spro lung du sleb pa gyis gsungs pas phyin/ spro lung nas 'phral du bteg /rgya ma'i la brgyud nas phyin pas pho brang gong du tshes bcu bzhi nyin 'byor/ tshes bco lngar mdo sde'i deb sla lta ba dang chos skyong mjal/ gsung gleng zhib pa ni khong rang mdzad long mi 'dug /tshes bcu drug la ngal gsos/ bcu bdun la mdo sde dngos gzhi mdzad skabs chos skyong gis sang gnangs bsam yas kyi gnas gzigs mdzod/ tshes nyi shu la lha mi 'dzoms pa'i zhib rgyas dgos pa yod do gsungs pa ltar tshes bco brgyad dang bcu dgu la bsam yas mthil mchims phu has po ri dang bcas pa mjal/ tshes nyi shu snga dro nas lcog tu sku phebs nas shog gsungs par phyin pas/ gsung gleng mang po'i mthar/ sngon bse 'bag smug gu 'di bha ta hor gyi sgom grwa nas nam mkha' la 'phur nas zan g.yang rdo rje gdan 'dir sleb dus kyi dam tshig de tsho da lta dge bshes kyis e dran gsungs par/ dran tshul zhus pas/ de yin gsung dgyes dgyes ltar mdzad/ slar lcog gi nang du bos/

rgyal po yab yum gyi sku gsob dang*/ bse 'bag shel gyi 'khor rten sogs zhib par bdag la bstan/ sngon bar khang g.yu zhal du slob dpon padma rgyal po yab sras dang bdag cag lha mi dam la bzhag cing dam bsres pa'i skabs kyi brjod bya rjod byed 'di lta bu gsung ba'i gleng 'phros zhib par mdzad pa'i rjes la 'phral dang yun gyi bslab bya mang du mdzad/ slar rgya ma brgyud spro lung du 'byor/ de nas skabs shig dad 'dus skya ser kha yar la/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang sgrub rgyas pa ras bris la brten pa dang sman sgrub kyang byas pa gzhung nas ji ltar gsungs pa ltar rtags dang ldan pa byung*/ rin chen ril bu grang sbyor shin tu phon che ba zhig phyi'i pha bong chag ra'i steng du sbyar/ skabs shig bla ma sa ngan pa nyi ma 'od zer la dgongs 'dus kyi dbang lung thog mtha' bar gsum zhus| slar rje nā ro pas dbu mdzad yang ri sgar pa'i tshogs pa dang skya ser mang ba la rdzong gi ka brgyad du bla ma dgongs 'dus dbang sgrub rgyas pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa dang*| zhabs drung spro lung gi bde gshegs dang zhabs drung gdung brgyud pa yang ri sgar pa dang bcas par bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi lung yang phul/ de rjes rje zhwa dmar ba drug pa 'bri gung du phebs shing ra sog thang du bzhugs sgar btab/ bdag kyang spro lung nas mjal du 'ongs/ de'i skabs nas rje nā ro pa dang zhabs drung spro lung gi bde gshegs sku mched dang zhabs drung gdung brgyud dpon sa phun tshogs rnams phyag g.yog gi rkyen dang 'bri bstan gyi sku chag 'go tshugs pa'i nyams kyis kha dog so so nas mgo mngon tsam 'dug pa mthong bas/ bdag kyang 'bri gung du bsdad tshe phyogs su lhung ba'i khag ngan 'khri ba zhig 'ong*/ de bas sngar zla dgon du log chad dang khang pa gsar 'chos byas pa sogs la snyad btags gzur pa la lab rgyu nyung bsam pa yid la bcangs/

rje zhwa dmar ba drug pa dang rje nā ro pa sku mched la de 'dra'i dge skyon ni ma zhus/ zla dgon du log chad byas pa rdzun du mi 'gro ba'i phyir 'gro tshul zhus pas dgongs khrol dka' ba tsam byung*/ lhag par rje zhwa dmar bas khyod de ltar nan bskyed kyis 'gro ba ji ltar yin zhes nan gyis dri ba gnang byung bas rgyu mtshan de rnams zhus pas dgongs pa gnang*| rje zhwa dmar ba bzhugs thog de rang du bdag rnams rdzong nas bteg /a la rong dang nub kong la brgyud/ thog mar rngod smad gtsang yul tshal du sgar btab/ rngod smad sde dgon rnams kyis bsu ba sogs byas/ ldong ba dgon gsar du bla ma dro skyid kyis bos bsnyen bkur bzang du byas/ khong pas bskul nas gtsang yul tshal du skya ser shin tu mang ba la bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang rgyas pa sogs 'dod chos mang du byas/ der nub cig rmi lam du rgya gar rdo rje gdan yin rgyu bar rdo'i khri mang po 'dug par khri gong ma brgyad la phyag 'tshal/ khri dgu pa'i steng du rtsa bting ba'i gdan la rdo rje skyil krung lag pa gnyis mnyam bzhag bcas byang chub kyi shing la rgyab gtad nas sangs rgyas dgu pa me tog tu sangs rgyas pa zhig rmis/ sgar btegs nas rngod stod gangs shod du sgar phab/ der yang dbang chos mang du byas/ ye spom dgon du bla ma be ri rtogs ldan gyis gdugs tshod bzang du drangs| slar rnam rgyal dgon du sgar phab/ der yang dbang chos kha yar byas nas bkra shis gangs ra'i phur rgyang me zhes pa'i gnas mjal du phyin/ de'i g.yu mtsho khar pha bong gnyis mtsho'i nang 'gro sdod byed pa sogs ya mtshan gyi ltas mang du mthong ba ni rgyang me'i gnas yig rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhal lung du bris pa ltar yin/ rang phyogs ya ngan sribs pa sde dgon la shin tu 'tshe ba'i sde dgon 'ga' zung la phug yul mtsho nag mor las sbyor zhig byas pas rang lus chu bur gyi khengs pa sogs sa nad rjes mthun yin nges btsan thabs su byung bar de nub rlung rtsol 'khrul 'khor la 'bad pas phyi nangs rma shu'i rjes tsam ma gtogs gtsang mar drag

/gzhan phyogs dmigs bya gang yin lo gsum tsam gyi khongs su kha dag pa byung 'dug /de nas shar kong la brgyud zla dgon pa'i bsu ba ser sbreng rgyas pa dang bcas spyil bu gsar pa dpal rnam gnon tshul khrims su gzhi phab/ de'i lor 'du khang chen mor bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi sgrub dbang rgyas pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa byas pa'i tshe skya ser che dgu 'dus pa khri phrag lhag pa la rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi sgo bstan/ spyil bu'i zhal bsror gzims chung chos 'khor bde yangs su gzhi byes kyi 'dus pa grangs mang ba la mgon po 'bri gung pa'i thugs bskyed chen mo byas/ der rgyang tsam bsdad/ slar dbra yul g.yur rong sogs su sgar skor la phyin| rnam dkar gyi 'brel pa mod mi dma' ba bgyis/ nags shod pa'i 'bod mi byung bas phyin/ gnyan sde mi sdes bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas dgon pa chos 'khor byams pa gling du sgar btab/ der yang nged yang ri bla ma byas nas phyin dus bla ma shākya rin chen pa ri bo che bar bdag gi zlar byon/ nags shod ba lag dgon da lta'i dgon gsar gyi mal bkag po sgang zer ba zhig yod par spos na rung ngam mi rung gsungs par/ shin tu legs par 'ong gnas de'i ming bkag po sgang zer ba mi legs pas chos 'khor byams pa gling thogs zer ba byas pa de yin/ der 'dus pa gzhi byes mang ba la dgon khrod kyi bla g.yel du rdo rje phreng ba rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor nyer brgyad rdzogs pa'i dbang dang*/ 'du khang du 'dus pa'i tshogs la kun rig sogs dbang lung mang rabs byas/ de lo bdag gi lo nyer lnga'i skag thog yin pas me mo rag phom gyi gnas mjal du phyin/ gnas dang khad nye bar khor tsha smad tha'i rgyal po dpon dbang lu'i ru bar bos/ zhag shas ngal gso dang sbrag bsdad/ dbang chos gang 'dod kyi 'brel ba bzhag /slar nags shod chos 'khor byams pa gling du 'khor ba'i skabs/

gnas skor ba 'ga' byung ba'i skad char 'bri gung du zhabs drung sku mched thugs snang ma dag /dge slong a tha lnga par thal/ yang ri sgar pas bkras ljongs la me rgyab pa sogs lugs gnyis ka'i srol las nyams shing*/ 'bri gung pa zhes gangs can gyi ljongs su lugs gnyis ka yar dper 'jog sa zhig yod pa de/ dus de nas mar gyi dper 'jog sa zhig byung*/ de'i tshe lugs ma legs pa de thos pas sems las kyang che ba la/ de 'dra ba'i skabs bdag ma the bas mtshengs ang snyam pa yang byung*/ de nas 'bi 'gom gyi sa mtshams dar yug thang du sgar btab/ 'bi 'gom gnyis ka'i gnyen sde dang rgan po rnams bsdus nas zang zing gi nor rdzas du ma byin te 'khrug pa 'dum pa byas/ slar dgon gsar du zhag 'ga' bsdad nas ka rong brgyud zla dgon du 'byor/ de'i tshe rje nā ro pa yang spro lung du zur bzhugs gnang*/ nyang po dang zho kha brag gsum phyogs su phebs pa'i gtam thos pa dang bcas/ zhabs drung sku mched nang 'dum tsam e yong bsam byang lam brgyud hor khrod nas a ce mgo mgo yang byon/ nged lcam sring gis mthil du zhabs drung sku mched la zhu 'bul 'dra byas pas khong rang sku mched zhal 'chams kyang*/ zhabs drung gdung brgyud pa dang dpon sa phun tshogs lcam sring gsan du ma 'dod pas thabs ma rnyed/ rdzong du bskor tsam phyin zla ba gnyis gsum tsam bsdad/ dpon slob snang gsal bar gshin rje khro chu dang kun bzang dgongs 'dus/ mkha' 'gro snying thig /mgon po ma ning*/ bka' thang sde lnga sogs dbang lung mang bar zhus/ byang bdag po'i sras zhabs drung bla ma phebs byung bar/ rje nā ro pa'i zhabs phyir bdag gis kyang byang gter thugs sgrub 'bring po thugs rje chen po rig 'dzin gdung sgrub dang*/ bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar sogs mang bar zhus/ zhabs drung gdung brgyud lcam sring nas bdag la yang gzigs phyogs shig 'dug pas/
