der bsdad kyang rang sdug cing khong rang lcam sring thugs 'tshigs pa las mi 'dug snyam nas bteg /gzhu rong brgyud brag dkar lha chur tshe sgrub mtshams lam bgyis pa'i tshe 'khrul snang dang lung bstan byung tshul zur du bris pa ltar yin/ de'i tshe zhabs drung nā ro pa yang nyang po bar phebs/ 'bras su bsdad thog rje nā ro par kun bzang dgongs 'dus dang gshin rje khro chu'i dbang lung phul| rje nā ro pa re zhig nyang po phyogs rang du bzhugs/ bdag gis zla dgon du phyin pa yin// pha yul bkra shis rdzong gsar na// sdang byed nye bar brdzus pa 'ga'i// sran tsam gyi dga' ston ma thob kyang*// mdo khams kyi longs spyod dga' bder spyad// a la la ru lu ru lu hūm̐ phaṭ// de nas zla dgon du yod skabs mi 'gyang bar gtsang sde srid nas rje nā ro pa 'bri gung gi lugs gnyis kyi chab srid la dbang bskur ba'i gtam bzang po yang thos/ dus der zla dgon du bdag rang gi spyil bu'i shar du sa shod sde pa'i gzims spyil kho lag yangs shing 'pho 'jug bde ba zhig yod par zla dgon bla ma bzod pa dang kong po tshong dpon mang bas gzhi bzung nas/ bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi sgrub dbang zung 'brel rgyas pa sman sgrub dang bcas pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa dang*/ mjug tu gshin rje 'char ka'i zor las gnam lcags thog mda' yang grub par bgyis pa'i rtags tshad rnams/ yin rlom la re ma dgos pa gzhung du gsungs pa ji lta bas der 'dus thams cad gsang sngags rnying ma la nges pa rnyed pa byung*/ de dag gi tshe nang chen sde dgon dang spo bo sde dgon gnyis kas 'bod mi byung bar/ re zhig spo bor 'gro bar shar/ o rgyan ri khrod du sleb skabs spyang ki la 'gags 'dug par gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin cing bka' bsgos pas zhag gnyis nas la shin tu bde ba byung bas/ thog mar rgyud sgo rdo khar sgar btab/

skya ser mang ba la chos kyi 'brel ba zhag kha yar byas/ slar bteg dngul lung du sgar btab/ gnas po khag rnams dang*/ ba gad ri gong kha sogs snye bo'i rnying ma ba'i bla ma khag mang ba dang*/ rong ma'i bla ma sogs mang bas bskul ngor bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang sgrub rgyas pa rdul tshon la brten pa dang rnga 'cham brub 'cham sogs rgyas par byas/ slar re zhig dben par 'dod pas dngul lung rdo kha'i phu'i nags gseb tu bla ma rong mi bstan pa rgyal mtshan pa'i spyil bu 'dug par gnas mal bcas/ sgar mang nags khrod du gang bder 'khod/ der bla ma o rgyan bstan 'dzin dang rba kha sprul sku sogs la 'dul ba mdo rtsa paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan gyis mdzad pa'i mdo 'grel snang byed nyi ma'i shing rta ba dan dkar po/ bslab bya chen mo sogs lung mang du bgyis/ de'i 'og tsam du pha bong kha zhes pa'i spyil bu zhig tu bla ma o rgyan bstan 'dzin pa'i bzhugs yul yin zhing*/ khong pa rtsa mi grwa pa thang 'brog pa yin pas dgongs 'dus la 'dris po yod zer bas/ mtshan mo lan grangs mang bar khong can tu dgongs 'dus zhur phyin pas/ bdag gi zla bo dbon po ra stag pa dang dge slong 'phrang kha ba gnyis las ma khrid cing*/ ri gzar ba dang nags mthug cing char zhod che bas nags khrod du 'dam rdzab che zhing mun pa nag pa sogs nas/ thag ring gang du phyin pa las kyang dka' tshegs dang ngal dub che ba byung yang chos kyi 'dod pas spro dga' min pa sems ngal ba ma byung*/ slar dngul lung mdor phyin/ zhag shas song nas ma skung lung zer ba'i gnas rgya che zhing ngo mtshar du ma dang ldan pa zhig yod pa'i grags pa thos pas mjal du phyin/ gnas de sgo dog cing nags dang chu 'phrang dam pas nyen shin tu che ba la/ gnas khongs su 'byor nas lung pa rgya che zhing 'jam la nags dang 'bab chu nel ma'i ljongs sogs shin tu dwangs spro ba 'dug pa'i gnas kyi smad tsam du bla ma o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyi spyil bu 'dug pa'i sar cog bu'i gnas mal btab/

khong gis zhabs tog bzang bar byas/ gnas der khong bsnyen par rdzogs pa chig rdzogs su bsgrubs/ de nas rim gyis gnas mjal bar che mchog gi bla mtsho g.yung drung 'khyil mtsho sogs bka' brgyad ka'i pho brang ya mtshan che zhing mtsho'i kha dog kyang lha rang rang gi mdog dang mthun pa/ khyad par phur pa'i bla mtsho'i dbus su brag de'u gru gsum gyi steng du rdo chung ngu phur pa'i dbyibs kho na spungs pa zhig 'dug pa mtsho dbus su song ba'i phyi nas mthong ba ma gtogs lag tu len rgyu ni mi 'dug |mtsho bran gu ru drag po dang tshe dpag med sogs kyi bla mtsho ngo mtshar can mang po dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i khrus kyi rdzing bu mtsho ma ma ting ting zer ba khang pa ka ba bcu drug tsam gyi mal la 'gram gyi rtsa shing las mtsho'i kha rkang gang tsam gyis mtho ba phyir mi 'bo ba sogs ya mtshan tshad las 'das pa 'dug /de'i phur nags gseb tu zhi ba rigs brgya'i pho brang g.yu mtshor grags pa kha dog g.yu drug dkar kho na lta bu zhig 'dug pa'i 'gram du ku co dang me 'bud pa sogs ci yang byas mi chog pa'i bka' shin tu gnyan pa 'dug |de la sogs pa'i gnas der ya mtshan du ma dang lhag par nyin re bzhin nam mkhar 'ja' sprin dang me tog gi char dang rol mo'i sgra dang spos kyi dri ngad ldang ba/ bdag kyang lan mang du tshogs kyi 'khor lo bgyis pa'i ma da na btung ngam snyam pa'i ra ro ba yang lan 'ga' yar dang*/ shing sdong gi lpags pa'i 'og gdung sha ri ram dngos su zhus chog pa bdag gis kyang 'ga' zung khyer ba sogs/ mdor na gnas de'i ya mtshan bag dro zhing byin chags pa sogs ni tsā ri la yang med pa tsam du 'dug /de nas bteg sgar mang spyang ki la brgyud zla dgon du btang*/ bdag rags bsdus kyis mar khu thang dang phe phe thang tshal rag thang stod sogs brgyud spo bo ka nam rdzong du slebs/ ka nam sde pa dpon tshe dbang nor bzang sogs la rdo rje phur pa'i dbang bskur byas/

slar nags 'bur mgor ngal gso zhing dbyar gyi ring bsdad/ ka nam sde pa nor bu bzang po sogs skya ser mang rabs la dgyes rdor gyi dbang dang nā ro chos drug gi nyams khrid 'khrul 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ sde pa nor bzang sogs la snyan ngag me long yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtsom rgyug sogs drang nges kyi chos mang pos tshim par byas/ de tshor 'brum pa'i 'tshe ba zhig byung bar gshin rje khro chu'i zlog pa rtags ldan du byas pas 'brum pa'i 'tshe ba rgyun chad/ slar ka nam sde pa nor bzang yang bdag gi zlar phebs pa dang sbrag spo bo gzhung brgyud khyung do la nas thon te zla dgon du slebs/ mi ring bar sde pa nor bu bzang po yang bsnyen par rdzogs pa bsgrubs/ khong pas dbu mdzad 'dus pa kha shas rtsa 'dab snyan brgyud kyi zab khrid 'khrul 'khor rgyab mdun gyi thur ma'i lag len yongs su rdzogs pa steng sgo dang 'og sgo'i rdzogs rim gang nyams su len kyang gzhan dring 'jog mi dgos pa'i pha 'bab dang*/ gzhan yang dza har pir nas brgyud pa'i rlung khrid dang*/ rgyal dbang ratna'i dag snang gi zab chos yid bzhin nor mchog gi khrid lung sogs zab chos mtha' yas pas tshim par bgyis nas sos dal du gnas pa'i skabs shig /bdag lung pa chen po zhig tu slebs 'dug par dgra rgyug pa'i 'ur zhogs cher byung bas bdag kyang dogs zon dang bcas phyin pas/ dgra ni mi 'dug dkyil 'khor gyi stegs bu chen po zhig 'dug pa'i steng gi rdul tshon rnams 'phyags/ dbang rdzas gzhan ci yang med par dbus der gser gyi rdo rje zhig bzhag 'dug pa rmis pa/ phyis brtags pas dgra brgyugs pa dang dkyil 'khor 'phyags pa sogs ni/ 'bri gung du sog po mthu med brgyugs pa dang*/ rje nā ro pa sog yul du spyan 'dren pa'i ltas dang*/ gser gyi rdo rje dbus su bzhag pa ni/ bdag rang phyis 'bri gung du gnas chags pa'i ltas su 'dug

/de ltar zla dgon du bag phebs par bsdad cing snye bo ri gong kha'i sngags 'chang dkon mchog skyabs spyan drangs/ dbus gtsang gi dregs pa nyi shu'i 'khor lo 'di bas ches zab cing rmad du byung ba/ sum pa byang chub blo gros pa'i gter ma zhal sbyor drug sogs gnad du ma dang ldan pa yang gdeng 'khel bar slob pa'i tshe/ chu mo phag lor 'bri gung du sog po mthu med brgyugs/ sa rigs rnams bgo bsha' btab/ rje nā ro pa yang sog pos spyan drangs 'dug par/ phyis gtsang sde srid nas dpung chen dbus su byon pas sog po rnams byang du byer/ sa rigs rnams rang mal byung 'dug kyang*/ rab tu rje nā ro pa tshur gdan e 'drong*/ de min na'ang rang dang brje 'phrul tsam e 'ong*/ tha na yang mjal tsam thub tu re bas ka nam sde pa yang spo bo phu lung ri khrod du phebs/ bdag tsho'i che gzhis zla dgon du bzhag |shad rtsol gyis 'bri gung du sleb par byas pas rje btsun mi la ras pa rang yul du phebs pa'i skabs sam/ rgya mtsho chen po nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu gzhan du song na nor bu mching bu gzhan rnams yod kyang don med par 'gyur ba ji lta bar/ rje nā ro pa ni byang du spyan drangs/ tshur phebs pa dang bdag dang brje 'phrul dang zhal mjal sogs kyi skabs ni ji ltar byas kyang ma byung bas snying bton pa'i ro khog ltar re zhig spro lung du bsdad/ skabs shig stag sher gyi jag pas sde pa gzhung gi sbra kha 'ga' zhig dang*/ rje nā ro pa'i sbra kha dang*/ bdag rang gi byes mdzo gang yod 'phyags/ gtsang du zhus pa'i zhal ngo 'gras khur pa can mi snar byung yang ming don mtshungs pa'i srol 'byed ma gtogs dpyis phyin pa ma byung bas/ ltas ngan dmag gi rgyal mo dang dregs pa khams byon zab khyad can sogs las sbyor mang du bgyis pas dregs pa'i 'khor lo'i rtsar nub re bzhin khrag 'dzags pa sogs kun gyis mthong zhing phyis rtags kyang mgo mngon byung*/

de'i tshe byi ba lor zhabs drung gdung brgyud sku gshegs/ mtshe'u khar chog mang gral gtsor stag lung zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal phebs pa dang lhan cig mjal gsung sgros sogs ni ci yang ma byung*/ glang lor bdag tsā ri mjal skor du 'gro bar brtsam par phal che bas zhabs drung gdung brgyud pa yang tsā rir phebs pas sku tshe'i bar chad byung ba yin/ khyod kyang phyin pa mi 'gab zer yang*/ gcig la ci byung kun la yong ba'i nges pa med bsam thag bcad nas phyin/ 'di skabs las tshan bcu gsum gyi 'bod mi dang dngos nyams mang por zhing skyong sogs gnas bdag rnams kyi 'bod mi byung bas/ nyang po dang 'ba' yas sna mas sna sogs brgyud nas zhur po rong la thon sgam por phyin/ rje nor bu rgyan pa dang mjal/ zhag gsum bsdad sgam po snyan brgyud gter gsar de'i dbang lung yang zhus/ slar bteg sku rab tu yang ri drung pa sogs mjal/ yang ri'i rta bsu dang zhabs tog tshad med pa mdzad/ chos zam du slebs nas zla bo thams cad rkang thang khres po rgyab khur byas/ rim gyis gnas chen mo'i nang du 'byor nas bskor ba la zhag bcu lhag cig 'gor ba byas| g.yu mtsho khar zhag lnga bsdad pa'i ring nyams snang dpag tu med pa byung*/ gzhan yang kā la dung mtsho dang me 'bar mtsho dang mtsho gnyis la sogs gnas skor ba phal cher gyis mi mjal ba rnams kyang mjal/ yul smad du sleb par nye ba na tsā ri ba rnams kyis bsu ba ser sbrengs tshad med pa byas/ der gzhi phab pa'i skabs sgrub sde de'u yags su phyin tshogs 'khor dang 'thor nas byas/ bya khyung nas dpon slob rgyal dbang bstan 'dzin yang gsang sngags rnying ma'i thugs zhen gyis bdag dang 'phrad par phebs 'dug pa mjal/ bzhed don ltar dgongs pa yang zab kyi dbang lung cha tshang ba phul/ bya khyung pa 'di rje sangs rgyas gling pa'i chos brgyud dgongs 'dus rang gi chos bdag yin 'dug pas dgongs 'dus kyi dbang lung gsol ba nan gyis btab par/

bdag kong po'i ban rgan khyim pa zhig gis de 'dra ba'i gnas ga la srid ces zhal gyis bzhes pa ma byung bas/ yab sras gsum rang la bka' srung gi srog gtad dam bsre snying gi khrag tig phul ba'i nub gtor ma phyag tu 'jog pa dang dus mtshungs par dam tshig la bkar ba'i zhu ba phul bas zhal gyis bzhes shing*/ tsā ri gnas bzang bas tshe'i rten 'brel gyis dbang ni dgongs 'dus kyi gnas skabs bdud rtsi'i sgrub pa drug gi ya gyal tshe sgrub bdud rtsi snying po'i dbang dang*/ bya khyung pa gong ma ngag dbang padma rnam rgyal gyi ljags bsgrigs dgongs 'dus dkyil chog don gnyis lhun grub dang*/ bsnyen pa tsha ba dmar thag rnams kyi ljags lung zhus/ 'bri gung du phebs dgos pa'i zhu ba gsol bas dgyes bzhin du gnang ba stsal/ yul smad du zhag nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsdad pu ri rgyab skor byas yul stod du phyin/ slar sngar gyi lam brgyud sgam por dpe cha kha shas rtsol sgrub byed rtsis yin yang*/ lam bar du stag sher bas bsgugs pa'i skad cha khungs thub snga phyir byung bas e go ra chos rdzong dang lha khongs thang sogs brgyud/ bsam yas kyi gnas mjal shud tsam byas chos skyong ni ma bab/ rgya ma'i la brgyud yul phyi shongs su sleb nyin/ mo thal ru bar stag sher brgyugs par mo thal gyis ra mda' byas pas stag sher ba nyi shu tsam rkyen lam du btang 'dug |de ltar byi lo nas stag lo'i bar stag sher gyi jag pa ngo ma brgyad cu lhag nges steng gdon dang rims kyi dbang du song 'dug */de skabs su sprul sku tha ba kha pa byams pa lhas sbyin gyis bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i zhal thang grwa tshar dang dbang sgrub kyi tsaka li cha tshang du bzhengs/ de nas spro lung du bsdad skabs zhabs drung spro lung du gshegs pa de nyid kyi bka' dang*/ rje zhwa dmar ba drug pa'i bka' nan dang gtsang sde srid kyi bkas 'bri gung gi lugs gnyis kyi 'gan 'khur dgos tshul gnang byung bar/

dpon po'i bka' rang ji ltar byas kyang sla mod kyang*/ bla ma'i gsung bcag na rdo rje theg pa'i dngos grub lta zhog rdo rje dmyal ba nyams su myong dgos par 'jigs nas/ me pho stag lor 'bri gung pa'i 'gan 'khur gzhan dbang gi mngag gzhug bran pa la dpon gyi ming snyan dang*/ khol po la bla ma'i ming btags pa 'di mi yong yang e yong lta ba'i khul byas/ cho 'phrul zla bar zur 'phyong nub kyi gzims chung sbug mar gshin rje tshe bdag dang khro chu sbrags pa'i bsnyen sgrub cig bgyis pa'i tshes brgyad kyi zhogs pa nyi shar gyi thun btang nas bsnyen pa bgyis pa'i 'phror gnyid zim pa 'dra ba'i ngang la mdun gyi sgo chung la nyi ma phog pa de mthong ba 'dra zhig gis rkyen byas nas/ steng du gshin rje tshe bdag dang*/ de'i 'og tu khro chu gnyis sku mdog rgyan chas rdzogs shing gzi brjid tshad las 'das pa zhig yun shin tu ring bar mthong zhing*/ de'i mod la gnyid mthug gi 'od gsal gyi ngang nas rang gzhan thams cad kyi sems kyi rtog pa dang byed spyod gang yang gsal por shes pa zhig byung*/ de'i dbyar stod bya khyung pa rgyal dbang padma bstan 'dzin rdzong gsar du spyan drangs/ bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi dbang bcu gcig rdzogs chen snying po gser zhun nyams khrid ngo sprod lag len rdzogs par/ lam 'bras rtsa rlung rdo rje'i dra mig nyams khrid 'khrul 'khor lag len gdeng khel ba/ phyag rgya chen po dang gcod yul lung khrid/ gzhan rnams bklag lung*/ gzhan yang phur sgrub thugs kyi nying khu'i dbang lung*/ tshe sgrub nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbang lung*/ rnam sras gser chen dang dmar po'i skor/ gzhan yang gtad khram rus sbal nag po/ rgyal sel lha khang ma la sogs gter phran du ma dang*/ phyag rdor dregs 'dul padma las 'brel rtsal gyi zab gter sogs du ma'i dbang lung lag khrid rdzogs par zhus|

dam pa de nyid mnyes pa gsum gyis yang dag par mchod nas kong phyogs su phebs pa'i zhabs phyir dge slong rin chen dbang rgyal dpe cha kha yar 'bri bar brdzangs/ de'i phyi lo me yos lo'i dbyar smad zla ba bdun par gtsang nas zhabs drung lcam drung spyan drangs pa'i mod/ ser skya kun zhen 'dod tsam ma gtogs rgyal dbang ratna'i skabs a stag bla ma kun dga'i dris lan dang*/ gter ston 'ja' tshon snying po'i gter lung kha shas dang*/ rang gi nyams rmis 'ga' zhig la dpags na don de 'bras ldan du 'byung ba ni chu shing gi snying po dang 'dra ba nyid do| |de nas rdzong du cho 'phrul zla ba'i skabs bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor chen por chos sman bsgrubs pas ya mtshan gyi rtags mang du byung*/ gzhan phyogs kyi rnam par 'tshe ba dag la gtad khram rus sbal nag po las la sbyar bas dga' ston du bgyis/ yang de phyogs rlung dmar dang gshin rje yang zlog klu bdud dang sbrel ba'i sgrub pa dang las sbyor bgyis pas/ de rnams rmeg med par da lta 'jig rten pa'i gnas mal du song ba thams cad kyi mngon sum du gyur pa 'di yin/ sbrul lo der rje zhwa dmar ba drug pa za dam du bzhugs/ rgyal ba'i dbang po chos dbyings rdo rje mthil sogs mjal bar phebs pa dang spro lung khang gsar rab gsal du mjal/ thugs nang shin tu dag cing gsung gleng yang mang du byung*/ de nas mi ring bar zhabs drung lcam drung gtsang du phebs/ bdag rdzong du yod thog 'phyong rgyas dpal ri grwa tshang ba dpon slob rags bsdus phebs byung bar rdzong gsar du bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi dbang rkyang sgrub chen dang sbrel ba dang*/ slar spro lung du phyin nas rdzogs chen snying po gser zhun gyi khrid ngo sprod dang sbrags pa dang*/ gzhan rnams lung shar rdzogs par byas/ gzhan phyogs kyi 'tshe ba rdo snum gyi 'khru sbyang sogs gtsang du byed dgos byung bar gshin rje king kang che ba shor sang nyi ma khros pa'i las sbyor gyi sgrub pa zhig byas par rtags mngon sum du mthong bar byung*/

sog yul nas phag mo zhabs drung mi pham rin chos pa bros byung ba'i skad char/ rje nā ro pa zla ba bdun pa'i yar tshes bcu gsum la zhi bar gshegs pa'i gtam ngan thos pas| mya ngan gyi khang bur zhugs shing gtsang du slob ston zhus pas yun ring tsam song 'dug pas sku tshigs dang sde dgon rnams 'dun byed pa sogs mi 'thad/ gzhan pa'i dgongs rdzogs sngar rgyun ltar 'gab gsungs pas/ chog mang 'bri gung rang gi sngar rgyun ltar 'bri gung mthil pas dbu mdzad dgon khag thams cad rdzong zhol du tshogs pa 'dus pa shin tu grangs mang ba byung*| gral gtsor sgam po sprul sku rje nor bu rgyan pa spyan drangs/ mchod pa'i sprin tshogs kyis yang dag par mchod/ tshogs mang grol nas rje sgam po par rdo rje gtsug lag phrin las drag po mngon du phyung ba'i dbang lung lag len/ phung bshig 'khor lo nag po bka' ma'i lung dang lag len/ drag gtad bam nag ma sogs/ drag po mngon spyod mang rabs/ sman spyad yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa/ de'i 'grel pa zla zer/ rgyud bzhi/ bye ba ring bsrel/ g.yu thog snying thig sogs gso dpyad skor/ sgra mdo ka lā pa dang*/ snyan ngag me long ma dang*| sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas sogs rigs gnas skor/ byams chos lnga/ dbu ma rtsa 'jug /mngon pa mdzod sogs shin tu mang ba'i lung tshur zhus/ rgyal dbang ratna'i bka' 'bum| skyob pa rin po che'i zab chos cha tshang sogs mang po'i lung phar yang phul/ de nas mi 'gyang bar gtsang nas zhabs drung lcam yang phyir phebs shing*/ bye ri stag rtse sogs bzhes skal du bsnams 'dug /de'i tshe hor dpon dkon mchog ces pa sku na phra yang rgyal po'i mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa rang gi tsha bo zhig yod pa rgya mar phebs lam du chibs kyis brdeb 'chos nas rgya mar grongs/ bdag shog zer bas mtshan brgyab khri khang du slebs/ sgrib sbyong dang sku gdung zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor chen por sreg sbyong sogs bdag rang gis bgyis/

thugs kha dog gser lta bu a ru ra tsam shin tu dang ba 'dren pa zhig byung ba ni bla ma chen po 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa phal cher la grongs rtags med par mi nag gi dpon por rtags de lta bu 'byon pa ni rdo rje theg pa'i cho ga 'khrul med tshad ldan bgyis pa'i byin rlabs kyi mthu mngon sum du bstan par sems so// slar yang 'khor nas mi ring bar hor dpon dkon mchog gi dgongs rdzogs la byang gi khra tshang ras khar hor dpon tshang du phyin/ cho ga dang sku rim gtor zlog sogs 'dod mthun byas/ hor dpon gyi dgongs rdzogs la sgam po nas rje nor bu rgyan pa yang phebs 'dug pa dang mjal/ shin tu zhib pa byung*/ bdag 'bri gung du 'byor thog rje sgam po pa yang 'bri gung brgyud rdzong gsar du phebs zhag kha yar bzhugs| 'di res bka' chos sogs tshur zhu phar 'bul che ba ma byung*/ khad kyis bye ri stag rtse'i mkhar las kyang tshugs shing*/ rdzong gsar du bal po dzñā na de wa dang gu ṇa sogs kha shas kyis rje nā ro pa'i dngul gdung rnam par rgyal ba'i mchod rten bzhengs/ thig rtsa sogs dri med mdo dang*/ bu ston rin po che/ brag nag pa dpal legs sogs kyi dgongs pa 'khrul med du bdag rang gis bgyis/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu bzhugs/ nang bzhugs sogs dkar chag logs su yod pa ltar rdzong gsar gyis zur 'phyong nub tu bzhugs par bdag rang gis zla gsang nag po'i dkyil 'khor du rab gnas zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg dang bcas pa/ slar 'dus pa dang lhan cig sdom pa rga lo lha lnga'i sgo nas rab gnas dang*/ phyis zhabs drung spro lung gi bde gshegs kyis kyang rab gnas gnang*/ skabs shig o rgyan rin po che'i sku gser gar blugs las grub pa sogs dang*/ rten bzhengs phran bu mang du bgyis/ de nas skabs shig rdzong gi lcang lo can du zla gsang gzhi bsnyen a kro bcu gcig pa gtong ba'i mtshams bcad pa'i tshe bsnyen pa'i skabs sde brgyad kyi cho 'phrul mang du byung zhing lha rtags kyang tho re ba byung*/

nye bar bsnyen pa'i rmi lam du lha'i rtags mtshan mang du byung*/ sgrub pa'i tshe 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag dngos su zhal mjal ba ni lan 'ga' byung la gsung gi gnang ba ni ma byung*/ nang mchod khol ba'i lbu ba la 'khor lo la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ la sogs pa'i yig 'bru'i rnam pa 'byung ba sogs ni dus rtag tu byung*/ sgrub pa chen po dngos grub kyi sgrub pa'i tshe dngos grub kyi rdzas shel snod du blugs pa chil sgra dang bcas khol ba'i lbu bar phyag mtshan dang yig 'bru mang po byung ba shel snod kyi phyi nas mthong ba dang lud nas phyir zham pa sogs byung*/ dngos grub blangs nas lha sgrub bdud sgrub kyi skabs sde brgyad dang las gshin sogs las la tshud pa'i mtshan ma lan 'ga' yar mthong bas phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg rdzogs par byas nas khad kyis mtshams grol/ rebs kyi chu tshan la phyin zhing mthil zhol du dbyar chos sgar yang phab 'dug pa'i sar bos pas phyin/ dbyar chos kyi ring der bsdad cing tshogs chen la phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid rim rgyas pa zhig phul/ de nas phyir log nas zhabs drung lcam drung gi thugs bzhed ltar 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang gis smin par byas nas lnga ldan nyams khrid du phul bas thugs nyams rtogs tshad med pa 'khrungs shing*/ de nas bzung thugs dam dang dge ba'i phyogs 'ba' zhig la thugs brtson pa 'di yang byung ba yin/ de nas khad kyis stag rtse'i mkhar las kyang grub pas lcam drung dpon g.yog stag rtser phebs/ rjes su bdag gis kyang phyin pa sogs rdzong gsar dang stag rtse'i bar du don med kyi 'gro 'dug mang du byas tshul la dgos pa'i tshogs ma mchis pas ma bris/ skabs shig rdzong du bsdad thog lcags mo lug lo rang lo so bdun pa'i zla ba lnga pa'i nyer bdun gyi nyin dge slong lha mo dang bla sgrub kyi 'phros shig byung bas sems khrid pa 'dra bas de nub tho rangs khar mthil gyi thog kha gser khang du bdag slebs nas/

gser khang chos rjer phyag byas pa'i tshe gser khang chos rjes bdag la lam gzhan bas bla ma sgrub pa zab tshul gsungs par/ bdag gis rang sems don dam pa'i bla ma rtogs na logs nas bsgrub mi 'tshal yang gzhan don du 'gyur srid pas bla ma sgrub tshul zhus par/ lam zab bla sgrub kyi smin lam dbang gi chu bo/ phyi sgrub byin rlabs 'byung gnas/ nang sgrub 'khor 'das rang grol/ gsang sgrub ye shes rgya mtsho/ de kho na nyid spros bral mthar phyin/ rtsa rlung rdo rje'i phreng ba/ rdzogs rim mnyam yang mtha' bral/ gegs sel bde ba'i rdo rje/ phrin las kha bsgyur gzhan phan snying po rnams tshigs bcad 'ba' zhig tu gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang bslab bya lung bstan mang du gsungs pa las/ bla sgrub rnams yi ger bris pa lo rgyus dang bcas pa logs su yod pa ltar yin/ de la kha skong rgyun 'khyer che chung gnyis sogs phran bu ni bdag rang gis byas shing de 'phral skya ser kha yar la de kha'i dbang khrid 'khrul 'khor sogs rdzogs par byas/ stag rtser bsdad pa'i skabs shig bla ma rin chen grags pa ba log pa'i gsung gis bskul nas/ skya ser grangs mang bar gzims chung khams gsum du grub chen 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i zhabs la/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su stsal ba phreng ba skor gsum du grags pa la sgrub thabs rnal 'byor rdzogs phreng dang dkyil chog 'jigs med dgongs rgyan zhes/ karma phrin las gnyis pa 'jigs bral gsung rab gter mdzod sbas pa'i sde'i ljags sgrig go don dang bcas pa'i yig cha ches 'phags pa de'i steng nas/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor nyer brgyad po nyin re dkyil 'khor gnyis re'i dbang bskur sta gon nyin gcig dngos gzhi nyi ma bcu bzhi byas par/ sta gon gyi kun slong 'chos pa nas bzung dngos gzhi rdzogs pa'i gtang rag yan chad la gzhung tshig 'bru gcig kyang ma lus pa so sor go don dang de'i lung rigs sogs rgyud don dang ma 'gal nges kyi bshad pa nyi ma bcu bzhi po la tshar gcig rdzogs par byas/

de'i tshe bum chu dang nang mchod la byin rlabs gzhan ma 'dres par ril bu byas pa rnams chung ngu sro ma tsam mang du 'phel ba dang*/ ril bu rnams ril chags byed pa'i snod dkar yol sogs kyi nang du chu tshan ltar khol ba dang*/ ri ldebs la rta mi rgyug pa ltar snod kyi ldebs su ril bu rgyug pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang ldan pa ni bcas pa grub chen ma sogs dad ldan mang po rang la byung 'dug /de grol 'phral klu sdings gser mdog lhun por zhabs drung lcam drung la yang rtsa dkyil nyer brgyad po sta gon nyin gcig dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor bzhi re la nyin re byas pa'i nyi ma bdun la rdzogs par phul/ sa pho stag lor btsun tshal chos rgyal bas mthil gyi gling la rab gnas skyor ba dang bstan srung rnams la phyag mtshan phul gsungs pas/ mthil zhol du sgar btab/ zla gsang gi rgyud ltar rab gnas rgyas pa dang ma mgon la phyag mtshan tshang bar phul/ yang rdzong gsar du sa mo yos lo hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i yar tshes brgyad nas bzung 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag gi las sbyor gyi sgrub pa zhig bgyis pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nub rmi lam du/ khang pa rnying pa zhig gi nang du bsus zlog cig byed kyi 'dug pa'i bsus ma'i tshig rnams drung pa lhang lhing mo pa yin rgyu ba zhig gis 'khrab cing thon 'dug /de'i lan 'debs bshol ma byed mkhan khang pa de'i gung nas bla ma mchod gnas ga 'dogs ma yin rgyu ba gzugs shin tu che ba mgos lcam la brten pa zhig byams bzhugs byas nas lan 'debs/ de dag gi bar bar du bu mo rgyan chas sogs sngar mthong ma myong ba mang po sa la bsdad nas gdangs snyan po zhig 'then gyi 'dug pa nyan pas/ 'khor lo rin chen bkra shis don gyi lha// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs stsol// zhes rtags brgyad kun la sbyar ba yin 'dug /khang pa'i gung na rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi sku thang zhig bshams 'dug pa'i zhal nas/

mche ba gtsigs shing bsgrims pa yi| |'jigs pa'i tshul gyi sku yis ni// zhes sogs zla gsang gi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i bstod pa de gsung gi 'dug pa'i mu la gnyid sad pa zhig byung*/ tshes bcu gsum gyi nub sa gzhi ngo mi shes pa zhig tu bdag slebs 'dug par sa 'og nas 'od dmar po shin tu che ba nyi ma stong las kyang gzi 'od 'bar ba'i dbus su nyi ma dmar po g.yo zhing 'tsher ba zhig yar thon/ steng nas 'od dkar po phyogs bcur 'bar zhing 'phro ba'i dbus su zla ba dkar po 'tsher zhing 'bar ba zhig mar bab/ de gnyis lhan cig bdag gi lus kyi steng 'og tu thim pa dang sbrags dar cig dran med du song*/ dran med de sangs nas sngar med pa'i bde stong zung 'jug gi nyams rtsol ba mi dgos pa zhig skyes pa'i 'phror gnyid sad byung ba ni rlung rtsol 'khrul 'khor sogs skabs der ma byas kyang*/ sngags bzlas pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang yi dam gyi thugs rjes dwangs ma dkar dmar dbu ma'i nang du 'phrad cing 'dres par 'dug /tshes bco lnga'i thor thun btang nas sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ lcang lo can gyi gnam yangs kyi nam mkhar 'od lnga 'khrugs shing 'bar ba'i dbus su 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon yab yum sras sprul 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsal la rdzogs pa 'od du 'bar zhing dgyes pa'i nyams dang gad mos stong gsum gang bar sgrog pa zhig mjal ba'i tshe/ tshad med pa'i dad pa brtan pos mchod cing bstod nas smon lam mang du btab pa'i mod la 'ja' tshon ltar yal song ba'i tshe nam langs kyi ngag 'don la 'jug ran par 'dug /nyer lnga'i nam gung gi thun btang nas sngags bzla ba'i tshe 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi sku shin tu khro zhing mi sdug pa zhig mjal bas/ de'i nyin zhag gi ring 'dar zhing 'jigs snang che cher ltar byung ba'i phyis nub nyer drug gi srod thun btang nas gnyid la thum tsam song ba'i tshe rang gi lto ba nas/

sngar dam nyams pa'i slob ma 'ga' zhig lus ham skya thal mdog gos hrul gyon pa lus bongs shin tu chung zhing nyams thag pa'i rnam pas thon song ba zhig byung ba ni/ yi dam gyi thugs rjes dam sri'i bar gcod 'ga' zhig tshar bcad par nges so// nyer bdun gyi srod thun btang ba'i mod gnyid la thum tsam song ba skad cig la 'jigs pa'i snang bas bskul te sad byung ba na yar bltas pas/ lcang lo can gyi gnam yangs mthongs su 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon phyag gnyis pa rgyan dang mtshan dpe rdzogs pa lta bas chog mi shes pa ma he chu glang padma zla nyi'i gdan la gar dgus bsgyings shing*/ zhal nas e ā ra li pheṃ pheṃ phaṭ phaṭ gsung ba zhig yun ring du mjal bar sems ma yeng par dar cig lha des dmigs rten ltar byas ting nge 'dzin las mi g.yo bar bzhag 'phral slar gnyid du song 'dug /de'i sang nyin phan chad mig btsums nas yi dam gang gsal btab pa de nyid gsal bar mthong ba zhig yod pa de/ de nas bzung mig btsums nas yi dam gsal 'debs mi dgos par yid la gang bsam pa de skad cig la dngos 'dra bar mthong*/ de gsal bzhin du yi dam gzhan gang 'dod pa zhig yid la byas ma thag snga ma de nyid phyi ma yid la gang byas der lam lam 'gro ba zhig nyin mtshan kun tu da lta'i bar rgyun chad med par 'dug /sgrub pa de'i ring las sbyor 'grub pa'i ltas mang du byung ba ni 'dir ma bris/ de nas nyer dgu la las sbyor rdzogs par byas te mtshams kyang khad kyis grol/ lo re'i sos gtor zla ba gnyis pa rang la gtong rtsis dang*/ skya ser mang bar chos drug gi khrid rgyas pa zhig kyang tshugs pa'i gtum mo rdzogs mtshams tsam du rgya sgo bar du a bo don grub rgyal po 'brum nag gis gtses/ de nyid gzhan rnams su yang mched pas shin tu bred pa dang*/ de skabs lcam drung rdzong du bzhugs skabs yin pas sku 'brum byung dogs kyis brdzangs par snyam yang*/

phyag phyi 'ga' zhig dbang yod khrel med kyis ya ga sna tshogs sgrog cing byed stangs la sems pham pa zhig byung ba'i ngang nas/ lcam drung stag rtser phebs/ chos drug gi khrid 'phro yang lus/ sos gtor yang 'gyangs pa'i ngang nas nad de la dmigs pa'i drang srong loka tri pā la'i las sbyor 'byung bzhi yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub pa zhig bdag rang gis lcang lo can du bgyis/ bla ma rgyal sras mnga' bdag gis gtsos gu ru drag po pad gling lugs dmar chen gyi sgrub pa bka' blon shag tu byas pa'i tshe/ tshes bcu gsum gyi nub rmi lam du sngar gtsang gi gnas rnying rgyal po rje nā ro par brdzus nas byung*/ bdag gis loka tri'i dbang bskur byas pa de nyid/ de nub mi dkar rta dkar can zhig tu byas nas byung ba ngo shes kyang*/ khyod su yin byas pas/ nga gnas rnying rgyal po yin zer/ ci byed du 'ong byas pas/ bdag gis sngar loka tri'i dbang zhus pa de shin tu legs pa byung bas do nub kyang bdag la loka tri'i dbang zhig zhu zer/ de ltar byas pa'i 'gro khar bka' drin che byung da dung skabs su bab pa zhig gi dus loka tri'i dbang zhig kyang zhu ba dang skad cha gsar pa de 'dra yang khyer nas 'ong zer/ de nub dbang yon la mi mgo g.yu pad btags pa zhig dang lcags kyi tho ba zhig byin nas bud song*/ tshes bco lnga'i thor thun btang nas sngags bzla ba'i tshe lcang lo can gyi gnam yangs su 'od dkar po kha ba lta bu'i dbus su drang srong dri med shin tu mdzes shing gsal ba zhig mjal bas mchod bstod smon lam bgyis pa'i tshe/ drang srong gi zhal nas/ da lam 'brum bu'i nad 'di la 'jigs mi dgos myur du 'chad par 'gyur/ gzhan yang rims nad 'ga' yar 'dug pa chad nas 'gro/ bag 'khum par mi 'tshal/ de tsam du ma zad khyod rang gi lus kyang 'brum bu'i 'jigs pa las myur du thar bas 'tshe ba mi 'byung*/ zhes gsung gis dbugs phyung nas slar gsung gleng mang po'i mthar/

sngon khyod rgyal po dharma a sho kar gyur pa'i dus sa gdon gyis nyen pa yang kho bos grol bar byas/ de phyin skye ba 'ga' yar la kho bos rjes su bzung zhing da yang rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur/ khyod ma 'ongs skye ba bdun brgyud tsam du sa gdon gyi 'tshe ba zhig 'byung bas/ de mi 'byung ba dang gzhan rnams la'ang phan pa'i slad du/ rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga rakṣa'i bsnyen sgrub rtags ldan zhig gyis gsung nas mi snang bar gyur/ tshes bcu drug nas bzung bco brgyad kyi bar du sde brgyad spyi dang bye brag rgyal 'gong gi 'tshub shin tu che ba byung ba rnams drang srong gi dmod pas tshar bcad/ tshes bco brgyad kyi tho rangs rmi nyams 'dres pa 'dra ba zhig la/ shing gi khri chen po'i steng du drung pa lhang lhing mo pa bse theb cig gyon nas nyal 'dug pa'i gdong pa thams cad 'brum nag gis khyab de'i zla bo 'ga' shas kyang 'brum pa na 'dug pas/ bdag gis 'di rnams 'brum pa'i nad bdag yin nges snyam drang srong gi dmod pa drag pos de thams cad tshar bcad cing bsgral ba zhig byung bas/ nad yams chad pa'i mtshan mar mthong nas/ tshes bcu dgu la 'byung bzhi'i las sbyor rdzogs par byas nas nang mtshams lhod tsam byas te ngal gsos/ slar drang srong dri med kyi bka' ji lta bar zla ba de ka'i nyer drug nas/ rig pa'i rgyal po'i bsnyen sgrub pad lugs ku sā li dpa' bo rkyang sgrub kyi ngag mtshams shin tu dam pa zhig bgyis pa'i nyer dgu'i nub| rmi lam du lung pa ngo mi shes pa zhig tu bdag slebs 'dug par bdag ngos kyi nam mkhar sprin dang na bun nag po 'khrigs pa'i khrod nas kha char drag po bab byung bar/ bdag gis sngags btab pas lce steng nas sbrul nag 'jigs su rung ba zhig thon nas kha char sprin na bun dang bcas pa thams cad sbrul des hab kyis zos song ba zhig rmis/ nyer dgu phyi ma'i nub rmi lam du bdag zla bo mang po dang bcas gnas khang zhig tu sku gsung thugs rten mang po la 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyis rab tu gnas pa zhig bgyi 'dun gyis khrus gsol gdangs byas pas ma 'grim par chad pa'i tshe/

dkyil 'khor ras bris kyi gtso bo 'khor lo sdom pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la zhes tshig rnams bskul byung ba zhig rmis/ gnam gang gi nyin 'bru bzhi pa grangs tshad thems nas 'bru bcu bzhi pa bsnyen/ dpa' bo rkyang sgrub la sgrub rten mi dgos kyang bcu bzhi pa'i tshe tshogs sgrub dang sbrel bas sgrub rten seng ldeng ngam gra ma'i phur bu dang bcas sgrub pa'i tshe/ nyin gung gi thun nas bzung srod thun ma grub bar raksha gdong drug kho na'i bgrang phreng zhig yod pa de'i phreng thag sbrul nag po 'jigs su rung ba zhig kho na phreng ba'i mig rnams su khyur khyur shigs shigs byed pa sha stag mthong*/ 'di nga'i mig 'khrul ba yin phreng thag sbrul la 'gro ba mi srid snyam bltas kyang de khar 'dug /mnyam bzhag byas kyang de kar 'dug /bskyed rim byas kyang de ka ltar 'dug pas/ phreng thag mi dgos nga rang sbrul du song yang bzod ci ltar song ba ltar gyis ang snyam thag bcad nas nyal ba'i rmi lam du sngar rab sgang du dam la bzhag pa'i 'brum bu'i nad bdag go zhal mo slebs byung bar khyod gang nas 'ong dris pas gtsang nas dbus chu gzhung brgyud 'ongs zer/ khyod kha nyin 'brum bu la dmigs pa'i sgrub pa byas skabs mi 'ong ba ci yin dris pas/ da lam 'brum pa 'di bdag gis btang ba min yang khyed kyis bsam par sngar rab sgang gser phye thang du khas blangs kyang don la ma gnas bsam bdag gsod kyis dogs yong ma nus zer/ 'o na da lam 'brum bu sus btang dris pas/ 'phan yul du a bo a rgyal 'brum pa na ba'i tshe jo lags zer sems chags nas shi bas a bo don grub rgyal po na ba yin zer/ don grub rgyal po nad bdag la skyes pa a yin byas pas/ kho nad bdag la skyes pa min nad bdag dngos ni rgyal 'gong yin yang rkyen des byas zer/ da lam 'ong ba ci yin dris pas/ da lam 'brum pa bdag gis btang ngam snyam pa'i dogs pa sel du 'ongs zer/

da gar 'gro dris pas/ gar 'gro rang cha med kyang phal cher dbus gtsang gang rung du phyin na thad zer bud song*/ gnam gang gi srod tsam nas lus la za ba dang g.ya' ba dang tsha phrig dang sha 'gul dang sha ro sogs lus la phyag rgya thebs pa'i rtags rnams rdzogs par byung yang*/ tshes gcig dang gnyis la sgang shod thengs gsum gyi rnam pa tsam byas pas/ tshes gnyis kyi nyin phur bu rnams la du ba dang me stag 'phro ba lan mang bar byung*/ de nub srod thun thog rig pa'i rgyal po dpa' bo rkyang sgrub gsal la mjal bas sems can thams cad kyi sa gdon gyi nad/ bdag gi lus la phyag rgya thebs pa 'dis go chod par gyur cig /khyad par bdag gis srung ba tshad ldan btags pa dang srung 'khor du bcug pa'i mi la sa bdag klu'i gnod pa rgyun chad pa sogs smon lam dpyis phyin pa btab nas 'ja' ltar yal song*/ nam gung mi sngon po zhig byung ba gang nas 'ong dris pas/ mal dro nas 'ongs zer/ su yin dris pas/ klu'i rgyal po gzi chen bya ba de yin zer/ ci byed du 'ong dris pas/ gtam zer du 'ongs zer/ gtam smos shig byas pas/ dbu ru ka tshal du nga'i 'dra 'bag yod pa'i sar sngar sha chang sogs ye mi khyer ba yin yang*/ dus phyis bag med rang du khyer bas nga ma bde/ de'i rkyen gyis mal gror klu nad dang gri 'thab mang du song ba yin/ da khyed kyis nga'i 'dra 'bag gi sar sha chang mi khyer ba'i bkod pa dang*/ nga'i 'dra 'bag la khrus dang sman mang po rin po che dar zab 'bru sna tshogs dang bcas pas gtams na mal gro yongs dang khyad par ka tshal dgon pa la phan/ bdag kyang dga' ba yin zer langs song*/ phyis stag rtser 'gro ba zhig gi zhor la ka tshal du phyin nas klu'i ngag ltar byas yod/ nam de'i gung la sngar srod kyi rmi lam de'i rkyen gyis sngon chos rgyal khri srong la klu mal gro'i gnod pa byung skabs slob dpon chen po padma la gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/

slob dpon chen pos sngon 'das pa'i tshe rgya gar gyi yul bhaṅga la a saṃ tra zhes bya bar rgyal po ratna dha ra gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba'i sras rgyal bu mtha' yas 'od bya ba lo bcu gnyis lon pa'i tshe sa gdon gyis rkang pa gnyis gum ste mal du gnas pa na/ yab rgyal po'i mchod gnas dge slong khrims ldan zhig yod pa de la yab kyis/ dge slong khyod kyis bdag gi bu sa gdon las grol bar gyis shig /ces bsgo ba'i tshe dge slong des rang gi lha la gsol ba btab pas lha yis 'di skad ces/ dge slong dag ri bo mgrin bzang zhes bya ba'i rtse mor sangs rgyas 'od srung gis rab gnas mdzad pa'i mchod rten zhig yod pa de'i bum pa'i nang du klu'i rgyud 'bum gyi ṭī ka bzhugs yod pas de'i nang na klu'i srung ba nā ga rakṣa zhes bya ba yod pa de blangs la nyams su longs shig /ces lung bstan pa rmis pas/ dge slong des de ltar bgyis pas rgyal bu nad las grol ba yin no// rgyal po chen po de'i tshe de'i dus yab rgyal po ratna dha ra gtsug gi nor bu ni mnga' bdag khri srong yin no// de'i sras rgyal bu mtha' yas 'od ni lha sras mu tig btsad po dge ba'i dpal 'di yin no// mchod gnas dge slong de ni nga yin no// zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa yang dran par gyur/ de nas thor thun gyi skabs/ 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das mtshams shed na zhes sogs bstod pa 'don pa'i skabs rig pa'i rgyal po dbu dgu phyag nyis brgya rtsa zhal sdig pa'i zhal sogs tshom bu tshogs sgrub gnubs lugs ji lta ba 'khor bcas gsal la rdzogs pa mjal/ phyi nangs lus byings kyi sha ro la sogs pa zhi nas/ rkang pa g.yas pa'i ngar gdong gi mar zur phyi ldebs kyi sha ro dang shu ba rnams cung zad chung du song nas shul da lta yang gsal por yod pa yin/ phyi nangs mdang gi nyams snang la sngon gnas dran pa de la the tshom byung bas nā ga rakṣa'i chos skor rnams g.yengs nas bltas pas lo rgyus rgyas par mdang gi de kho na ltar 'dug pa mthong bas yid ches thob pa byung*/

de nas tshes gsum gyi nyin mo klu'i srung ba rab gnas sogs gzhung ltar byas nas mtshams kyang khad kyis grol ba yin/ de ltar na 'brum bus nyen pa sogs kyi tshe bdag lta bu nyams chung 'khos zhan la/ gzhan rnams dbang yod khrel med gang 'gro btang gtong ba las tshod mi 'dzin pa de rnams kyi ya ga dang ngan smras kyis lung ba bkang ba'i tshe ma bslus par gang 'dod thog tu 'bab pa'i dngos grub skad cig la stsol ba'i lha mchog de ni rgad bu og zhol can 'di yin no gzhan yang skya ser drag zhan sus kyang pho skyes rgyab re ba bzhin byas pa su yang med/ 'on kyang de kas chog pa byung badzra kī li kī la phaṭ ang*/ 'di skor zhib pa dge slong lha mos bskul nas bris pa zhig kyang logs su yod/ yang bye ri stag rtser lcags pho 'brug lo zla ba dang po cho 'phrul chen po'i tshes gnyis nas brtsams zla gsang gzhi bsnyen ya ma bcu bdun pa la btang ba'i mtshams bcad dam po bsdams pa'i tshes gsum gyi nub rmi lam du/ rtse ba'i tshoms yin rgyu ba zhig tu bande mang po'i dbus su shing khri zhig bzhag 'dug pa bdag la bstan nas khyod da lo 'chi ba 'dug /shi nas phung po shing khri 'di'i steng du 'jog rgyu yin zer 'dug par/ bdag gi bsam par bande 'di rnams rgyal 'gong du 'dug |bdag la co 'dri bar zad kyi bdag gis kyang spros te smra'o snyam nas/ kho bo nam shi yang khyad med/ shi nas phung po shing khri'i khar bzhag kyang nyan/ khyod rang rnams za na yang zo/ gang bsam pa ltar gyis shig smras pas/ yang de rnams na re/ khyod shi na zhag bcu phrag gcig gsang dgos khyod nges par da lo 'chi ba yin zer bas/ bdag gis nga shi na khyod rnams dga' bar gyis/ lo stong phrag gsang yang gsongs ji ltar dga' bar gyis/ zhes smras pas de rnams gdong zhum pa ltar byas nas dengs song*/ tshes lnga'i nub dam sel dang nyams grib kyi mtshan ma kha yar dang bcas khams 'dus shing zos mi bde ba byung*/

tshes drug phyi ma'i nyin nyang po sang zin sgang du long po'i dmag byung ba thos pas rkyen byas pa ltar/ de nub nam srod la sde brgyad kyi 'tshub che zhing mang ba byung*/ nam gung gi thun grub nas bzlas pa byas pa'i mod gnyid la song 'dug par rmi lam du/ bdag zla bo mang po dang lhan cig khang pa ngo mi shes pa zhig tu bsdad 'dug par/ gzhan phyogs kyi dmag gi 'tshe ba zhig yong rgyu'i khul dang*/ ra ba'i nang du tsher ma mang po brtsegs 'dug pa yang bdag tshos bsrung dgos pa'i khul 'dra ba zhig 'dug par bande seng ge'i mgo can gtsod ru thogs pa zhig gis gtsos pa'i dmag mang du slebs byung ba de la bdag gis/ khyod dmag dpon yin na lag cha mi 'dug pa byas pas/ gtsod ru de bstan nas lag cha 'di yin zer/ des bdag la khyod kyi lag cha gang yin zer bar/ bdag gis phur bu dang rnga gdengs bstan nas lag cha 'di ka yin no lag cha la rag ma lus so byas nas/ bdag gi bsam par ban dmag 'di rnams la zla gsang rtsa ba'i rgyud chen nas gsungs pa nad ngan gtong ba ma mo'i zla gsang de byed do snyam de'i sbyor ba byas pas/ bande seng ge'i mgo can de sgo 'gag tu brang rdung gi 'dug /ci nyes byas pas/ dmag thams cad khrag nad kyis shi song ji ltar bya zhes ngu 'bod byed kyi 'dug |mi bden snyam sgo 'gag tu bltas pas dmag thams cad khrag bshal nas kha sbub tu shi 'dug pa rmis/ yang de ma thag nam mkha' nas 'brug sgra drag po sgrog cing thog ser mang po bab byung bar phur bu gdengs shing drag sngags bzlas sdigs mdzub gtad pas/ de dag phyogs gzhan du song nas ri 'bur zhig gi rtser mchod rten gcig 'dug pa thog gis bshig song ba zhig rmis pa ni byad kha zhig gzhan gyis bdag la btang ba bsgyur thub pa'i rtags su 'dug /de'i tho rangs bzlas pa'i mu byas shing nam langs su nye ba'i tshe gnyid la thum tsam song 'dug par rmi lam du/

bdag gis rta dmar po shin tu legs pa zhig zhon nas khang pa mang po'i thog tu 'gro 'dug pa'i tshe bsam pa la/ 'di rmi lam yin 'dug bdag mtshams bcad yin par rta zhon pa dang de yang khang thog tu 'gro ba sogs gar yong*/ 'di rmi lam yin pas sprul bsgyur ji ltar byas kyang btub pas nam mkhar rta rgyug bya'o snyam nas brgyugs pas thang la dkyus pa dang khyad mi 'dug /yang bsam par/ 'di rmi lam yin mod kyang theg chen rta la zhon nas stong nyid nam mkhar 'gro ba bsnyen sgrub kyi rtags bzang por nges pa yin no snyam pa'i tshe/ gzugs med pa'i skad chen pos de ltar yin no zer ma thag gnyid sad par gyur/ tshes bdun gyi nub khams nyog cing sde brgyad spyi sgos 'dus shing tshogs pa'i zang zing shin tu mang ba las 'di yin ma byung*/ tshes brgyad kyi nub de ring bdag cag gi ston pas bdud btul ba cho 'phrul chen po'i dus ston dngos gzhi yin snyam pas sems dad pa'i shugs drag po'i ngang nas gnyid du song ba'i rmi lam du/ sa yul ngo mi shes par grong khyer chen po'i dbus su seng ge'i khri chen po dar zab kyis g.yogs pa'i steng du bdag cag gi ston pa bzhugs pa'i drung du lha dang lha min mi'i rgyal po du ma dang*/ dge 'dun dang skye bo pho mo bgrang gis mi lang ba'i tshogs 'dus pa'i khrod du mu stegs kyi ston pa gcer bu thal mdog ral pa can dang ral pa med pa la rang gi 'khor mang po dang bcas 'dug la/ rgyal bas cho 'phrul mang po bstan nas mu stegs de rnams tshar bcad pa zhig rmis pas/ bdag gi bsam par 'di rmi lam du 'dug cho 'phrul chen po'i bshad pa rnams su mu stegs tshes brgyad la tshar bcad pa de'i sems rmis su 'dug /'on kyang ston pa dang mjal ba bskal ba bzang snyam pa byung*/ ha ha cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa de// sngon rabs gtam dang de'i bris sku// dpe klog lta bar re ma dgos// rmi lam nyams kyi snang ba ru// dngos su mjal bas dang re spro// tshes dgu dang bcu sogs la rmi lam zang zing mang zhing gzhi bdag dang lha 'dre sogs ngo mi shes pa mang po 'thab pa sogs 'tshub che ba byung*/

tshes bcu gsum gyi nub rmi lam gyi ltas zla ba thang la lhung ba sogs bsnyen sgrub tshad du phyin pa'i rtags 'ga' zhig byung*/ tshes bcu bzhi dang bco lnga la yi dam gyi sku yi snang brnyan mang du mthong zhing de thams cad kyang sprul bsgyur dngos su thub pa sogs byung*/ tshes bco lnga'i nub kyang sde brgyad kyi 'tshub che zhing lhag par stag rtse der rgyal 'gong dang gre bo dang chu 'dre sogs shin tu mang bar 'dug pa thams cad kyis gzugs ston cing cho 'phrul sogs kho rang tshor gang yod rdul sprugs su byed pa byung yang*/ lha sngags ting 'dzin gyi sbyor bas tshar bcad/ tshes bcu dgu'i nub phyi nang gi gdon bgegs mang po tshar bcad zin pa'i ltas mang ba dang*/ khyad par dregs pa sde brgyad las la tshud pa'i rtags mtshan mang ba byung*/ tshes nyi shu'i nyin nub thams cad du khams 'dus pas zos mi bde zhing tsab tsub mang ba rang byung bas bla ma dang yi dam la gsol ba btab pas/ 'jam dbyangs zhi ba'i sku'i snang ba yud tsam mthong nas gnyid du song 'dug pa'i tshe gnyid mthug gi 'od gsal ngos bzung zhing*/ de'i ngang la gnas pa'i da lta shi yang tshe snga phyi'i bar mtshams zhes pa ming tsam ma gtogs khang pa gcig nas gcig tu 'gro ba tsam las mi 'dug pas yid ches nges pa rnyed pas da lta'i bar gnyid kyi thim rim dang de'i ngang nas gnyid mthug gi 'od gsal ched du 'dzin mi dgos par rang shugs kyis zin pa kho na byung*/ de nub 'od gsal gyi ngang nas rigs drug gi gnas sbyong dpag tu med pa dang*/ rmi lam dang nyams sna tshogs pa byung yang yi ges ngal bas ma bris/ nyer gcig gi snga dro drang srong dri med zhi drag dang 'khor lo sdom pa sogs yi dam mang po'i zhal mthong*/ srod la dam can rdor legs ra rgya bo zhig khrid phad bu zhig khyer nas slebs byung*/ gang nas 'ong dris pas 'u yug nas 'ongs zer/ ci byed du 'ong dris pas/

phad bu 'di khyer nas 'ongs zer/ phad bu'i nang du mi skya spa lo yod pa 'brum rjes gnyis gsum tsam dang mig zur g.yon du sme ba yod pa/ pad 'dab dang kong rna shin tu che ba zhig bstan byung bar mgo des bdag la 'o cag pho lhas khyer ba ka yin zer bas/ bdag gis dam can par the'u rang zhes pa phra men 'byung po'i nang nas kyang tha shal byed rgyu mang la snying tshan chung ba zlos kha yang ba zhig yin yang yin te/ khyod 'dra ba pho lhar bsten nas mtha' rjes 'di 'dra las 'os ci yod ang byas pas dam can pa rang kha skyengs pa 'dra zhig byas song ba'i mur bdag kyang gnyid du song*/ tho rangs rmi lam du btsun tshal chos skyong slebs byung ci byed dris pas/ da dung gshin rje'i rgyud mang po rtsol ba byas nas 'bul zer byung bas de ltar gyis zer ba byas/ nyer gnyis nas bzung bsnyen sngags la don 'grub bsnyen pa'i rgyas sdebs rnams sbyar bas 'tshub shin tu che ba dang*/ de nub kyang yi dam dang chos skyong dang sde brgyad kyi rtags mtshan mang bar byung*/ tho rangs sngags bzla ba'i tshe mdun tu mi ro mang po glu len gar byed pa dang*/ me chu 'khrugs pa dang*/ sa rlung 'khrugs pa dang*/ gnam sa go ldog pa sogs cho 'phrul gyi rnam pa bsam las 'das pa byung yang rang sems kyi rol par thag chod pa'i gdeng yod pas ltad mo che bar lta bu byung*/ de'i phyi nyin nas bzung sngags kyi rang sgra sgrog pa dang*/ gtor mar me dang du ba 'bar ba sogs byed kyi 'dug /de nub srod dang gung thun la sde brgyad spyi dang bye brag yul de'i lha 'dre mang po 'dud cing khas blangs pa dang*/ sha khrag dang nor rdzas mang po phul ba'i rmi lam nyams dang tho rangs dngos grub gsol ba'i cho ga bgyis nas nam langs kar gnyid du thum tsam song ba'i tshe/ rmi lam du glegs bam mang po sgreng tshar du bab byung ba la la khar mid la la pang du blangs la la lag pas bzung nas khyer ba zhig rmis/

nyer gsum gyi snga dro gtor 'bul byas/ de nyin mtshams rjes bsrungs pas de nub rang gzhan dge mi dge'i mtshan ltas mang po rang zhig byung yang*/ 'o cag gson por mngon sum du smras pa yid dan 'jog pa dka' 'dug par/ 'khrul snang smras pas khrel ba'i rgyu las cir 'gyur snyam nas kha rog par bsdad kyang*/ phyis rmi lam de rnams thog tu ma bab pa gcig kyang byung ma song*/ de'i tshe gzhan yang rtags mtshan mang du byung yang ma bris la/ bsnyen sgrub rang gi mtshan ma yin nges mang bar mthong yang gzhan la gsang dgos par rgyud rnams su gsungs 'dug pas ci yang ma bris so// bye ri stag rtse'i rdzong nang der// mi las lha 'dre mang ba yi// sdod grogs ngo mtshar che ba byung*// mi rnams zhal skyil dkar nag mang*// lha 'dre tshad la gnas shing btsan// de 'dra de 'dru mang du yod| |ha ha/ yang stag rtser yod thog cig /dbon po rdzong na bzhugs pas bya yul bla ma thar pa ri pa sogs kyis/ bdag skag che bar 'dug zer bas rim 'gro la 'bung pa dga' gsung ba'i 'phrin btang byung bar de nub rmi lam du/ bdag dang sde pa a rgyal sogs grogs 'ga' zung dang bcas mgon khang zhig tu phyin pas bdag gis gsang ba gsol 'debs 'don zhing lha rnams mjal ba'i tshe/ mgon po dang a phyi gnyis ni khong rang gi gsang ba gsol 'debs bdag dang lhan cig tu gsungs/ lha gzhan rnams kyang rang rang gi bstod pa rnams rem nas gsungs shing gar nyams mang po mdzad pa zhig rmis pas/ bla ma thar pa ri pa'i gsung de yang ri bong gi rwa ltar mthong*/ yang nub cig rmi lam du bdag stag rtse'i khams gsum du nyi ma shin tu dro ba zhig 'dug par nag yug la rgyab gtad nyi ma sro zhing 'dug pa'i tshe/ khams gsum gyi byang ngos kyi rtsig ldebs la rgyu dang kha dog sngar ma mthong ba'i gos dar las byas pa'i snam sbyar mang po bzed 'dug pa'i mdun du/

gding ba gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i steng na bdag cag gi ston pa thang gos dmar po/ bla gos ngur kha'i steng gser btso ma'i snam sbyar mnabs shing phyag g.yas sa gnon g.yon mnyam bzhag /zhabs sgreng stabs su bzhengs nas/ sku la mtshan dpe rnam par bkra zhing 'od zer mig gis mi bzod pa 'bar ba zhig mjal bas/ sems shin tu dga' zhing mos gus kyis sems brtse ma sogs thub bstod mang po bton cing phyag btsal bas/ ston pa de nyid dal bus bdag gi mdun du phebs byung ba'i tshe dri bzang po sngar ye ma thob pa zhig chil chil 'dug pas bdag gi bsam par/ do nub rmi lam du bdag cag gi ston pa dang mjal ba 'di 'khrul snang yin mod/ 'on kyang chos nyid rtogs pa'i ngor dngos nyams rmi lam thams cad khyad par med pas do nub skal ba bzang re dga' snyam zhing bcos min gyi mos gus khong nas 'khrugs pa'i mchi ma 'dzag cing lus sems zhig 'gro ba lta bu byung bas/ lag g.yon pas phyag g.yas sa gnon gyi rtse mo la 'jus/ g.yas pas phyag g.yon snam sbyar zlum khyer mdzad pa'i grwa nas bzung*/ zhabs gnyis la mgo bo gtugs nas sems bskyed rang gis len pa'i cho ga dang smon lam mang du btab/ slar zhal dkyil la bltas pas shin tu dgyes pa'i 'dzum mdangs tshad med pa'i ngang nas mdzod spu nas gser btso ma lta bu'i kha dog dang ldan pa'i 'od bkye nas bdag gi lus thams cad g.yogs pa ltar gyur pa yun ring du mjal ba'i mod gnyid sad pas sems la sngar ma myong ba'i bde ba dang skyid pa'i nyams dang mos gus bzod glags med pa byung*/ e ma/ gsang ba'i rgyud sde du ma ru// ston pa zhal ni mthong rmis na// rang gzhan don 'grub mtshan ma zhes// gsungs pas 'jag kyang blo bde dpal// a ha ha ha/ yang stag rtser nub cig rmi lam du paṇḍi ta nags kyi rin chen yin zer ba ras ngur smrig mnabs shing zhi dul che che ltar mdzad/

res dur khrod kyi chas mnabs nas rtsing hral che che ltar mdzad/ res rgya mtsho'i gting du nub cing gar mdzad pa rnam 'gyur sna tshogs pa ston pa zhig mjal bas shin tu dad nas phyag btsal/ mgo bo btud nas phyag rgya chen po'i gdams ngag cig stsol ces zhus pas/ phyag sor nam mkha' la gtad nas/ kye ma/ med bzhin snang la snang bzhin stong*// gcig dang du ma'i mtha' las 'das// sprin dang na bun sbrul mdud bzhin// rtog pa rnams kyang rang bzhin grol// gang du'ang ma 'dzin ma yeng bar// ma mthong mi mthong don la ltos// zhes sogs gsungs shing 'ja' yal ba ltar song bas/ rang gi nyams len la yid ches shing*/ rnam rtog la gnyen po rgyag pa dang ngos 'dzin pa dang dran pa brtan pa sogs kyi sgom chen dang gsung rigs la ni e e phud phud bsam pa yang byung*/ yang rdzong gsar du yod thog nub cig rmi lam du bdag cag lcang lo can du bsdad 'dug par/ sde pa a rgyal gyis jo bo rje dang mjal phrad mdzad na rab gsal du phebs zer bas bdag kyang langs te mgon khang mdo'i gnam sgo nas ka gnyis brgyud rab gsal du phyin pas ka ba lho ma'i mar gyu la gding ba dmar ser zhig bting*/ de'i g.yas ngos su stan dmar zhig bting*/ mdun du gding ba mang po gral bsgrigs nas bting 'dug /bdag slebs nas cung zad song ba'i mod phyi sgo nas yar rab byung mang po snam sbyar gyon nas bdag la phyag 'tshal ba'i mod/ dge slong dar la bab pa bzhin bzang ba mthang gos dmar ser dang bla gos ser po snam sbyar rdo tshos bzhes/ stod rjen byas pa paṇa zhwa rtse smyung gsol ba zhig byon byung bas bdag mthong 'phral paṇa zhwa phud nas gus gus kyi rnam 'gyur mdzad 'dug pas/ bdag gis 'di jo bo rje yin nges snyam phyag 'tshal bas/ des kyang tshur phyag 'tshal/ mthar phyag gis so sor 'jus nas dbu thug mdzad byung bar dge slong de'i sku dang na bza' la tshul khrims kyi dri chil chil 'dug

/slar jo bo rje mar gyu'i gding ba dang*/ bdag gi de'i g.yas stan dmar gyi steng du bsdad/ dge slong gzhan rnams so so'i gding ba la bzhugs/ jo bo rjes bskul nas rgyun chags gsum pa legs sbyar gyi skad du lhan cig gsungs/ de rjes jo bo rje dang gsung rab kyi gleng mo shin tu mang ba mdzad pa zhig rmis/ yang de'i rjes rmi lam du bdag padma 'od du bsdad 'dug par/ dge slong bgres po sku bongs che ba chos gos gsum rdo tshos kham mthug ge ba bzhes pa zhig byung*/ khyed su yin gang nas byon dris pas/ kho bo gnas brtan dus ldan bya ba de yin/ gnas brtan chen po rnams rgya gar shar lho'i ri bo su gandha parba ta dharma saṅgraha bya ba'i ri la dbyar gnas par bzhugs/ khyod kyang de rnams blta bar 'bod du 'ongs lam rgyus kho bos bya gsungs pas/ bdag gis de ltar bya 'on kyang sa thag ring bas rkang pas mi sleb 'phur nas 'gro byas/ de ltar rung gsungs dge slong de 'phur song ba'i zlar bdag kyang 'phur nas phyin pa'i rjes su sde pa a rgyal dang sku rdzi btson 'grus gnyis kyang 'phur nas byung bas/ khang pa thog mtho dman gnyis mkhar dang zhol gyi rnam par 'dug pa'i bdag dang dge slong gnyis mkhar steng du bab/ khong gnyis mkhar zhol steng du bab/ de ma thag shar ngos su 'ja' 'od 'khrugs shing sprin dang na bun gyi khrod nas char zim bu dal gyis 'bab/ nyi ma'i 'od kyang gsal/ rol mo dang gaṇḍi'i sgra bsgrags byung bar/ dge slong des shar ngos thag mi ring bar ri zhig 'dug pa la mdzub mo gtad nas bdag cag gsum la/ ri 'di'i ngos su gnas brtan chen po bcu drug dbyar tshul la bzhugs pa la ltos shig zer ba ltar bltas pas/ ri bo chen po lhun sdug cing brjid chags pa/ sngon chad mthong ma myong ba'i ljon pa mang po'i steng nas bya skad snyan pa du ma sgrog cing gar byed pa/ nags khrod du ri dwags sna tshogs pa rgyu ba/

'bab chu kha dog du ma bkra ba dal gyis 'bab pa/ sman dang 'bras bu'i bye brag sna tshogs pas yongs su gang ba'i khrod du/ brag ri dkar po nor bu 'bar ba'i dbyibs lta bu bcu drug yod par so sor phug pa dang bcas pa 'ja' dang na bun gyi gur phub pa bltas pas tshim pa med pa 'dug pa'i brag phug rnams su gnas brtan chen po la la ni mnyam par 'jog /la la ni phug pa'i sgor 'chag /'ga' zhig ni bgres po/ 'ga' zhig ni dar la bab pa/ 'ga' zhig ni gzhon nu'i tshul thams cad kyang chos gos gsum rdo tshos kham mthug ge ba mnabs shing sku stod gcer bu byas pa 'ba' zhig 'dug /brag phug stong pa zhig 'dug par dge slong des brag phug stong pa ya gi ni kho bo'i gnas so zhes gsungs/ bdag gi zla bo gnyis la yang khyed kyis legs par ston cig ces smras pas de na re/ khong gnyis 'dir bgrod pa yang khyod dang sngon nas las 'brel mang zhing thugs bsun ma phyung bas yin/ bdag gis legs par ston zhes khong gnyis kyi rtsar byon nas legs par bstan song*/ slar bdag gis dge slong de la ri 'di ha cang mtho ba mi 'dug pas gnas brtan rnams kyi sar 'gro'o smras pas/ dge slong des/ do nub rang mjal ba 'dis chog /gnas brtan rnams dang gsung gleng spro na bdag dang gsung gleng byung ba 'dis gzhan thams cad dang byung ba rang yin/ 'on kyang so sor gsung gleng sogs zhib cha spro na slar phyis su nges par yong ba yin no gsungs mi snang bar gyur pa'i mod la/ bdag gsum yang rang gnas su 'phur te log yong pa'i snang ba'i mod la gnyid sad pa zhig byung*/ ston pa'i rgyal tshab bcu drug po'i// zhal thang dang ni 'bur sku la// ske kyog byas nas mjal ma dgos// rmi lam dag pa'i snang ba ru// mjal bas ngo mtshar bdag skyid do// yang nub cig rmi lam du/ mi dkar po zhig gis bdag la gos dar gyis dril ba zhig gtad byung ba/

ci yin dris pas/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi zhal 'gram yin/ khyod la thod zer ba yin zer/ sus bskur dris pas/ sus bskur 'chad mi dgos zer/ de la bltas pasami dkyus ma'i 'gram pa las che ba la kha dog nya lcibs lta bu tshems lnga drug yod pa 'od 'bar ba zhig 'dug par bdag gis byin rlabs zhus shing*/ tshems 'di rnams zla bo dam tshig gtsang ba 'ga' la byin/ zhal 'gram 'di bdag rang gi dad rten byed dgos bsam pas/ des de ltar rung zer nas gar song cha med du song ngo*// de nas slar dpa' bo zhes pa lcags pho 'brug lo rgyal ba dus kyi 'khor lo'i skur bzhengs te/ shākya zla ba bzang po la dpal ldan 'bras spungs su dam pa dang po'i smin grol stsal ba'i dus khyad par can nag pa zla ba'i tshes gcig dkar po nam gru'i 'grub sbyor bzang po la e nas dpon yig tog dkar la mkhas pa dpon bsam grub yab sras gsum gyis gser dngul 'dul ba'i 'go brtsams/ zla ba de'i nyer gcig la e nas dpon yig mkhas pa nyi shu 'byor/ nyer gnyis gza' pa sangs dang skar ma chu stod lang tsho sbyor ba la shog las kyi 'go btsugs/ lo de'i sa ga zla ba bshol du ston pa'i phyi ma'i dmar po'i bzang po gnyis pa gza' nyi ma dang skar ma khrums stod 'phel myur gyi sbyor ba la/ e gnyan po nas tog dkar la mkhas pa dpon tshe ring nor bus gtsos pa'i yi ge'i rig pa la byang pa'i bris mkhan brgya dang bcu 'byor bas bris shing*/ de yang phyi mo rgyal dbang ratna'i thugs dam bka' 'gyur dkar po la slar zhus dag legs par byas shing*/ de dang lhan cig bla ma ba log pa/ bla ma lho pa sku skye/ mthil sgrub sde'i mtshams grwa dang bcas par/ lnga ldan rgyas pa byang sems kyi skabs mgon po 'bri gung pa'i thugs bskyed chen mo dang bskyed rim gyi sngon du sdom pa rga lo lha lnga'i dbang sogs cha tshang ba byas/ lhag par ma mya da drag med na bstan pa sum gnyis nub zer bas glegs bam gyi dbu rnams su da drag dang sngags dang skad dod thams cad la sgra rig ka lā pa ltar rang nyid kyis zhus dag legs par byas pas phyi mo bgyis te/

'dul ba glegs bam bcu gsum/ rgyas pa 'bum glegs bam bcu gnyis/ 'bring po nyi khri glegs bam bzhi/ bsdus pa brgyad stong pa glegs bam gcig /shes rab khri pa dang khri brgyad stong pa bsdoms par glegs bam bzhi/ sher phyin sna tshogs glegs bam gcig /sangs rgyas rma ga chad ces sam/ snyan gyi gong rgyan zhes sangs rgyas phal po che glegs bam bzhi/ dkon brtsegs glegs bam drug /mdo mang glegs bam gnyis/ gsang sngags phyi 'gyur glegs bam bco brgyad/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur glegs bam nyi shu tham pa/ gzungs 'dus glegs bam gnyis/ sngags 'bum glegs bam gcig rnams bsdoms pas glegs bam brgya dang nyi shu tham pa gser dngul spel zhing*/ glegs shing rnams tsandan dmar pos byugs shing dngul gyi ri mo bkra ba glegs thag dang bcas pa lo de nyid kyi smin drug zla ba dkar po'i phyogs kyi dga' ba dang po gza' lhag pa dang skar ma lhag mtshams 'grub sbyor dge bar yongs su rdzogs par grub cing*/ dpon yig rnams la gser dngul gos dar ja ras rta nor la sogs pas gya nom pa'i yon gyis mnyes par byas te rang yul du byon/ bdag rang gis zla gsang tant+ra'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa ltar rab tu gnas pa sta gon dang dngos gzhi zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg dang bcas pa legs par grub pa bgyis/ de nas lcags mo sbrul lo'i sos gtor grub pa'i zla ba gsum par brag khar dpon sa gshegs pa'i yar 'dren la 'bod mi byung bas phyin/ brag kha rdzong du bsdad/ bde chen tshal du dge 'dun 'dus pa stong phrag gnyis lhag nges kyi gral gtsor phyin/ mnga' ris grwa tshang pa'i zhal snga nas kyis mas gtam byas/ bdag gis bsngo ba yon bshad sogs rgyas pa byas/ sku rim du mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i gtor zlog byas nas rgyal bzang du bteg /slar brag kha'i bde yangs su yang ser tshogs chung ba zhig byas pa'i gral gtsor phyin bsngo smon gyis rgyas btab/

zang zing gi 'bul nor rgya cher byung*/ slar rgyal bzang du zung 'jug rgyud rim la rab gnas dang*/ gzhan phyogs kyi byad kha bzlog thabs dgos gsungs par gshin rje tshe bdag gi sgo nas byad kha bshig pa'i las sbyor byas/ gdan sa thel mjal du phyin/ de skabs 'on rin chen brag gi gdan sa bla ma rin po che ba log pa yin pas khong gi sku rim ser tshogs kyi gral gtsor rin chen brag tu phyin/ 'om sdings kyi gdan sa bla ma lam pa ba yin pas der yang bos nas bsnyen bkur bzang po zhus/ skya ser mang ba la dbang chos kyi 'brel ba bzhag /de nas rim pas bteḍa te brag kha'i sde pa sku mched sogs kyis 'on phu sdings sna bar skyel ma mdzad/ rang yul du log pa'i lam bar du sde gzar chen po de'i dbu btsugs pa'i skad cha thos/ shad rtsol gyis rdzong gsar du 'byor/ sde gzar gyi g.yeng ba che ba'i ngang nas skyid shod khog gi rdzong rnams phal cher phab/ slar zla ba bdun gyi khongs su bye ri stag rtse dang*/ gtsang bsam 'grub rtse sogs kyang phab/ gtsang sde srid lha sar spyan drangs/ de skabs 'brum pa na yang sngar yi dam gyi lung bstan dang nad bdag gis khas blangs par myur du bde bar byung*/ 'bri gung du bde 'byor byang pa sogs bod sog gi sku tshab tshan che ba 'byor/ rdzong rnam rgyal chos sdings gtsang bshigs dang*/ rdzong gsar gyi btsan dmigs rnams bshigs/ zhabs drung bde gshegs kyang spro lung du phebs/ de nas khad nye bar bdag kyang rang nyid skyes pa'i khyim rtse ba gzhis kar bsgril nas bsdad/ rgyal chen rtses gtsos pa'i 'phan yul du sa rigs gang yod sde pa skyid shod pas bzhes pa bka' drin bskyangs/ de'i sa tshab tu gong sa chen mo nas yar stod gri dpon pa'i shul rnams re zhig nged rang la gnang*/ skabs shig gshin rje tshe bdag gi bsnyen sgrub dang*/ las sbyor gyi sgrub pa bgyis pas rtags 'gyang gzhi yod pa mthong*/

rta lo dang lug lor dbus gtsang thams cad du sad kyi gnod pa tshad las 'das pa byung bas mi phal cher mu ges shi/ ma shi ba dbul po rnams kyang mi'i klad pa ldag pa dang*/ bud med rgan mo la las khyi bsad pa'i sha za ba sogs sngar yong ma myong ba lta bu'i bskal pa ngan pa byung ba blos ma bzod par spre'u lo dang bya lo gnyis la sad bsrungs pas bcas 'og gi rde'u rnams las khrag bab pa kun gyis mthong ba byung zhing*/ sad kyi gnod pa ci yang ma byung bas phyogs mtha'i skye bo thams cad kyis rtsam pa zhim po ster mkhan gyi bla ma de 'di yin zhes rjes su yi rang byed pa byung*/ skabs der nang khul gyi ser skya kha shas snying la dam sri brlams pas sngar ma grags pa'i zang zing sna tshogs byas kyang bla ma yi dam chos skyong la gsol ba btab pas 'phral 'jags che la phugs zos bde zhing snying tshim pa byung*/ lug lo de'i nang du bla ma ba del gyis gtsos sgar khams nas 'khor/ spre'u lor tshogs che ba la lnga ldan gyi khrid rgyas pa zhig byas dus 'tshang kha dam po rgyab pas drung 'tsho ba karma bzod pa'i rtsibs ma bcag pa sogs byin rlabs che ba byung*/ de nas a stag bla ma kun dga'i dris lan dang rang gi rmi lam nyams sogs gang la dpags kyang gdung brgyud 'byung ba'i skabs mi 'dug pas bar chad kyi chos rnams dang mi ldan yang*/ pham pa dang po dngos kyis ye ma gos pa byas kyang lhag ma gnyis pa dang spang ltung bcu tshan gsum pa'i ltung ba brgyad pas yang yang sbags pa dang*/ gzhan yang dgos pa 'ga' zhig mthong bas shing bya lo hor zla drug pa'i yar tshes bco lnga rgyal ba lhums su zhugs pa'i dus ston dang*/ de nub zla ba la sgra gcan 'jug pa sogs dus khyad par can la mkhan po don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te dā na sampanna dang*/ las kyi slob dpon ra khyim dge slong ngag dbang phun tshogs sogs dad pa'i dge 'dun mtha' 'khob tu dmigs bsal gsungs pa grangs tshang gi drung du tshigs gsum rim par nod pa chig rdzogs su rtse ba gzhis ka'i mchod khang rtser mkhan brgyud gsar ma las legs par bsgrubs/

a bo nag gus gong sar zhu log phul 'dug pas gong sa mchod yon nas lha sar shog gsungs pa ltar phyin/ bka' bkyon bsgyur sbyang mang rabs gnang ba'i mthar zhag gsum gyi bar du dpal dro shag tu dam dog kyang gnang*/ bdag srung mi sog po rnams kyis rgya mthongs nas bltas pas bdag nang du mi 'dug pa dang*/ gdan thog tu me 'bar ba sogs mthong snang mang po byung zer phyis su gleng ba thos/ de tshe sa g.yos pa sogs rang gzhan thams cad kyis shes pa byung song de mtshungs 'bras spungs nas/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas phyag na padma can ngur smrig gi rdzu bag la brten pa rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa chen po'i zhabs drung nas mchod dpon pa dge slong dge dar ba rdzongs brda gnang byung ba mun mtshams su lha sar 'byor/ bdag la'ang dbugs dbyung ba'i bka'i glegs bam dang*/ gong sa mchod yon du'ang bka' mchid yod 'dug pa ltar phyi nyin nas dam dog grol slar jo bo'i drung du rtsi ga phul/ phyi nyin gser chab sgron zhing gnas mjal byas nas yar 'ongs/ gzhung nas sku tshab grwa zlum po ba dang*/ sog po'i sku tshab dang*/ sde pa skyid shod pa'i sku tshab dgon shar chos mdzad dang bcas yar lam zhwa lha khang du zhabs drung bde gshegs dang bdag dpon slob kyis rtsi ga phul/ slar 'bri gung mthil du zhabs drung bde gshegs dang mkhan slob chos gsum sogs kyis sgo mang mchod khang dang mgon khang dus dran khang rnams su rtsi ga phul/ slar rtse bar 'byor/ khyi lor 'dus pa tshogs che ba la chos sgo gdan sa pa bla ma ngag dbang gis bskul nas ma ṇi bka' 'bum dang bdag rang gi brtsams chos po ti lnga tsam yod pa dang 'dul ba mdo rtsa'i lung sogs byas/ hor zla drug pa'i nang du rje nā ro pa'i dngul gdung rdzong gsar du bzhugs pa de rdzong gsar phyis mi brtan par mthong bas arga'i cho ga byas/ mthil khang gsar mchod khang du spyan drangs bzhugs su gsol zhing rab tu gnas pa bgyis/

rtse bar 'byor slar skabs shig la phyi rdor 'dzin bla ma chos bsnyen par rdzogs shing 'dus pa che ba la mgon po 'bri gung pa'i phyag bzhes thugs bskyed chen mo bgyis/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba slob dpon chos bshes kyi rgya cher 'grel pa dang bstun pa'i mchan bu zhib pa zhig btab/ khyi lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu snga mar dbon po ra stag pa 'das par chog mang dgung zhag sogs rang re'i zhal ngo gcig dang mnyam pa dang*/ zhabs drung spro lung gi bde gshegs spyan drangs 'bul nod rgya che ba byas/ phag lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu bzhi la dbon po'i phung po zla gsang 'dus pa'i tant+ra nas gsungs pa ltar bdag rang gis sreg sbyang byas/ rus bu rnams dngul las grub pa'i slob dpon chen po padma'i sku za hor lugs rkyang khru gang pa bzhengs pa'i nang du bcug pa da lta gdan sa chen po 'bri gung gi gtsug lag khang thog kha gser khang sbug mar bzhugs/ sum brgya par rang 'grel 'od ldan dang bstun pa'i mchan bu zhib pa dang*/ karma sha tam la sdoms tshig dang sbrel ba'i mchan bu rags pa zhig btab/ 'dus pa tshogs che bar bdag rang gis bsgrigs pa'i chos drug gi khrid yig rtsa bar byas pa la bshad sbyar dang go don lag len rgyas par bstan/ byi ba lo'i dbyar 'tsho byed dwags po bsod nams legs pas bskul te/ rtse ba'i g.yul khar gur chen khams gsum zil gnon phub par/ sngon 'gro tshogs bsags kyi rim pa nas bzung mjug mar me'i smon lam yan chad bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyi zab gter gyi dbang phuul/ dbang gi mdo byang*/ dbang chog /sgrub khog /dus kyi bsnyen pa/ lha dbang rnams so sor yod pa ga sprad nas/ rgyal dbang ratna'i phyag len dpyis phyin pa mi bar khyis ma chod cing chu dang 'o ma'i ngan lhad dang*/ gzhan pa'i rgyas 'gebs dang*/ 'thad legs kyi rang bzo sogs spu tsam yang med pa/

yang la la dag gis bka' brgyad kyi dbang chog phyis kyi bla ma 'ga' zhig gis nag bsgrigs su byas pa'i dpe cha klog thub pa tsam snying por byas pa'i dbang bskur dang*/ yang 'ga' zhig gis bka' brgyad kyi sgrub dbang sbrags ma byas so zhes zhag bdun tsam gyi khongs su yang grub pa'i gtam la yid dan byed pa dang*/ yang la la dag gis dkyil 'khor rdul tshon yin na bcer zin ma thag dang*/ ras bris yin na bris zin ma thag zhag gcig tsam yang ma bsgrub par dbang bskur ro thob bo zhes pa sogs ma dag pa'i phyogs ni sa steng gi rtswa las kyang grangs mang la/ rnam par dag pa ni gnam gang srod kyi nyi zla ltar dkon pa 'di 'dra'i dus gong ma'i phyag len dang gter gzhung dpang por bzhag ste/ tshig don lag len gang la yang nongs pa'i tshogs med par thog mar rnal 'byor rgyun dbang dang*| dkyil 'khor bca' ba/ sgrub cing dngos grub kyi cho ga slob ma sta gon nas bzung dbang rdzogs mtshams su/ khro bo dgos sgrub dang sman sgrub kyi yig cha gter byon nyid sor bzhag sman bsags pa nas bzung*/ sbyar ba/ khrol sgrub/ 'thag pa/ gong bur sgrub pa/ sman dbang dang bcas pa/ mjug chog mar me'i smon lam dang*/ mthar rkyen zlog khro rol rgyas pa khyung dgu ma dang bcas pa/ de dag gi tshe rdo rje slob dpon chas bzhugs/ gar 'cham sogs kyang lag len rnam dag byas pa de dag gi nyin re bzhin der tshogs kyi 'dus pa che dgu grangs las 'das pa lta bu thams cad kyi mig gi spyod yul mngon sum par me tog gi char dang*/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur dang*/ sman khang du 'dzab kyi rang sgra dang*/ rol mo'i skad la sogs pa ngo mtshar gyi ltas rmi lam dang nyams snang la re ma dgos pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi ro ma rnams phag rom mtshor gshegs pa'i nyin char drag po 'bab pa sogs klu rnams dga' ba'i ltas dang bcas pa der 'dus kun gsang sngags snga 'gyur la yid ches slar yang thob pa byung*/

sa mo glang lor mthil sgo mang la gser thog phub cing tshogs chen la lnga ldan gyi khrid bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi lung rdzogs par byas/ gser thog 'di phyis spro lung du nang so phyag mdzod pa 'das pa'i rkyen gyis chos khrims dang drung 'khor 'ga' zhig brtsad pas slob dpon thugs dkrugs pa dang rdo rje'i spun la brnyas pa'i ltung ba rdzogs pa'i tshe/ la las mthil du mang ja skol 'dug pas dam sel gyis de nub gser thog rdib 'dug /lcags pho stag lor rig 'dzin padma gling pa'i sku'i skye ba gsum pa dpon slob tshul khrims rdo rje rtse bar phebs/ 'dus pa mdo dbang chen mo kaḥthog pa rdo rje bzang po'i lugs yongs rdzogs dang rnying ma'i rgyud 'bum glegs bam nyi shu po rdzogs pa'i lung dang*/ pad gling pa'i drag dmar che 'bring chung gsum/ nag po skor gsum/ padma las 'brel rtsal gyi gter ma gtad brgyud gsal sgron gyi dbang lung sogs thob yig tu thebs pa ltar mang du zhus/ de skabs nged rang bad kan na ba'i sgang yin pas phar la dgongs gcig rdor she ma/ padma gling pa'i bka' thang*/ padma las 'brel rtsal gyi gshin rje king kang kha la rgyas 'debs sogs kyi lung phul/ thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ dpon slob klung shod brgyud nas phebs/ de skabs shig bdag la karma pa chos dbyings rdo rje'i bka' shog byung 'dug zer ba zhig gong sa'i snyan du byung 'dug pas rtsad gcod mang du gnang byung yang*/ bka' shog bdag la ni ma byung*/ gzhan du byung ba zhig shes kyang snyan du ma phul/ rang sar nyes skyon med pa'i mna' gan sogs mi sna dang zhu yig gi lam du phul yang cung zad thugs khrel ba'i rnam pas nyang po shab/ 'grung*/ 'bras/ yar stod gri rnams bzhes/ spro lung gi bar thang yang bzhes song*/ phyis sa tshab ma zhus kyang dgongs bcad kyis 'chad bu gnang zhing de steng snon ma yong ba'i bka' bzhes byung yang*/

da cha nged rang la ma shi bar du zas gos ma phongs pa ni gang ltar byas kyang yong*/ de phyin sa rigs kyi dgos pa med bsam nas zhabs bskul ma zhus/ skabs shig 'on rin chen brag gi bla ma dkon mchog lhun grub kyis bskul nas rin po che padma gling pa'i lho brag sman mdo'i brag gi zab gter bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho'i rtsa ba'i dbang dang bla med bcu gsum gyi dbang bskur rdzogs par bsgrubs/ yang grub chen dza har pir nas brgyud pa'i rlung khrid kyang cha tshang byas/ de nas yos lo'i nang du nub pa'i sde pa a rgyal zer ba nga rang gi zla bor yod pa lnga par song ba'i sems las che ba byung bas 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi dkyil 'khor du phung po bdag rang gis sbyangs/ lar sde pa a rgyal 'di dbon po mgon rgyal pa'i skye ba yin nges yin zhing*/ snga gong rje ratna la mi gus kyang*/ phyis gus shing mkhar thog tu 'das dus rje ratna'i sku pang du mgo bzhag nas/ 'chi khar bdag ngan song du mi 'gro zhing nyid dang nam yang mi 'bral ba'i zhal bzhes dgos zhus pas de ltar zhal gyis bzhes pa yin 'dug /rgyal mchog thams cad mkhyen pa chen po dang*/ dbyings sa bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po rnams rgyal me tog thang du chibs kha bsgyur ba'i phebs lam mal gror gnang byung bas bdag kyang ka tshal du phyin/ mal gro gung dkar du dpon kho shol gyis gung tshigs la chibs gzhol zhus pa'i sar mjal du phyin pas/ en tsam gnas tshang du bsgugs thog /snga 'gros rgyal ba'i sku gzhogs su phyag 'bul la phyin pas/ rgyal ba'i bzhugs khri mi'i sked pa tsam dang mnyam pa| bdag la sku gzhogs g.yas kyi mar zur du gdan mda' gang lhag tsam byas/ bdag gis phyag 'bul zhu dus rgyal bas bzhugs khri'i steng rang du bzhengs/ slar bzhugs gral 'grigs 'phral rgyal ba nyid rang nas bla ma dgongs 'dus/ pad gling pa'i drag po/ yang zab skor sogs la nan tan gyis dri rtsad dang bka' brgyad la yang bka' gros yod tsam dang*/

gshin rje lcags sdig skor la yang bka' gros gnang byung bar thams cad yig cha so so nas nges dag rtsa ba khog pa zhus shing*/ de skabs gsol ja bar thag ring ba gsum gyi ring 'jig rten gyi gsung bgros gang yang ma byung*/ de nas grol nas mchod yon gyi sku gzhogs su phyin pas/ bdag la gdan rkyang khru gang tsam dang*/ mchod yon rang la sa gdan steng kha gang ma re re gnang*/ bdag yong gdong bzhugs gdan gyi mdun du bzhengs/ bdag gdan khar 'dug zin nas mchod yon gnyis ka'i phyag 'bul phyag mjal bkras btags re gnang*/ bdag gis dbu thug phyag skyor ma re phul/ gsol ja gnyis tsam gyi ring 'jig rten gyi bka' gros smar ba dbyings sa rang dang byung*/ rgyal po ni bod skad mkhyen rigs min pa 'dra/ de nas yar rtse bar 'byor/ slar gong sa'i sku gzhogs nas/ rgyal ba'i bka' bkod la 'bri gung zhabs drung la rten 'brel gyi tshan grangs legs pa zhig phul zhes bka' phebs byung ba yin gsungs gos dar dang ma na hu'i spyad pa sogs la rgyal ba'i sku zhabs kyi phyag rtags 'byar ma tshan grangs legs pa zhig yar skyel mi gnang byung*/ de skabs zhabs drung spro lung bde bar gshegs pa des thugs dam dngul gdung byang chub chen po'i mchod rten bzhengs pa gnang grub pa'i rab gnas la shog gsungs pa ltar mthil du phyin/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i rab gnas nyin gcig ma zhig byas/ gnang sbyin gya nom pa stsal/ de nas rtse ba 'byor/ rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa chen po rgya nag tu phebs pa'i bshul lam 'dam brgyud pa'i thang 'brog tu phebs phyag 'bul la phyin/ bzhugs gdan sogs sngar mal gror gnang ba dang khyad med la/ gsol ja gsum bzhi'i tshe bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub chen dang khro rol sogs kyi dkyil 'khor dang bca' bshoms/ bdag mdun bskyed tshul sogs la dogs gcod shin tu mang ba de yang mdzes lam tsam ma yin par yin min 'gal spong dang sbrags pa'i rtsa ba khog pa gnang byung bas/

so sor gsal dag mtha' ma thung ba zhib tu zhus pas phyis thugs dgyes shing yi rang bas nyams chung gyi na ba bdag lta bu gsang sngags snga 'gyur la shin tu goms par thugs mthong ches cher che ba gnang zhing*/ phyag tham gnang bar yang rig 'dzin yongs kyi gtsug rgyan dam pa zhes sogs bsngags pa brjod pa gnang ba zhig byung*/ des na bdag la de lta bu'i bsngags pa brjod pa'i gnas ci la srid/ rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs ngor 'khor 'das thams cad kyang dag pa rab 'byams kyi gnas las gzhan med pa chos nyid yin pas de lta bu yin par gdon mi za'o// de yang chu rta lo nas bad kan gyi nad gzhi mgo brtsams nas dpon slob gsum sprul la mdo dbang dang rnying ma'i rgyud 'bum zhu ba'i skabs rnams su shin tu na bas chos gral du lus thams cad rdul chus khyab pa ltar byed pa kho na byung yang chos thob dgos pa'i 'dod pas sdug sran bskyed dgos pa 'ba' zhig byung*| de nas sbrul lo hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gsum la mthil sgrub sde'i mtshams pas gtsos ser skya 'dus pa ches mang ba la lnga ldan gyi khrid go don bshad sbyar dang sbrags pa'i rgyas pa zhig mgo brtsams par/ bad kan je lod du na bas nyer drug nas khrid 'chad ma thub/ de nas je lod du song bas 'on nas drung 'tsho ba man khang nas bos pas sman rang la ngo so cher ma byung*/ me mnyam gyi gsang kha gsum dang rgyab kyi tshigs pa bcu gcig pa la spra tshugs bzhag pa'i nyin mo me tog gi char bab pa phal cher gyis phyi nas mthong 'dug |de nas spro lung gi zhabs drung bde gshegs spyan drangs sgrol dkar gyi tshe dbang brgya rtsa zhus pa'i nub gcig rmi lam du rdo'i sātstsha mang po rnyed pa rmis pas/ gzhung du mchod rten dang sātstsha mthong na 'chi ba bzlog pa'i ltas yin par gsungs 'dug /slar sgam po'i bla sman rab brtan bzang po dang rgyal pa 'tsho byed gzhan phan sogs spyan drangs/

de ka'i mu nas 'bab sbyong yun ring byung bas rkyen byas/ ldan pa'i chu nad kyi mgo brtsams skrang po shin tu che ba byung*/ sman gang yang phan po rang ma byung*/ gzhan du sman dpyad gang 'gab sman pas nad pa la 'dri ba'i srol mi 'dug kyang*/ gtsang pa'i 'tsho byed gzhan phan/ sgam po drung 'tsho ba dang*/ rgyal ba 'tsho byed sogs kyis sman gang 'gab bdag rang la dris byung bas chu sman bde ba'i 'khor lo zhig byed byas pas de ka phan che ba byung*/ 'on kyang rtsa thams cad la grangs nges med du sdod pa zhig byung bar 'tsho byed man khang nas kyis sdod pa 'di nyes skyon med gsungs/ ban grong sngags pas mkha' 'gro'i bsus zlog cig byas pa'i glud yas gad sgang du bskyal bar 'ja' zug pa kun gyis mthong*/ sgam po bla sman pas chos mdzad lcang gcig pa'i rtsar zhag lnga drug las mi 'gyang bar 'chi gsungs 'dug /rgyal ba 'tsho byed kyis kyang 'chi nges su thag bcad 'dug /nga rang gis bltas pas 'chi ltas ni gang yang mi 'dug /slar dwags po nas 'tsho byed lo yag spyan drangs/ khong pas lus kyi skrang po sogs la thugs rtog bcug pas da res nyes skyon med pa khag khyag gsungs pas/ phyis drung 'tsho ba man khang dang 'tsho byed lo yag gnyis kyis gsungs pa la nges shes 'drongs/ de nas khad kyis nad las grol/ rebs kyi chu tshan la phyin/ slar mthil nas mkhan slob chos gsum che bgres rnams kyis rta bsu dang bcas gdan sa chen por 'byor/ der grwa nang thams cad kyis 'bul nod byas/ slar spro lung du shog gsungs par phyin nas zhag gsum bsdad/ ma shi ba'i gtang rag tu gnang sbyin gya nom pa gnang*/ de nas khad kyis rtse bar 'byor/ shing pho rta lor dpon slob gsum sprul rtse bar slar yang phebs/ de skabs bad kan na ba rang yod kyang bla ma'i bka' mi gcog pa'i slad du rje mar rngog yab sras kyi thugs dam rngog dkyil bdun pa'i dbang rgyas par phul/

tshur la rkyen sel gyi tshe dbang tshar mang ba tsam ma gtogs zhu ma thub/ 'di lo yang zla ba gsum pa nas bad kan gyi 'bab sbyong la khag gtags pa'i lo snga ma'i ldan pa'i chu de ka bzlog pas snga ma bas skrang po chung tsam la rtsa'i sdod 'then sogs babs lod pa rang byung*| de'i tshe dpon slob gsum sprul gyi tshe dbang dang*/ gtum po'i dug sbyor khrus sbyong sogs dang*/ spro lung nas zhabs drung bde gshegs pas mgon dkar gyi tshe dbang*/ yang zab kyi 'chi bdag zil gnon sogs dang*/ spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra'i gdon 'grol sogs mang du mdzad/ cung zad bde 'go bstan nas shing bzo ba tshe ring*/ bsam 'grub tshe brtan/ 'on pa'i shing bzo ba gcig rnams kyis rgyal bas gnyan du yod par mu stegs pham par mdzad pa'i tshe brtsigs shing dus ston dang bcas pa cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i mchod rten zhes sam/ mu stegs pham byed kyi mchod rten yang zer ba da lta mthil du dngul gdung bzhugs pa thams cad las sku tshad che ba 'di'i shing bzo dbu btsugs/ shing rnams ha lam tsam zin par zhabs drung spro lung gi bde gshegs dang dpon slob gsum sprul gyis kyang phyag nas 'thor/ dpon slob gsum sprul lho kha phyogs su phyag bteg /de nas nad khams bde ba'i khul gyis lo de ka'i zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gsum la/ bal po nor bu shing gis gtsos pa'i bal po mkhas pa nyi shu rtsa gsum 'byor/ zla ba de ka'i tshes bzhi'i snga dro nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor bzang por gser dngul gyi bzo sbyang gi dbu btsugs/ do dam pa 'on rin chen brag gi bla ma mnga' ris pa dkon mchog lhun grub dang dge slong spangs phug pa sogs kyis byas/ bkod pa gang dgos bdag rang gis byas/ grub tu nye ba shing mo lug lo gnam du tshes pa'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i smad nas spro lung du zhabs drung bde bar gshegs pa de nyid sku khams cher snyun/

bdag kyang zla ba bcu gcig pa'i gnam gang la spro lung du phyin/ zhabs pad mi brtan par thag chod kyang 'gyod med kyi gsol sman dpyad sogs 'tsho byed rnams kyis phul yang ma phan par zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum gyi nyi ma ri rtser shar ba chu srin gyi khyim thog mar shar ba'i tshe dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pas sems las mthar thug pa byung yang gnas skabs su zo gang dkar byas/ de nub srod la sku gdung rin po che sman gyis sbags pa'i ras kyis dril zhing ni tsu la'i za ma tog tu chu'i snying po'i dbus su bzhugs su gsol/ mchod pa sogs bkod bshams byas shing zhag gsum tsam gsang ba'i khul byas kyang phal cher gyis shes 'dug /de nas rtse bar slebs pa dang gsang rdol ba sbrags/ zla ba dang po'i nang dngul gdung yang grub pas bal po sogs gzhu rong brgyud mthil du brdzangs/ bdag spro lung du phyin/ zla ba dang po'i tshes lnga la zhugs 'bul byas/ pur khang zhal bsdams| tshes brgyad la mthil du 'byor/ bdag cag gi ston pas mu stegs pham par mdzad pa'i dus ston dngos gzhi tshes brgyad yin pas de nyin dngul gdung gi rmang dge phyin gyi shing rnams bsgrigs/ de'i phyi nyin nas nang gzungs rnams 'bul ba dang shing sgrig pa sogs rim gyis byas/ grub nas bal po rnams kyis gser dngul g.yogs/ legs par zin nas yan lag lnga pa'i 'bras bu mchog tu bzang bar bdag rang gis 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phye/ yang ri sgar gyi bla ma rgyal sras/ bla ma chos sgo ba/ gtsang sgrub sde'i bla ma gad la 'or pa/ 'on rin chen brag gi bla ma sogs 'dus pa rgya mtshos 'khor lo sdom pa rga lo lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye ste rab tu gnas pa nyi ma gnyis la rgyas par bsgrubs| rab ston mthil tshogs chen la mang ja dang 'gyed/ rab gnas pa rnams la yon sogs phul/
