slar spro lung du 'byor/ pur khang zhal phyes nas rtse bar 'ongs/ sos gtor yang grub nas/ mi ring bar spro lung du chog mang 'dzugs ran pas phyin/ stag lung nas zhabs drung rin po che ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub chog mang gi gral gtsor phebs/ 'bul nor gzab gshom byas shing smon lam gnang*/ bdag dang dbang ldan pho brang du mjal phyag rtse sprad dbu thug sogs byas/ slar yang thengs gnyis gsum tsam mjal/ slar stag lung zhabs drung mthil gyi gnas gzigs la phebs/ bdag rtse bar 'byor/ de nas stag lung zhabs drung phebs lam klung shod brgyud rtse bar phebs/ zhing thang khug gang por bzhugs sgar btab/ phar la skyob pa rin po che'i bka' 'bum/ bstan snying sogs lung mang ba phul/ tshur la bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang dang khrid lung*/ gshin rje 'char ka ye shes pa'i dbang sogs zhus/ lar babs de gong 'bri stag thugs nang dag pa rang zhig med kyang*/ zhabs drung 'di nyid dang mjal ba nas bzung da lta'i bar thugs nang dag cing lugs legs pa rang re bka' brgyud pa mos gus kyi lam gtso bor 'dzin pa sngon gyi bzhed srol ji lta ba dngos su byung ba 'di yin/ spro lung du zhabs drung bde gshegs zhing brjes tsam la khams nas rang re'i chos sras kyi thu bo bla ma lho pa sku skye dkon mchog phrin las rnam rgyal yang 'byor byung*/ bdag gi zlar mthil du phebs/ sa khri dmar po'i steng du bdag phyin bla g.yel du tshogs chen tshogs pa'i dbus su 'bul nod shin tu rgya che ba dang brtan bzhugs sogs 'bul ba mdzad/ de nas rtse bar 'byor nas bal po rnams la yon rdzong grub/ de'i dbyar ngor bla ma lho pa sprul skus bskul nas/ rig 'dzin sangs rgyas gling pas o rgyan sgrub phug pu ri phug mo che nas spyan drangs pa'i bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi dbang sgrub la/ gter ston nas bzung da lta'i bar dgongs 'dus kyi chos bdag bya khyung pa dpal ldan seng ge nas bzung*/

rtsa ba'i bla ma bya khyung pa dza yend+ra padma shā sa na dha ra'i zhabs kyi bar brgyud pa'i phyag len lhad med pa/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur dang phyi 'gyur ba'i bla ma la la dag ni mkhas pa'i khur tsam rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ 'thad legs dang rang bzo'i kha 'gengs kyis tshong 'dus kyi 'o ma ltar gyur/ la la ni bla ma'i dbon brgyud sogs yin pa thod du bcings shing yi ge klog tsam gyis chog par sems/ bslab sbyangs kyi yon tan ni nyin skar ltar gyur/ nyams len ni chu shing gi snying po dang mtshungs/ tshig don la dri rtsad byas na ne tso la smras pa ltar don med kyi lab lob mang du byed/ slar nye bar bcar na ngo gnag khro tshul gyis mjug bsdu ba rnams kyi brtul zhugs rgyang du bsrings nas/ dam pa gong ma'i phyag bzhes dri ma med pa 'di dgongs 'dus la dbang rkyang par bskur ba/ sgrub chen rkyang par byed pa/ dbang rgyas pa sgrub chen dang sbrags pa/ dbang bsdus pa sgrub chen dang sbrags pa/ dbang rgyas bsdus gang la yang sgrub chen dang sbrags par yan lag dngos grub bdud rtsi'i sgrub pa drug po gang rung sbyor ba/ dbang mi bskur bar sgrub chen dang sgrub phran sbrel ba sogs phyag len rnam grangs mang ba rnams glo bar tshud cing legs par sbyangs pas yid ches thob pa/ mchod khang steng du ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten cing dbang rgyas pa sgrub chen dang sbrags pa/ dbang phran 'ga' zhig dang bcas pa skya ser kha shas la legs par bsgrubs/ gzhan yang bka' gsar rnying gi dogs gcod mang du mdzad 'dug par dpyis phyin pa zhus nas mi 'gyang bar khams su brdzangs/ spro lung du dngul gdung dang gzims mal gser sku gser gdugs rnams kyi bzo thab bal po dha lam sogs kyis btsugs/ bdag rtse bar mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyi mtshams zhig bgyis pa'i tshe thog mar rang nyid la rang gis mtshon bsnun pa sogs cho 'phrul dang*/

rtags bzang ngan ston pa mang du rmis/ mthar lha grub pa'i mtshan ma rdzogs par byung*/ de skabs shig 'brong ngur du bla ma tshe dbang 'dzin pa'i bsnyen sgrub mtshams lam tsam zhig kyang bgyis/ de nas lug lo'i ston de kar spro lung gi bzo rnams grub/ gdung rus gdan drangs shing mthil tshogs chen gyi ser sbreng gis bsus/ khang gsar byang du bzhugs/ bal po rnams dang bcas gser gdugs phub cing dngul gdung gzims mal sku 'dra dang bcas bsgrigs/ gdung rus rnams za 'og gi na bza' dri bzang po'i phur ma dang bcas bre'i nang nyid du bzhugs su gsol/ grub nas bdag cag 'dus pa dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa rga lo lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du rab tu gnas pa rgyas par bsgrubs/ slar rtse bar slebs/ spre'u lo'i cho 'phrul zla bar mtshams grwa brje len la lnga ldan dang yang zab khrid kyi sngon 'gro yid bzhin nor mchog gi khrid rnams sbrags nas byas/ de lo'i dbyar zla ba drug pa spre'u'i zla bar 'brong ngur du phyin/ tshes bcu'i nyin yang zab kyi zhi khro'i bskang bshags gsar pa byas shing*/ phyogs thams cad kyi skya ser pho mo ches mang bas gnas mjal du lhags pa la phyag nas sogs rnam dkar gyi 'brel ba bzhag /lo de'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa chen po mjal du 'bras spungs su phyin/ tshes bcu gsum gyi snga dro dga' ldan pho brang gi gzims chung bka' gdams yang rtser rgyal ba nyid la bzhugs gdan gdong g.yogs bzhi dang*/ bdag la lnga yod pa la cung zad dma' ba byas/ bdag gi phyag 'bul skabs rgyal ba nyid bzhugs gdan steng nas mthil du phebs/ phyag mjal slog gnang bzhugs gdan la bzhugs ma khad gshin rje yang zlog gi dogs gcod bka' phebs kyi 'go gnang byung*/ slar de nyin dbyings sa mjal bar dbyings sa chen po gzims chung sgo 'gag tu phebs/

bdag nang du sleb tshe gdan mda' gang tsam 'dug pa'i steng du bsdad 'phral dbyings sa nang du phebs mjal dar kha btags che ba gnang*/ bdag gis dbu thug phyag skyor ma phul/ bzhugs gdan kha gang ma gcig rang bting ba'i steng du bzhugs| gsung gros shin tu smar ba byung*/ de nyin gung tshigs la gsol ba dkar dro dmar dro 'dres pa shin tu bzang ba gnang grub nas rgyal ba'i drung du rgyal ba nyid kyi gsung 'bum rnams kyi ljags lung dbu tshugs/ tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin mchod khang chen mo dang sngags khang sogs gnas mjal byas/ gung tshigs la dga' ldan pho brang du ston mo gong ltar gzab gshom gnang*| grol nas rgyal ba'i sku zhabs su ljags lung 'phro ma rnams rdzogs par zhus/ ljags lung gi bar dang gsol ja mchod pa'i ring yang gshin rje yang zlog kho na'i dogs gcod gnang*| de nas grol nas dbyings sa bdag gi rtsar phebs/ lo rgyus gsung gleng zhib par gnang*/ de'i gong nas yang ri sgar la brtan thub kyi bzhugs yul zhig med pas nged rang shi na 'thor ba las 'os med pas ci drag bsam pa kho na yod pas/ de gong sgar che chung spro lung du zla bsgril pa dang*/ bla ma nang so rin chen dang*/ gnyer par dbon chung bsko bzhag dang*/ de mtshungs nang so rin chen la gong sa nas kyang bskos bya gnang dgos pa sogs gang ci'i gsung gleng gi zhar la phul bas/ de ma thag de ka 'gab po yin 'dug gsung zur gyis bka' bzhes byung*/ de dgong dbyings sa nas dngos spyad gya nom pa gnang*/ phyi nangs yang rgyal pa'i zhabs drung du shog phebs pas phyin ston mo gzab rgyas gnang*/ sku gzhogs su phyin/ bzhugs gral gyi ring gshin rje yang zlog gi dogs gcod kho na gnang*/ dngos po'i gnang sbyin dpag tu med pa gnang zhing*/ bdag gis phyi phyag phul ba'i tshe bzhugs gdan zhol du bzhengs bzhin pas/ 'o na sku'i 'tsho skyong dang thugs dam gong 'phel gnang ba dang*/

yi ge 'phral 'phral gnang ba zhu gsungs/ de nyin btegs nas po ta lar 'phags pa wa ti bzang po sogs kyi rten mjal zhus/ gung tshigs gzab pa gnang*/ lha sar slebs gnas mjal grub cing zhag gsum bsdad nas yar bteg /yar lam gar par zhag tshugs thog byang bdag zhabs drung bla ma'i sku skye dang spos dga' chos rje la gshin rje yang zlog gi dbang bsdus pa dang 'char ka'i zor dbang phul/ lam bar de rang du rgyal ba'i sku gzhogs nas dogs gcod snga ma'i 'phro shog dril mdom gang tsam zhig mchan bu thob phebs byung yang lam bar du bri ma thub pas rtse bar khyer/ sleb 'phral shog dril la mchan bu zhib pa dang*/ yang zlog gi dpe tshan kha shas dang*/ rdo rje gtsug lag 'phrin las drag po mngon du phyung ba/ rgyud dpe'u ris dang bcas pa g.yar 'bul du dge slong ljang rnyed brdzangs/ de rjes me bya lo'i sos gtor grub ste zla ba gsum pa'i nyer bdun la lcang gcig chos mdzad 'das pa'i phung po sreg sbyong gi bkod pa byas shing*/ lag len dge slong sbags sogs tha ba kha pa kha shas kyis byas| bya lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes brgyad nas bal po dha lam can bcu gcig gis gser gdugs che ba gshin rje yang zlog me'i spu gri'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i bkod pa yongs su rdzogs pa sgrub pa'i dbu btsugs/ do dam 'on rin chen brag gi bla ma lha mo dang dge slong spangs phrugs pas byas/ dwags po 'tsho byed zhig gis ched du bskul bas 'tsho byed bcu lhag la lag len ston pa dang sbrag dngul chu btso bkru nas bzung rin chen grang sbyor ril bu phon che ba zhig sbyar/ byang rgyud rgyal po a bu btsun pas 'bum rgyas pa zu re mgo 'jo thang du bzhengs pa'i sku rim la phyin/ dpal ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i sgo nas drag po'i sbyin sreg byas pas rtags mtshan 'bring tsam byung*/ de nas gser gdugs kyang mgyogs par zin nas mthil du spyan drangs|

bsgrigs nas yan lag lnga pa'i 'bras bu dge ba la dkyil 'khor de nyid slar zhal phye nas rab tu gnas pa gzab rgyas grub par byas 'phral/ cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i mchod rten dngul gdung gsar pa'i dbu steng du phub pas gzi brjid che ba byung*/ mtshe'u kha rnying ma'i mgon khang gi rdo sku me 'bar dang bcas pa khang gsar byang ma'i gnyer khang phugs su yod pa steng gi gzims chung sbug ma'i phugs su spos/ khang gsar 'og mar bla ma brje len la 'om sdings gdan sa zur pa bla ma lam pa ba dang dbon po dgong rtse ba rjes su bzhag /bdag rtse bar 'byor/ 'bras spungs nas rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa chen po nas bka' shog dang*/ rgya zhang khrom gyi gter ma gnam lcags kyi rdo rje/ karma pa rang byung rdo rjes bsam yas mchims phu nas spyan drangs pa'i rta mgrin phur pa dzhai kṣim las grub pa rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phra btab pa/ 'ja' dmar po yug sogs kyi bka' shog rten dang bcas/ rgyal ba ratna sogs dam pa gong ma yin nges rnams kyi dad rten dang*/ bdag rang gis gshin rje yang zlog gi kha 'gengs su brtsams pa'i dpe cha gang yod rnams bskur phebs pa dang lhan cig |yang zlog rang gi dogs gcod snga ma'i 'phro shog dril rgyang 'dom gang lhag nges la mchan bu thob phebs pa sogs rkang gtad gnang byung bar/ phebs sgo ji lta ba bzhin bsgrubs te myur bar phul/ de rjes rgyal ba'i drung nas bka' shog dang*/ loka tri'i shog khra khungs thub dang gshin rje'i yang zlog gi kha 'gengs la legs bshad gnang 'dug pa lta bu loka tri la'ang yod na bskur phebs pa dang lhan cig /yang zlog rang gi dogs gcod shog dril 'dom phyed do tsam yod pa zhig stsal byung bar bka' mchid cod pan du mnos te ji lta ba myur du bris te phul/ de rjes snga gong 'bras spungs su phyin skabs dbyings sar sgar pa che chung bsgril ba sogs snyan 'bul zhus nas slar zhabs bskul zhu bsam yang*/

lhor dpung bzhengs sogs thugs g.yeng che bas zhu ma nus par lo hril po gcig 'gyangs par/ 'di skabs yar la rting bskul phebs sgo gnang byung ba la rgyu mtshan zhib tshags phul bas sku tshab gtsang gzugs po nas gzhon nu lags gnang byung ba dang bstun/ sgar che ba'i bla ma rgyal sras dang*/ sgar chung gi bla ma brgyad ra ba gnyis zur du bzhugs/ sgar pa gnyis spro lung du lhan cig bsgril ba'i bla mar nang so rin chen dang*/ gnyer pa dbon cung*/ gzhan yang las tshan so so bsko bzhag dang*/ rtsis sprod bskos ja shis brjod rnams 'di kar grub pa byas/ sgar chung rtsis sprod la zhal ngo gzugs po'i zlar bla ma lam pa ba btang grub pa dang bstun sgar chen spro lung du bsgril nas lhan cig gdan 'jags par byas/ nang chen khrod nas dpon slob mgar bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyi sku skye dang*| bla ma ban grong ba tshul khrims rin chen pa'i skye ba/ zla dgon bla ma zhogs pa/ spang brjid dgon nas bla ma bkra shis rin chen gyi sku skye rnams 'dzoms byung bar bdag rang gis brtsams chos po ti bcu lhag tsam 'dug pa'i lung thog mtha' bar gsum byas shing*/ ban grong sku skyer mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i dbang sogs byas nas khad kyis nang chen khog tu slar brdzangs/ da lta lo dus kyi rim 'gro gdan sa chen po nas klog dpon gyis dbu byas gsung rab klog sgrog la byang ba nyi shu rtsa lnga 'byor ba'i rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog tshar gnyis dang*/ de dag gi dgongs 'grel bstan 'gyur tshar gcig sgrog pa'i skabs dang*/ slar lo dus kyi rim 'gro sos gtor chen mo yang 'dzugs ran pa'i rnam g.yeng gi mgo rtsom pa'i skabs 'di bzhin yin la/ gzhan yang grwa thang gi par gso dpyad kyi rgyud bzhi kar mchan bu zhib pa dang*/ gshin rje yang zlog gi ngag 'don dang*/ gshin rje 'char ka nyang gter gyi sngags sgrub dang*/ bde mgon gyi las rim gsal sgron dang*/

gtor zlog bya mgo ma'i las sgrig bstan srung mtshon cha dang*/ rdo rje gtsug lag phrin las drag po mngon du byung ba dang*/ chos dbang gi klu bdud lto ba'i zab gter man ngag snying gzer nag po dang*/ dgongs pa yang zab kyi rtsa gsum las byang dang*/ mgon po'i thod nag be'u bum gsum pa dpal phag grus mdzad pa sogs mchan bus bkrol/ de ltar bla ma lho pa sku skye dang la phyi rdor 'dzin bla ma chos sogs kyis bskul ngor/ rang gi rtogs brjod rags pa 'di rnams rang gis gang dran dang ma dran pa zla bo rgyus can 'dra la yang dris nas wal wol du bris pa yin cing*/ de ltar rang nyid btsas nas chos smra shes pa nas bzung da lta rang lo drug cu re bzhi lon pa'i bar du khams dang 'di phyogs lho byang rnams su rnam dkar gyi 'brel pa bzhag pa dang dbang lung che chung sna tshogs pa bgyis pa dang*/ dge tshul dang bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs pa dang*/ sngar srol gyi mthil sgrub sde'i mtshams grwa brje len dang*/ yang ri sgar gyi mtshams grwa brje len sogs kyi skabs su dbang khrid lung sogs bgyis pa dang*/ lo dus kyi sos gtor dang*/ mtshams bcad phran bu bgyis pa dang*/ drag po mngon spyod kyi sreg 'phangs mnan gsum/ srog gzer gtad gsum/ sdebs gshor rlung gsum/ 'byed dkrugs bskrad gsum/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum sogs las rab 'byams bsgrubs pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten phran tshegs bzhengs pa sogs mang bar yod kyang brjed ngas kyi dbang du thal bas 'dir bri rgyu ma rnyed/ skye bo pho mo skra bcad skyabs sdom tsam byin pa ni bgrang bas mi lang ba lta bu yod do// zhes pa yang rang nyid kyis sug bris su g.yar khral rngo thog par bgyis pa yin no// slar yang gong gi 'phro snga gong bsam yas chos skyong gi zangs kyi khyi mo rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa zhig yod pa re zhig tshe 'phos mi lus thob pa rgyal dbang ratnas rjes su bzung bla ma gdan gcig par grags|

gdangs dang gar 'cham la mkhas shing rje de'i thugs sras su gyur pa'i skye ba dge slong snang gsal ba dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sa khyi zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu bdun la mdzod 'dzin du bskos| rang phyogs rnams kyis legs bya'i brda mtshon kyang byas/ lcam zhabs drung*/ bla ma mgar gyi sprul sku/ bla ma bkra shis rin chen gyi sku skye sogs 'dus pa mang bar dwags po'i bka' 'bum/ rje phag gru'i bka' 'bum/ skyob pa'i bka' 'bum/ rje kun dga' rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/ rgyal dbang ratna'i bka' 'bum/ dgongs gcig /zab chos/ bstan snying*| dgongs pa yang zab/ rje dngul chu chos rdzong ba'i bka' 'bum/ rang lugs kyi chos spyod rab gsal/ bde mchog /mgon po'i bskang gsol/ a phyi/ zhing skyong*/ drang srong*/ gnod sbyin rtsi dmar ba rnams kyi bskang gsol/ mgon po'i gtor zlog bya mgo ma/ bsang rngan bde legs kun 'byung*/ a phyi'i lhug gsol/ rgyal gsol la sogs pa lung mang bar byas/ hor dpon gyi 'bum yang legs par grub pas/ sa khyi zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga la mgo 'jo'i thang du ru thog la 'byor/ tshes bcu drug la sbra nag chen mor 'dus pa'i tshogs dang bcas pas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa rga lo lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du sta gon/ tshes bcu bdun la dngos gzhi sogs rab gnas kyi rgyud dang spyan dbye'i cho ga rgya gzhung rnams nas ji ltar gsungs pa 'khrul ba'i dri ma dang bral ba dag rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba rang nyid kyis bsgrubs te legs par bgyis/ slar yang gad la 'or du bla ma sku skye'i nang rten dngul las grub pa o rgyan rin po che'i sku khru gang tsam bzhengs 'dug par bdag nyid gcig pus gshin rje zla gsang gi sgo nas rab gnas rgyas pa byas/ spro lung zhabs drung bde bar gshegs pa de nyid kyi sprul pa'i sku long po glang dkyil grong du khyim tshang shar pa zhes par yab lha rgyal dang*/

yum rnam rgyal mo 'bod pa'i sras su me spre'u lor sku bltams 'dug pa 'khrul med yin par rngo thogs steng sa khyi zla ba dgu pa'i nyer lnga la dbur stod 'bri chos phyug klung rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu spyan drangs/ zla ba de ka'i nyer brgyad yan lag lnga'i 'bras bus mchog tu dge ba'i nyin dbu skra gtsug phud bregs shing skyabs su 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen du bsgrubs/ mtshan dkon mchog phrin las bzang por gsol| mnga' ris mang yul rgyal sras chos rje rin chen pa'i grwa rgyun dang gser zho stong byu ru spos shel sogs 'bul chas bzang po 'byor/ mthil dang ka tshal sogs su 'bod mi byung bas phyin/ yang gangs ri ti ser spro lung gi rje bde gshegs kyi phyi rten gser gdung bzhengs mi 'khor ba dag stabs gcig tu dgon pa rgyang grags sogs nas kyang grwa rgyun dang*/ gser byu ru spos shel la sogs pa'i 'bul nor rgya che yang 'byor/ slar skabs shig tu rkyen gang yang med par mdzub mo shin tu na ba zhig byung bas bde mtshams su bcad/ mtshams khog de khar bla ma lho pa sku skye/ mgar sku skye/ rin rgyal ba'i sku skye/ bkra shis rin chen pa'i sku skye/ khams skyo nang so sogs la lnga ldan gyi khrid bshad sbyar mdor bsdus tsam la dmigs rkang rgyas pa sbar bcangs ma zhig bdun gnyis la grub par byas/ rin rgyal ba'i sku skye la bskos bya dang bcas sga glang chen dgon du brdzangs/ de nas sa mo phag lo gsar pa'i lo dus kyi rim 'gro gshin rje tshe bdag gi srung zlog sgrub pa dang*/ bka' bstan 'gyur sgrog pa sogs grub cing*/ sos gtor yang bgyis/ bla ma lho pa sku skye yang sgom sde nang chen khrod du rdzong brda grub| de nas gtsang shel dkar sgrub sde/ rta'u mchog grub gling sogs phyogs mtha'i mtshams grwa lo gsum gyi brje res dgos pa rnams so so nas 'byor/

da lta mtshams grwa brje len dang bla ma bsko bzhag gi grabs yul nyer bsdogs bgyid pa'i skabs su yod pa 'di bzhin no// de nas de ka'i mus la spro lung du phyin/ sgar pa mtshams grwa khag /mthil sgrub sde'i mtshams pa sogs 'dus pa mi nyung ba la phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi nyams khrid go don bshad sbyar dang sbrags pa/ 'khor lo sdom pa rga lo lha lnga'i dbang rgyas pa dbang don rgyud sde'i dgongs pa 'khrul med du bkral ba'i bshad pas brgyan pa/ dgongs pa yang zab kyi rtsa gsum gtor dbang*/ zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dbang*/ rig 'dzin padma gling pas gung thang rdo rje gur phug nas spyan drangs pa'i bla ma drag po dmar chen gyi dbang chog reg pa don ldan/ dpal mgon phyag bzhi pa'i bum dbang bcu bzhi pa rnams kyang lag len 'khrul med dbang don brda bkrol lung rigs kyis rgyab skyor ba byas/ bca' yig gsar pa bsgrags pa dang*/ khrims kyang sngon chad las dam tsam e yong gi kha ta tshogs lab zhib tu gtang nas yod/ de nas rtse bar 'byor/ dbyar smad rtse ba skor du rims bdun drug pa zhig mched par gshin rje'i gshed po'i las mtha' rgyu ma'i zhags pa la brten pa'i rims nad gcod pa'i thabs byas pas 'phro gtsang du chad/ sa mo phag lo 'dir 'bras drug shin tu legs pa rgyal khams phyogs khyab tu byung bar sad kyi nyer 'tshe byung dogs gzhan pas bskul ba med kyang*/ rang gi bsam bzang mthing ril gyis gnam 'degs pa'i dpe ltar dang du blangs nas rgya nag chu 'khor che ba 'dzugs pa dang*/ sngags dmigs tsam byas pas sprin ye med kyang ba mo thams cad zil par 'gro ba dang*/ chu 'khor gyi sgros kyi rtsa bar dngul chu dngos su byung ba chu dpon gyis blangs 'dug pa dang*/ chu 'khor bskor ba'i tshe de ma thag sprin 'du char 'bab pa dang*/ chu 'khor gyi chu bcad pa'i tshe gnam thangs pa sogs lag pa'i 'du byed kyis bcos pa ltar rang dbang du 'dug pa/

grogs po rnams la kha ta slob ston byed pa bas nam mkha' stong pa rang dbang 'du ba zhig byung ba'i nyams mtshar ba tsam du byung*/ de ka'i mu la rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa chen po'i zhabs rdul phyag bgyi ba'i slad du hor zla brgyad pa'i yar tshes bcu gcig la rtse ba nas bteg/ lam zhag gsum gyis lha ldan ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug khang chen por tshes bcu bzhi la 'byor/ 'di skabs drang srong gdol pa shar te rgyal ba chab zhugs pa la phebs 'dug /nyi ma kha yar po ta la'i ltag sgo nas zhabs 'gros kyis phebs par/ zhabs tshigs la chab bab nas snyun zug dang skrang po yod pa zhig byung 'dug par rong nas chu dron blangs pa slar bsres pas zhabs la 'phrod bsten gnang ba'i skabs kyi sku mtshams shin tu dam pa zhig bcad 'dug pa/ bdag tshor zur chas sogs gya nom par gnang zhing snyun gzhi cung zad ma dwangs bar sgug sdod byas par snyugs ma bud gsungs pa sogs phebs byung bas lhod phabs nas bsdad/ nyer lnga'i nyin sku mtshams dam pa'i khongs su shog gsungs pas phyin/ bdag dang nye gnas dan pa dang lde mig pa rnam dag gsol dpon dang bzhi sku gzhogs su thar cing phyag 'bul grub nas 'gag tu sdod bcug /bdag gi phyag 'bul skabs bzhugs gdan mtho gang tsam las mi 'dug kyang bzhengs pa dang mjal dar slog /dbu thug sogs mthong bzos dpe med gnang*/ bdag la yang gdan mtho gang tsam 'dug /de nyin ri pa rtser rgyangs la bdag dpon slob gnyis ma gtogs su yang med par gnang nas gshin rje tshe bdag lcags sdig skor yang zlog king kang bka' gter gyi skor/ 'char kha sogs gshed skor rnams la dri rtsad dang dogs gcod zhib rgyas su gnang*/ de'i phyi nyin tsha bzhes gong tsam nas yang pho ta lar phyin/ gung tshigs skabs ma gtogs nyi ma bzhud gdong bar snga nyin ltar gzhan pa su yang med par snga ma'i gsung 'phro rnams kyi 'phro dang*/ gzhan yang bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi khro rol skor dang*/

dregs pa nyi shu khams byon/ 'khor nag bka' gter/ gtad khram rus sbal nag po/ rgyal gsol lha gang ma/ sngags sdebs kyi skor sogs drag po mngon spyod kyi gzhung chen mang po dang*/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa dang zhal bzhi pa'i skor sogs shin tu mang ba'i dri rtsad dogs gcod dang*/ gzhan yang 'phral yun gyi gsung 'phro mang rabs gnang*/ khyed kyis mngon spyod kyi las sbyor byas pa'i rtags thon pa ji tsam byung*/ las sbyor gzhung gang 'dra'i rigs lag tu blangs sogs dri rtsad shin tu zhib pa gnang byung ba'i lan thams cad sba gsang med par zhus/ lhag par gshin rje lcags sdig gi mchod rten bca' lugs deng sang sgron ma drug pa ltar mdor bsdus tsam ma gtogs/ ṭī ka rin chen phreng ba ltar gces pa'i 'khor lo bcu gsum tsam rdzogs par grub pa'i bca' gzhi yongs rdzogs rgyas pa 'di lag len zhib cha dbus gtsang gi sngags ban su la yang mi 'dug pas/ khyed kyis gshin rje yang zlog gza' gdong zhal gdams ltar kha gsal zhing lag tu len bde ba khrigs chags shig cis kyang gyis gsungs pa'i phebs sgo nan chags su gnang zhing*/ nyi ma gzhud mtshams sku gzhogs su dngos po'i gnang sbyin gya nom pa stsal te lha sar log /phyi nang nyer bdun gyi nyin sku gzhogs nas chos rje spos dga' ba'i sku tsha lags 'bal 'bal zer ba zhig yod par yang zlog gi skor rnams dang*/ phyag bris sam ṭa dang dogs gcod phran bu la mchan bu dgos tshul gnang byung bar/ yang zlog gi srung zlog bsad mnan gyi sngags tshig la sham bsgyur byed tshul sogs snga sor phul ma grub pa'i 'phro rnams dang*/ bsad mnan gyi ngag 'don nyes byas drag bskul/ so sdebs kyi dregs pa bskul ba/ zla gsang 'dus pa'i tant+rar gsungs pa'i thun bskul sogs blo la gang 'dug rnams kyang bris nas phul/ gzhan phyag dpe 'bul dgos dang rtags ldan du bsgrubs pa'i thun gyi phab rgyun 'bul dgos sogs mang ba thor 'khod gnang byung ba rnams khyer/

nyer dgu la lha ldan nas bteg /lam zhag lnga bgyis nas rtse bar 'byor/ de ltar gyi yar lam dang phyir lam lha sar sdod ring sogs la bsngo byang dang 'phrad mi sogs bgrang las 'das pa zang zing khor yug tu song*/ rtse bar 'byor nas stag lung zhabs drung rin po che ma chen gyi sku gzhogs nas bla ma lung rings pa 'khrul zhig ched gtad kyis rdzong brda gnang byung bar/ mdo mang gi lung rnams zhabs drung ma chen rang gsan pa'i rtsis yin pas 'di pa la gyis zhes phebs byung bar/ mdo mang gi lung rnams mthar chags su bklag lung ni ma lcogs/ thog mtha' bar gsum dkyus ma bas zhib nges pa byed pa'i skabs 'di bzhin du gnas so// //dge'o// dge'o// dge'o//
